jobs.title: Dipl. Pflegefachfrau/-mann HF/FH Demenzbetreuung 60% für die Region Wettswil am Albis gesucht
jobs.description:
- Für ein bekanntes Haus im Bereich Pflege und Medizin in der Region Wettswil am Albis suchen wir Sie als Dipl. Pflegefachfrau/-mann HF/FH – Schwerpunkt Demenzbetreuung.

### Ihr Überblick zur Stelle als Dipl. Pflegefachfrau/-mann HF/FH in Wettswil am Albis

**Position:** Dipl. Pflegefachfrau/-mann HF/FH

**Fachbereich:** Demenzbetreuung

**Pensum:** 60 %

**Anstellung:** Feste Stelle

**Start:** Nach Vereinbarung

**Arbeitsort:** Region Wettswil am Albis

**Arbeitgeber:** Den Namen nennen wir Ihnen gerne im Gespräch

Kurz gesagt: Der Rahmen stimmt. Zudem lernen Sie nun den Arbeitsort besser kennen, denn genau darum geht es als Nächstes.

Wettswil am Albis liegt im südwestlichen Kanton Zürich und besticht durch seine idyllische Lage in einer grünen Voralpenregion. Sie erreichen den Ort bequem mit der S-Bahn, die eine direkte Verbindung nach Zürich bietet. Die Region kombiniert ländliche Ruhe mit guter Verkehrserschliessung und bietet Ihnen als Arbeitnehmerin oder Arbeitnehmer ein attraktives Umfeld zwischen Natur und städtischer Erreichbarkeit. Dies macht Wettswil besonders für Pendlerinnen und Pendler zu einem beliebten Wohnort.

### Das erwartet Sie als Pflegefachfrau HF/FH Demenzbetreuung in Wettswil am Albis

- Sie tragen dabei die Verantwortung über den ganzen Pflegeprozess, von der Erhebung bis zur Auswertung
- Zudem: Durchführung ärztlicher Verordnungen sowie sichere Abgabe der Medikamente
- Zudem überwachen Sie die Vitalzeichen, denn Sie erkennen früh, wenn sich etwas ändert
- Darüber hinaus leiten Sie FaGe, Pflegeassistenz sowie Lernende fachlich an
- Ausserdem lückenlose Pflegedokumentation im elektronischen System
- Zusammenarbeit mit Ärzteschaft, Therapien sowie Angehörigen auf Augenhöhe

### Ihr Profil – darauf kommt es an

- Zuerst das Fachliche: die Ausbildung als dipl. Pflegefachfrau/-mann HF oder FH
- Bei ausländischem Diplom: SRK-Anerkennung zwingend erforderlich
- Zudem Erfahrung in der Langzeitpflege, Akutpflege oder Reha
- Vor allem Verantwortung, Empathie sowie eine belastbare, ruhige Art
- Dazu sehr gute Deutschkenntnisse in Wort und Schrift (mind. B2)

### Ihr Arbeitsumfeld: Demenzbetreuung

Die Demenzbetreuung arbeitet person-zentriert: Im Mittelpunkt steht der Mensch mit seiner Biografie. Sie gestalten deshalb einen Alltag mit festen Ritualen sowie vertrauten Handgriffen, erkennen nonverbale Signale und begegnen Unruhe mit Ruhe.

Kurz gesagt: Als Pflegefachfrau HF/FH Demenzbetreuung in Wettswil am Albis verbinden Sie Fachlichkeit mit einem Umfeld, das zu Ihnen passt. Darum lohnt sich diese Stelle doppelt.

### Der Beruf im Detail: Was macht eine diplomierte Pflegefachperson HF/FH?

Als diplomierte Pflegefachperson HF/FH tragen Sie die fachliche Verantwortung über den ganzen Pflegeprozess. Sie erheben den Pflegebedarf, danach planen Sie die Massnahmen und werten die Ergebnisse aus. Zudem steuern Sie die Abgabe der Medikamente, überwachen Vitalzeichen und erkennen Veränderungen früh. Somit entsteht Pflegequalität, die ankommt.

Der Weg in diesen Beruf führt über die höhere Fachschule (HF) oder das Bachelorstudium Pflege (FH). Ausländische Diplome brauchen dafür eine [Anerkennung durch das Schweizerische Rote Kreuz (SRK)](https://www.redcross.ch/de/srk-anerkennung). Ausserdem stehen erfahrenen Fachpersonen viele Wege offen: ein Nachdiplomstudium (NDS), die Rolle als Berufsbildnerin oder die Teamleitung.

Die Region Wettswil am Albis verzeichnet eine hohe Nachfrage nach qualifizierten Pflegefachfrauen und -männern mit Spezialisierung auf Demenzbetreuung, insbesondere für Teilzeitpositionen wie 60%-Stellen. Sie profitieren von exzellenten Chancen auf dem lokalen Arbeitsmarkt, da Alters- und Pflegeinstitutionen in der Region kontinuierlich Fachkräfte suchen. iPersonal als spezialisierter Vermittler erleichtert Ihnen den Einstieg erheblich durch gezielt ausgewählte Positionen, umfassende Unterstützung im Bewerbungsprozess und direkte Kontakte zu renommierten Arbeitgebern in Ihrer unmittelbaren Nähe.

### Ihre Vorteile mit MediPersonal in der Region Wettswil am Albis

- Bezahlte Kurse über [Temptraining](https://temptraining.ch) – somit bekommt Ihre Karriere Rückenwind
- Persönliche Begleitung von der Bewerbung bis zum ersten Arbeitstag
- Dazu schnelle sowie ehrliche Antworten – meist innerhalb von 24 Stunden
- Faire Verträge nach GAV, denn Ihr Lohn soll klar und offen sein
- Zudem eine langfristige Perspektive, denn wir vermitteln Stellen, die wirklich zu Ihrem Leben passen
- Und vor allem: Diskretion garantiert – Ihre Bewerbung behandeln wir streng vertraulich

### Häufige Fragen zur Stelle als Pflegefachfrau HF/FH Demenzbetreuung in Wettswil am Albis

**Welche Ausbildung brauche ich für diese Stelle?**
Dafür benötigen Sie ein Diplom als Pflegefachfrau/-mann HF oder aber einen Bachelor in Pflege FH. Ausländische Abschlüsse sind mit SRK-Anerkennung ebenso willkommen.

**Ist mein ausländisches Pflegediplom in der Schweiz gültig?**
Ja, sofern das Schweizerische Rote Kreuz (SRK) Ihr Diplom anerkannt hat. Ausserdem beraten wir Sie gerne kostenlos zur Anerkennung.

**Wie schnell erhalte ich eine Rückmeldung auf meine Bewerbung?**
Meist hören Sie schon innerhalb von 24 Stunden von uns, denn Ihre Zeit ist uns wichtig. Zudem halten wir Sie danach laufend auf dem neusten Stand.

**Erfahre ich den Namen des Arbeitgebers?**
Ja – sobald wir sprechen, nennen wir Ihnen den Namen der Institution offen. Denn Offenheit gehört bei uns dazu.

Übrigens: Laufend weitere [offene Stellen](https://med-ipersonal.ch/offene-stellen/), Jobs und Stellenangebote in Pflege und Medizin finden Sie auf med-ipersonal.ch – täglich aktualisiert.

Kurz gesagt: Der Rahmen stimmt. Zudem lernen Sie nun den Arbeitsort besser kennen, denn genau darum geht es als Nächstes.

Killwangen liegt im Kanton Aargau und bietet Ihnen eine hervorragende geografische Position zwischen Zürich und Luzern. Die Region verfügt über eine ausgezeichnete Verkehrsanbindung durch die Eisenbahn und Autobahn, was Ihnen schnelle Pendlerverbindungen ermöglicht. Als Arbeitsort besticht Killwangen durch seine Nähe zu Wirtschaftszentren, die hohe Lebensqualität und das ausgewogene Verhältnis zwischen urbanem Flair und ländlicher Ruhe.

### Das packen Sie als Pflegefachfrau HF/FH Notfall in Killwangen an

- Sie tragen dabei die Verantwortung über den ganzen Pflegeprozess, von der Erhebung bis zur Auswertung
- Zudem: Durchführung ärztlicher Verordnungen sowie sichere Abgabe der Medikamente
- Zudem überwachen Sie die Vitalzeichen, denn Sie erkennen früh, wenn sich etwas ändert
- Darüber hinaus leiten Sie FaGe, Pflegeassistenz sowie Lernende fachlich an
- Ausserdem lückenlose Pflegedokumentation im elektronischen System
- Zusammenarbeit mit Ärzteschaft, Therapien sowie Angehörigen auf Augenhöhe

### Ihr Rüstzeug für den erfolgreichen Einstieg

- Zuerst das Fachliche: die Ausbildung als dipl. Pflegefachfrau/-mann HF oder FH
- Bei ausländischem Diplom: SRK-Anerkennung zwingend erforderlich
- Zudem Erfahrung in der Langzeitpflege, Akutpflege oder Reha
- Vor allem Verantwortung, Empathie sowie eine belastbare, ruhige Art
- Dazu sehr gute Deutschkenntnisse in Wort und Schrift (mind. B2)

### Ihr Arbeitsumfeld: Notfall

Sie arbeiten im Notfallbereich – dort, wo kein Tag dem anderen gleicht. Schnelles Erfassen, klares Priorisieren und ruhige Kommunikation zählen hier mehr als alles andere. Dafür erleben Sie Medizin in ihrer ganzen Breite, im eingespielten Team.

Kurz gesagt: Als Pflegefachfrau HF/FH Notfall in Killwangen verbinden Sie Fachlichkeit mit einem Umfeld, das zu Ihnen passt. Darum lohnt sich diese Stelle doppelt.

### Der Beruf im Detail: Was macht eine diplomierte Pflegefachperson HF/FH?

Diplomierte Pflegefachpersonen HF/FH tragen die fachliche Verantwortung im gesamten Pflegeprozess. Sie erheben den Pflegebedarf, danach planen Sie die Massnahmen und werten die Ergebnisse aus. Zudem steuern Sie die Abgabe der Medikamente, überwachen Vitalzeichen und erkennen Veränderungen früh. Somit entsteht Pflegequalität, die ankommt.

Der Weg in diesen Beruf führt über die höhere Fachschule (HF) oder das Bachelorstudium Pflege (FH). Ausländische Diplome brauchen dafür eine [Anerkennung durch das Schweizerische Rote Kreuz (SRK)](https://www.redcross.ch/de/srk-anerkennung). Ausserdem stehen erfahrenen Fachpersonen viele Wege offen: ein Nachdiplomstudium (NDS), die Rolle als Berufsbildnerin oder die Teamleitung.

Der Arbeitsmarkt für diplomierte Pflegefachpersonen in der Notfallmedizin ist in der Region Killwangen äußerst angespannt, mit konstant hoher Nachfrage seitens Spitäler und Kliniken. Ihre Qualifikation ist sehr gefragt, wodurch sich Ihnen hervorragende Chancen auf eine schnelle Platzierung bieten. iPersonal unterstützt Sie als erfahrener Vermittler durch umfassendes lokales Netzwerk, maßgeschneiderte Stellenvorschläge und persönliche Betreuung, was Ihren Einstieg erheblich erleichtert und beschleunigt.

- Kostenlose Weiterbildungen über [Temptraining](https://temptraining.ch) – somit bekommt Ihre Karriere Rückenwind
- Persönliche Begleitung von der Bewerbung bis zum ersten Arbeitstag

- Faire Verträge nach GAV, denn Ihr Lohn soll klar und offen sein
- Zudem eine langfristige Perspektive, denn wir vermitteln Stellen, die wirklich zu Ihrem Leben passen
- Und vor allem: Diskretion garantiert – Ihre Bewerbung behandeln wir streng vertraulich

### Häufige Fragen zur Stelle als Pflegefachfrau HF/FH Notfall in Killwangen

**Welche Ausbildung brauche ich für diese Stelle?**
Dafür benötigen Sie ein Diplom als Pflegefachfrau/-mann HF oder aber einen Bachelor in Pflege FH. Ausländische Abschlüsse sind mit SRK-Anerkennung ebenso willkommen.

**Ist mein ausländisches Pflegediplom in der Schweiz gültig?**
Ja, sofern das Schweizerische Rote Kreuz (SRK) Ihr Diplom anerkannt hat. Ausserdem beraten wir Sie gerne kostenlos zur Anerkennung.

**Wie schnell erhalte ich eine Rückmeldung auf meine Bewerbung?**
In der Regel melden wir uns bereits innerhalb von 24 Stunden bei Ihnen, denn Ihre Zeit ist wertvoll. Zudem halten wir Sie danach laufend auf dem neusten Stand.

**Erfahre ich den Namen des Arbeitgebers?**
Ja – sobald wir sprechen, nennen wir Ihnen den Namen der Institution offen. Denn Offenheit gehört bei uns dazu.

Infrastructure as Code \& Automatisierung  
Entwicklung und Pflege eines modularen Terraform\-Frameworks als gemeinsame Grundlage aller Cloud\-Ressourcen im Unternehmen

Aktive Mitarbeit beim Aufbau einer Security\-by\-Design\-Kultur: Secrets Management, Network Segmentation, least\-privilege RBAC

Aktive Teilnahme an SAFe\-Zeremonien: PI Planning, System Demo, Inspect \& Adapt, Team Iterations

jobs.title: Philanthropy Advisor for Private Major Donors - German
jobs.description:
Join MSF OCG as a Philanthropy Advisor!
We are looking for passionate candidates ready to contribute to our humanitarian mission.
Below, you will find the job details and the qualifications we are looking for.
Inclusivity and Diversity at MSF
Do your qualifications and experience not exactly match all requirements of the job?
At MSF OCG, we are committed to an inclusive culture that supports and amplifies the diverse voices of our staff members. We strive to create workplaces where teams of people with diverse backgrounds, characteristics, perspectives, ideas and experiences work together to advance MSF's social mission and create better outcomes for our patients and the communities we work with.
We understand that some people may hesitate to apply for employment if they don't meet all listed job requirements. Research shows that this is especially true for women. If you believe your profile is a good match for this position, we invite you to apply even if you don’t fulfil every listed qualification.
We encourage applications from individuals of all genders, ages, sexual orientations, ethnicities, background, religions, beliefs, ability status, and all other diversity characteristics.
MSF does not tolerate sexual exploitation and abuse, any kind of discrimination or harassment, including sexual harassment. All selected candidates will undergo reference checks.
Context & mission
Médecins Sans Frontières is an independent, international medical and humanitarian organization that provides care to people in need, people affected by natural or man-made disasters, and victims of armed conflict, without discrimination and without regard to race, religion, creed or political affiliation (MSF Charter).
The MSF movement is built around 5 operational centers supported by 24 sections and offices worldwide. MSF Operational Center Geneva (MSF OCG) is one of these centers.
As Philanthropy Advisor, you will secure and grow income from individual major donors in German-speaking Switzerland and Liechtenstein. You will manage a portfolio of assigned donors, build strong and lasting relationships, deepen their engagement with MSF’s social mission, and identify opportunities to increase their support. This includes organising meetings with MSF representatives, sharing relevant information on MSF projects and priorities, coordinating donor events and webinars, presenting funding opportunities, and directly soliciting financial contributions. You will also contribute to the effective use of the CRM system and prospect research to strengthen the team’s fundraising approach.
Tasks & Responsibilities
Qualification, cultivation and stewardship
•    Manages a portfolio of Major donors
•    Is accountable to deliver the best possible experience to MSF key donors in in order to increase their engagement.
•    Qualify each Major Donor and Major Donor prospect, in close cooperation with the Prospect Researcher
•    In coordination with the Team Coordinator, closely liaise with the Middle Donor manager to identify and update potential Major Donors
•    Prepare and facilitate one to one meetings, calls, presentations and other meaningful interactions with major donors or representatives (lawyers, wealth managers, etc.)
•    Establish relations with new potential major donors, including high-potential middle givers and other prospects, including ultra-high-net-worth individuals, to secure significant future support for MSF’s work
•    Interact and collaborate with key spokespersons within MSF (President, General Director, Director of Operations, other management team members), as well as field staff, with the aim of bringing donors closer to the organisation in an attempt to show them our live saving mission and work in the projects.
•    Define, propose and organise visits to MSF offices and projects, in line with MSF criteria and guidance
•    Ensure that the nature / identity of donors is in line with MSF gifts acceptance policy.
•    Ensure that the moves management runs smoothly, and donors are thanked and steward properly.
•    Keep the database up-to-date
•    Liaise with Writing Officers for the preparation, including proof reading and editing, of project briefings, reports, proposals, slideshows, infographics and any other creative way of presenting MSF and its mission to private major donors
•    Liaise with the Direct Marketing team to adequately leverage marketing appeals and to coordinate touch-points
Solicitation
•    Present and defend MSF’s cases for support to individual major donors in German speaking Switzerland and Lichtenstein.
•    Ensure that the major donors journey strategy is followed and that major donors are solicited according to their motivations in a personalised way.
Information and data management
•    Closely work with the System Support Team to ensure most efficient use of Customer Relationship Management Database
•    Support the Team Coordinator in income forecasting and quarterly analysis of results
Others
•    Participate in the Community of Practice for Individual Major Donors of MSF
•    Work proactively on projects as needed in the Unit, upon request by her/his supervisor.
Your profile
Education
•    University degree in Business Management, Marketing, Communications, Political Science, Law, International Relations or equivalent
Experience
•    Minimum of 3 years of professional experience in similar functions or in the fields of  high-level relational skills, like public relations, wealth management or sales/marketing/communications, high-level advocacy or humanitarian project work
•    Experience in using Microsoft Dynamics or other Customer Relationship Manager System: a plus
•    Experience and knowledge of humanitarian aid: a plus
Languages
•    (Swiss) German (native or equivalent),
•    English
•    French : a plus
•    Italian: a plus
Skills/ Technical competencies
•    Proven writing skills
•    Excellent in oral public presentations
•    Use of data base a plus
Personal Abilities/Qualities
•    Excellent interpersonal skills
•    Rigorous and good organizational skills
•    Empathic, enthusiastic, optimistic
•    Result orientation
•    Team spirit
•    Strong commitment to MSF’s social mission and values
Terms of employment
•    Full-time position 100% (40h/week)
•    Open-ended contract
•    Working place: Zürich
•    Ideal start date: asap
•    Gross annual salary (for 100%): from CHF 87’372.- to CHF 100’608.- (salary commensurate with equivalent experience and internal salary grid)
•    Paid vacation: 25 days per year, prorate temporis, plus any Swiss public holidays falling within the contract period.
•    Pension plan: pension contribution covered 3/4 by MSF, 1/4 by staff member.
•    Relocation support available for eligible candidates.
How to apply
Candidates are invited to submit their application exclusively through our recruitment platform, following these guidelines:
•    CV (maximum 2 pages)
•    Cover letter (maximum 1 page)
•    Documents must be submitted in either English or French.
The application deadline is 30th August, 2026.
We reserve the right to close this vacancy earlier if we receive a sufficient number of quality applications.
All applications will be treated confidentially.
Only shortlisted candidates will be contacted.
Please note that we do not wish to use the services of recruitment or placement agencies.

jobs.title: Senior Associate – Treasury Strategy & Technology
jobs.description:
Shape the Future of Treasury. Lead with Innovation.

Treasury functions are undergoing a profound transformation. The convergence of advanced technology, artificial intelligence, and evolving financial landscapes is redefining how global organizations manage liquidity, mitigate risk, and drive strategic value. We're looking for an exceptional Senior Associate to help our clients navigate this transformation - someone who combines deep financial expertise with cutting-edge technology knowledge and a passion for innovation.

What You Can Expect From Us

- Strategic Advisory at the Highest Level: You will advise international corporations on complex treasury, financial risk management, and cash management challenges, with a specific focus on treasury technology, systems architecture, and digital transformation.
- Transformational Impact: You will help drive large-scale, multi-stakeholder transformation initiatives at global companies - reshaping how treasury functions operate, create value, and leverage technology.
- AI & Innovation Leadership: You will be at the forefront of applying artificial intelligence and machine learning to treasury and financial processes - from cash flow forecasting and liquidity optimization to fraud detection, risk modeling, and intelligent automation.
- Thought Leadership: You will provide thought leadership and practical, actionable advice on treasury strategy, financial risk management, regulatory compliance, and the evolving role of technology in finance.
- Efficiency & Value Creation: You will improve the added value, operational efficiency, internal controls, and regulatory compliance of clients' treasury functions and their supporting technology ecosystems.
- Collaborative Excellence: You will collaborate with a diverse, global network of highly talented experts across strategy, technology, risk, and finance - sharing knowledge and building innovative solutions together.
- Diverse, International Environment: You will work across multiple industries, service areas, and geographies in a dynamic and stimulating professional setting.

What We Expect From You

Experience & Qualifications
- 3 - 6 years of relevant professional experience in treasury consulting, treasury technology, financial risk management, or within a corporate treasury function with a strong systems and technology focus.
- University degree (Master's preferred) in Finance, Business Administration, Economics, Financial Engineering, Computer Science, or a related discipline.
- Professional certification such as CFA, FRM, CTP, or equivalent qualification, demonstrating deep expertise in financial analysis, accounting, and financial risk management.

Technical & Domain Expertise
- Deep financial analysis and risk management skills, including a strong understanding of financial instruments, hedge accounting, valuation methodologies, interest rate and FX risk, and treasury-related accounting standards (IFRS 9, etc.).
- In-depth, hands-on knowledge of at least one leading Treasury Management System (TMS) such as FIS (Quantum/Integrity), Kyriba, Coupa Treasury, ION (IT2/Wallstreet Suite), SAP Treasury, or similar - including implementation, configuration, and optimization experience.
- Familiarity with treasury processes and operations, including cash and liquidity management, bank relationship management, payments and bank connectivity (SWIFT, host-to-host), debt and investment management, and intercompany financing.
- Deep knowledge of the application of AI and machine learning to financial processes, including predictive analytics for cash forecasting, anomaly detection, natural language processing for financial data, robotic process automation (RPA), and the integration of intelligent solutions into treasury workflows.
- Understanding of the broader treasury technology ecosystem, including ERP integration, data architecture, API connectivity, cloud-based solutions, and emerging fintech platforms.

Personal & Professional Attributes
- Exceptional analytical and problem-solving capabilities, with the ability to synthesize complex financial, operational, and technical information into clear, compelling recommendations.
- Strong presentation and communication skills, with confidence and credibility when interacting with senior client stakeholders, including C-suite executives and treasury leadership.
- An advisory and team-oriented mindset - you take ownership of workstreams, mentor junior team members, foster innovative thinking, and contribute to a culture of excellence.
- Comfort working in a dynamic, fast-paced environment, both independently and as part of cross-functional, international teams.
- Fluent English (written and spoken) is required; German, French, or any additional language is a strong plus.
- A commitment to expanding our global business network and leveraging your personal and professional relationships to create opportunities and deepen client trust.

Why This Role?
This is not just a consulting role - it's an opportunity to sit at the intersection of finance and technology during one of the most exciting periods of transformation in corporate treasury. You will work on challenges that matter, with people who inspire, for clients who are shaping the global economy.

Credit Control Officer

About BCP  
Established in 1963 as a Swiss Bank, BCP segments its activities into two well\-established core businesses: Commodity Trade Finance and Wealth Management. These are reinforced by our expert Treasury services. BCP enjoys a solid reputation as a high\-quality service provider in all of its banking fields. Founded under Swiss Banking Law and Regulations, BCP is supervised by FINMA, the Swiss financial markets supervisory authority. Headquartered in Geneva, BCP also operates branches in Luxembourg and in Dubai.  
More information can be found at  
About the role  
As a Credit Control Officer, you will play a key role in safeguarding the Bank's credit portfolio by providing independent oversight and control over Commodity Trade Finance and Wealth Management credit facilities. Working closely with the Front Office, Credit Risk and Operations teams, you will contribute to the sound management of complex credit transactions, ensuring compliance with the Bank's risk appetite, internal policies and regulatory requirements. This role offers the opportunity to combine technical expertise, analytical thinking and business partnering within a dynamic international banking environment.  
Key responsibilities  
Perform independent controls over credit facilities, transactional exposures and clients' economic positions, including the assessment of hedging structures and overall risk exposure.  
Ensure ongoing monitoring of Commodity Trade Finance (CTF) and Wealth Management (WM) credit facilities in accordance with the Bank's control framework, internal policies and regulatory requirements.  
Partner closely with the Front Office and Credit Analysts by providing independent oversight on the structuring, renewal and lifecycle management of Commodity Trade Finance credit facilities.  
Support the monitoring and renewal of WM lending facilities while strengthening independent control processes across the portfolio.  
Prepare \& review credit documentation, identify control gaps and escalate potential risks or exceptions in a timely manner.  
Ensure the execution and continuous improvement of credit control administrative related tasks.  
Contribute to the continuous enhancement of Credit Control best practices, processes, procedures and governance.  
Prepare accurate management reports, credit monitoring documentation and regulatory information within established deadlines.  
Participate in cross\-functional initiatives and projects, including process optimisation, system enhancements and IT\-related developments.  
Foster close collaboration with internal stakeholders to promote a strong risk culture and operational excellence.  
Your profile  
University degree or professional qualification in Banking, Finance, Economics or another relevant discipline.  
8 to 10 years of experience within an international bank, ideally as a Transaction Manager, Trade Finance Risk Manager or in a similar control function with significant exposure to Commodity Trade Finance.  
Good understanding of credit risk principles, exposure monitoring and hedging mechanisms.  
Strong organizational skills and analytical mindset \- able to challenge, identify risks and propose practical solutions.  
Ability to work autonomously, and perform effectively under pressure with a high level of accuracy.  
Good accounting and financial analysis skills.  
Strong communication skills, in both English and French (written and spoken).  
Proficient in standard banking systems and Microsoft Office applications.  
Swiss residency mandatory.  
What we offer  
A dynamic and multicultural work inclusive culture where empowerment and creativity are competitive compensation from home (one day per week).

Please submit your résumé via JobUp.

jobs.title: Head of Accounting & Controlling CDI 80% - 100%
jobs.description:
About Us
Founded in 1892, the International Skating Union (ISU) is the oldest international winter sports Federation and the second oldest International Sports Federation. The ISU is recognized by the International Olympic Committee, governing the sports of Figure Skating and Speed Skating.
Today, the ISU’s vision is a world where everyone can experience and enjoy the thrill of skating and our mission is to sustainably grow and improve our sport by prioritizing our skaters, engaging our fans, nurturing partnerships and inspiring communities.

Our DNA is to be Inspiring, Supportive, Unstoppable.


The Role
The Head of Accounting & Controlling is responsible for leading the ISU's accounting and financial control functions, ensuring the integrity of financial reporting, maintaining an effective internal control framework, and overseeing treasury activities. Reporting to the Chief - Finance & Operations, the role manages a small finance team and plays a key role in supporting governance, risk management, and strategic financial decision-making.


Key Responsabilities

Accounting & Financial Operations
•    Lead, mentor and develop the accounting team responsible for the day-to-day finance operations.
•    Ensure the accurate and timely processing of all accounting transactions, including accounts payable, accounts receivable, general ledger, fixed assets and statutory reporting.
•    Oversee the year-end closing processes and ensure that soft closes take place on at least a quarterly basis.
•    Ensure compliance with applicable accounting standards, statutory requirements and ISU policies.
•    Continuously improve accounting processes, controls and reporting efficiency.

Financial Control & Internal Controls
•    Maintain and continuously enhance the ISU's internal control environment.
•    Develop, implement and monitor financial policies and procedures to ensure compliance and operational effectiveness.
•    Identify financial and operational risks and implement appropriate mitigating controls.
•    Support the implementation of best practices in governance and financial controls.

Treasury Management
•    Monitor the ISU's liquidity and working capital position.
•    Oversee daily treasury activities, including cash management, payment approvals and banking relationships.
•    Propose and implement appropriate FX hedging solutions
•    Prepare and monitor cash flow forecasts and funding requirements.
•    Support the optimisation of working capital and cash management processes.

Audit & Governance
•    Lead the preparation and coordination of the annual external audit.
•    Act as the primary liaison with external auditors and coordinate the timely resolution of audit findings.
•    Support the Chief - Finance & Operations in coordinating the activities of the Audit, Risk and Investment Committee.
•    Prepare financial reports, presentations and supporting documentation for

Executive Management, ISU Council and ISU Congress.
•    Monitor the implementation of audit recommendations and internal control improvements.
Business Partnership
•    Provide high-quality financial analysis and advice to senior management.
•    Contribute to budgeting, forecasting and financial planning processes.
•    Support strategic initiatives through financial analysis and business insights.
•    Foster a culture of continuous improvement, accountability and collaboration within the finance function.


Essential Requirements
•    Bachelor's degree in Accounting, Finance or a related discipline.
•    Professional accounting qualification (CPA, ACCA, ACA, CA or equivalent) preferred.
•    Minimum of 7–10 years of progressive experience in accounting, controlling or finance, including experience in a leadership role.
•    Demonstrated experience managing a small finance or accounting team.
•    Strong knowledge of financial reporting, internal controls and treasury management.
•    Experience coordinating external audits and interacting with auditors.
•    Strong understanding of corporate governance and risk management principles.
•    Experience with Microsoft Business Central (MSBC) ERP is highly desirable.
•    Experience in implementing or evolving ERP systems.


Desirable
•    Strong leadership and people management skills.
•    Excellent analytical and problem-solving abilities.
•    High level of accuracy and attention to detail.
•    Strong organisational and project management skills.
•    Excellent written and verbal communication skills.
•    Driven by process improvement and open to technological advancement and automation.
•    Ability to build effective relationships with cross-functional colleagues, auditor and banking partners.
•    Fluent in English. Comfortable working in French language environment with with excellent written and verbal communication skills.
•    Advanced proficiency in Microsoft Excel and financial reporting systems.


Key Success Measures
•    Timely and accurate financial reporting.
•    Effective leadership and development of the accounting team.
•    Strong and well-documented internal control environment.
•    Successful completion of annual audits with minimal findings.
•    Effective cash flow and treasury management.
•    High-quality reporting and support provided to Executive Management.
•    Continuous improvement of finance processes, governance and operational efficiency.


Why Join Us
Be part of the International Skating Union and make a direct impact on global skating events. Work closely with senior leadership in a dynamic, international environment where your financial and strategic expertise shapes key organizational decisions.


What We Offer
•    A unique opportunity to contribute to the financial planning and strategic coordination of a global sports federation.
•    Exposure to senior leadership and organizational decision-making.
•    A dynamic and international working environment in Lausanne.
•    The chance to support the development of global skating events and initiatives.


How to Apply

If you are eager to contribute to the ISU’s strategic projects and enhance your experience in global sports leadership, we would love to hear from you.

Please submit your CV to jobs@isu.org with the subject line:
Head of Accounting and Controlling – [Your Name]

Former athletes and skaters are strongly encouraged to apply, as their unique experiences are highly valued.

jobs.title: HR Generalist, EMEA
jobs.description:
HR Generalist, EMEA  
vVARDIS is a Swiss\-based oral health company founded by Dr. Haleh and Dr. Golnar Abivardi, dentists, innovators, and award\-winning entrepreneurs. vVARDIS is the result of a combined 30 years of dental and entrepreneurial experience, and 20 years of laboratory and clinical research paired with the creative vision of its founders.  
At vVARDIS, we are committed to delivering innovative solutions that enhance oral health and well\-being, inspired by the vision of our founders to foster preventive rather than reparative dentistry. At the heart of our Company lies its patented, revolutionary biomimetic peptide technology. Scientifically proven in over 200 publications, this unique technology can treat early caries through enamel regeneration, like no other technology can do, offering a non\-invasive, pain\-free solution for patients of all ages. We offer a number of oral health products targeting dental professionals and their patients, as well as consumers, all based on our proprietary technology.  
We value our people and believe in fostering a positive and collaborative work environment, based on our core values of innovation, excellence, integrity, and empathy.  
We are located in Zug, Switzerland, with operations across Europe and the US. Join us on this exciting journey!  
Position Overview  
We are seeking a hands\-on HR Generalist to support the Director Human Resources in the day\-to\-day HR operations across our EMEA markets, starting with Switzerland, the UK, and Italy, and expanding as the company grows. This is a generalist role suited to someone who builds and improves processes rather than simply administering them — you'd rather fix a broken process than complain about it. You're comfortable holding direct, constructive conversations with managers when needed, while remaining approachable and collaborative.  
The role also includes acting as payroll deputy for the UK, Switzerland, and Italy, ensuring continuity when the primary contact for our external payroll providers is unavailable. The role reports directly to the Director, Human Resources, with close day\-to\-day collaboration on HR and payroll matters. We work mostly from the office — 60% a week on site, 40% remote.  
Key Responsibilities  
Payroll Deputy — UK, Switzerland \& Italy: Act as back\-up for payroll processing across the three countries, maintaining accurate documentation and liaising with external payroll providers and authorities as required.  
HR Operations \& Process Building: Build and continuously improve core HR processes (onboarding, leave, records, policies) and maintain accurate, compliant personnel records across our EMEA locations. Some of this still needs to be built from the ground up — you're comfortable turning a blank page into a working process.  
Employee Relations \& Manager Support: Serve as the primary point of contact for employees and managers on HR matters, mediate disputes and handle grievances fairly, and promote a respectful, open workplace culture.  
Talent Acquisition \& Recruitment: Manage end\-to\-end recruitment — job postings, sourcing, interviewing, offers, and onboarding — in close collaboration with hiring managers.  
Performance Management: Run a simple, effective performance review process and coach managers on delivering direct, fair feedback.  
Compensation \& Benefits: Support payroll processing with our external providers and administer employee benefits across EMEA, helping define pay structures that are fair, competitive, and easy to administer.  
Compliance \& HR Best Practices: Ensure compliance with employment law across the UK, Switzerland, Italy, and other EMEA markets, escalating regulatory changes and labor law challenges to external counsel where needed.  
Training \& Development: Organize onboarding and practical, ongoing learning support for employee development.  
Qualifications \& Skills  
Degree in Human Resources, Business Administration, or equivalent practical experience.  
3–5 years in an HR generalist or HR Manager role, ideally within a scale\-up or fast\-growing organization.  
Practical knowledge of payroll and employment law fundamentals in at least one of the UK, Switzerland, or Italy — you don't need to be a lawyer or payroll specialist, but you know when to bring one in.  
Proven ability to build and improve HR processes from the ground up.  
A clear, calm communicator who remains professional and approachable, including in demanding situations.  
Fluent in English and German and/or Italian an advantage given our presence in Switzerland and Italy.  
Proficient with HR/payroll software and HRIS tools.  
vVARDIS is an equal opportunities employer and welcomes applications from all suitably qualified persons.  
Join vVARDIS: If this role is not suitable to your experience or career goals but you wish to stay connected to learn more about vVARDIS and our career opportunities, join the vVARDIS Network on LinkedIn: /  
If you don't hear from us, please know that we highly value your interest in vVARDIS and encourage you to stay connected for future opportunities. jpid26d0925jm jit0833jm jiy26jm

jobs.title: DevOps Engineer
jobs.description:
DevOps Engineer (a) (80 – 100%)  
HRM Systems AG mit Sitz in Winterthur ist ein erfolgreiches Familienunternehmen mit 160 Mitarbeitenden und langer Firmengeschichte. Grossunternehmen und Unternehmensgruppen werden bei der Abwicklung von HR\-Prozessen und im betrieblichen Gesundheitsmanagement durch die im Hause entwickelten Softwarelösungen und Dienstleistungen unterstützt. Als Marktleader in ihrem Bereich steht das Unternehmen auf stabilen und finanziell gesunden Beinen. Dies ermöglicht die gezielte Investition in die wegweisende Weiterentwicklung ihrer Produkte. Auf dich warten flexible Arbeitszeitmodelle, grosszügige Home\-Office\-Regelungen, sehr gute Sozialleistungen sowie moderne Arbeitsbedingungen. Mit der spürbar gelebten Wertekultur «Gemeinsam», «Mutig», «Begeistert» und «Respektvoll» bietet man dir ein attraktives Umfeld.  
Die IT von HRM Systems entwickelt sich stetig weiter. Komplexe Produkte, gewachsene Infrastrukturen und moderne SaaS\-Architekturen bringen spannende technische Herausforderungen mit sich. Um den Bereich DevOps über alle Produkte hinweg gezielt zu stärken, wird ein neues, kleines DevOps\-Team aufgebaut. Dieses Team bildet künftig die Brücke zwischen dem Produktbereich, interner Infrastruktur, Betriebsinfrastruktur und dem Entwicklungsbereich. Damit entsteht eine vielseitige Rolle mit Gestaltungsspielraum und technischer Verantwortung. Im Rahmen eines Exklusivmandats suchen wir eine:n erfahrene:n DevOps Engineer.  
Deine Herausforderung  
Du unterstützt übergreifend die Produktentwicklungsteams rund um die drei Produkte UKA Solutions, CAREMA und UKA Connect bei DevOps\-Themen und betreust die bestehende Infrastruktur.  
Du stellst den stabilen Betrieb von Produktions\- und Entwicklungsumgebungen auf Infrastruktur\-Ebene sicher.  
Du analysierst und behebst Störungen in enger Zusammenarbeit mit den Entwicklungsteams, IT\-Services und dem externen Infrastruktur\-Provider.  
Du optimierst die Automatisierung rund um Builds, Deployments, Testing, Monitoring und Alerting.

jobs.title: Senior Researcher & Lecturer Midwifery and Reproductive Health 80-100%
jobs.description:
Senior Researcher \& Lecturer Midwifery and Reproductive Health 80\-100%  
Combine research and teaching at MSc level, and actively shape the future of midwifery science. In this role, you will strengthen evidence\-based care, promote knowledge transfer and contribute to the further development of a young academic profession.  
Senior Researcher \& Lecturer Midwifery and Reproductive Health 80\-100%  
School:  
School of Health Professions  
Starting date:  
Immediately or by arrangement  
Your role  
In this role you will:  
Design, secure funding for, coordinate, contribute to and lead research and development projects in midwifery and sexual and reproductive health. You will liaise closely with the head of the research unit, take responsibility for project budgets and lead project teams.  
Help shape the strategic development of the research \& development unit and strengthen the internal and external knowledge transfer as well as the national and international visibility of the institute. This will be reflected in your interdisciplinary collaboration, scientific publications, conference presentations and accessible science communication.  
Take responsibility for modules within the MSc Midwifery programme. You will design, plan, deliver, evaluate and ensure the quality of profession\-specific and interprofessional modules. To that end, you will develop scientifically sound module objectives, teaching content, didactic formats and assessment methods at EQF level 7\.  
Teach classes in the MSc Midwifery programme and, where required, in the BSc Midwifery. You will systematically integrate the latest research findings, blended learning, e\-learning and the considered use of artificial intelligence into your teaching and learning environments.  
Provide expert guidance to students on their master's theses, develope and evaluate assessments, and conduct resit examinations in accordance with the applicable quality and AI guidelines.  
Support the programme director in the strategic, organisational, curricular and didactic development of the MSc Midwifery programme. You will contribute to the further development of module curricula, quality assurance and AI integration, and actively represent the programme within the professional community.  
Your profile  
You hold a PhD in midwifery, psychology, health sciences, social sciences or a related field. Your scientific expertise focuses on midwifery care and/or sexual and reproductive health.  
You have successfully developed, secured funding for, conducted and led research projects, and are experienced in project planning, coordination and implementation.  
You have proven expertise in quantitative research methods and confidently apply health or social science methods, with nuance and a strong commitment to quality.  
You have experience in higher education teaching, ideally at master's level, and have completed a continuing education qualification in higher education didactics or a comparable qualification.  
The following would be advantageous:  
A recognised midwifery qualification as well as a sound understanding of the field's professional practice and current challenges facing the profession.  
Several years of professional experience as a midwife or other relevant professional experience outside the higher education sector.  
Enthusiasm for creatively developing and implementing innovative research projects, teaching formats and sustainable solutions.  
Experience in inter\- and transdisciplinary collaboration, as well as the willingness to productively combine different profession\-specific and practice\-based perspectives.  
This is what we stand for  
Zurich University of Applied Sciences ZHAW is one of Switzerland's largest multidisciplinary universities of applied sciences, with over 14'000 students and 3'400 faculty and staff.  
The ZHAW School of Health Sciences is one of the largest and most renowned centres for education and continuing professional development for health professions in the German\-speaking countries. More than 2,000 students and 300 employees benefit from unique degree and continuing education programmes as well as attractive job opportunities in teaching and research in the heart of Winterthur (Canton of Zurich).  
The Midwifery Research Unit promotes quality in obstetrics and midwifery through applied research and development projects by focusing on the best possible care for women, children and families during pregnancy and childbirth, the postpartum period and breastfeeding. We train midwives as well as the next generation of researchers, and develop innovative, sustainable solutions to ensure the delivery of high\-quality, patient\-centered and evidence\-based care by midwives and interprofessional teams. Another focus area is the promotion of sexual and reproductive health among the population.  
ZHAW is committed to gender\-mixed and diverse teams in order to promote equality, diversity and innovation.  
What you can expect  
We offer working conditions and terms of employment commensurate with higher education institutions and actively promote personal development for staff in leadership and non\-leadership positions. jobs.description:
BOKU
UNI... 1 Postgraduate Research Associate
project employment
(Reference code 151)


Extent of employment: 30 hours per week
Duration of employment: 1st of October 2026, limited to 30th of September 2030
Workplace: 1190 Vienna
Allocation in compliance with the Collective Agreement for University Staff to job group:
B1
Gross monthly salary: (depending on previous eligible experience) at least: € 3.776,10
(payable 14 times per year)


PhD Position in Forest Regeneration and Nutrient Dynamics
Tree regeneration success is a key determinant of forest resilience and long-term ecosystem
stability. While light availability has been widely studied as a driver of regeneration dynamics,
the role of the forest floor as a regulator of nutrient supply to seedlings has received far less
attention. The Forest floor is the interface between the above- and below-ground parts of forest
ecosystems. It serves as a seedbed and rooting zone for vegetation, and acts as a hub of the
ecosystem where organic matter, nutrients and water are stored, absorbed, and transformed.
In the context of climate change, the Forest floor and its associated ecosystem services appear
as particularly at risk. As part of the research group "Humus layer: Function, dynamics and
vulnerability in transition" (https://gepris.dfg.de/project/457330647), the goal of our project is
to investigate how forest floor characteristics, root and mycorrhizal connectivity to mature
trees, and drought jointly regulate nutrient availability and regeneration performance. For more
information, please contact: emilie.fleurot@boku.ac.at.


Responsibilities
º Conducting lab work (measurement of soil and leaf nutrient concentration,
measurement of 15N concentration, ...)
º Conducting 2 weeks of field work per year in Germany (collecting leaf and soil
samples, measuring the condition and height of the plants)

Our Center for Innovation Systems & Policy is a think tank in national and international research and innovation networks, and it is a key pa... 1 Master Thesis "Meta Learning in Nonlineary Dynamic System Modelling"  * The focus of this master's thesis is the investigation of meta learning techniques for fast model adaptation in low-data scenarios. This is especially relevant for reducing end of line commission times for high-mix low-volume systems.
* You will support us in the field of data-driven modeling and identification of nonlinear dynamical systems.

jobs.description:
Tööülesanded: Rolli kirjeldus:
Toateenindaja vastutab külalistubade, heaolualade ja ühiskasutatavate ruumide puhtuse, korra ja esindusliku välimuse tagamise eest kõrgel tasemel. See roll toetab üldist külaliskogemust, tagades, et kõik retriidi alad on puhtad, hügieenilised ning järjepidevalt esitatud vastavalt kehtivatele tööstandarditele ja protseduuridele. Peamised tööülesanded: Külalistoad • Valmistada ette, koristada ja hooldada külalistube vastavalt standardtööjuhenditele (SOP) ning töötervishoiu ja -ohutuse (OHS&E) nõuetele. • Austada külaliste privaatsust ning käsitleda isiklikke esemeid hoolikalt. • Teavitada hooldusmeeskonda viivitamatult ilmnenud probleemidest. • Teavitada muudest probleemidest majapidamisjuhti või majapidamise vahetusevanemat. Heaolualad ja ühiskasutatavad ruumid • Koristada ja hooldada heaoluruume, hoolitsustube, termilisi alasid ning ühiskasutatavaid ruume kogu päeva vältel. •Tagada, et kõik alad on hügieenilised, korras ja külalistele ohutud, teavitades hooldusvajadusest vastavalt vajadusele. • Seada ja taastada ruumid vastavalt päevakavale ja tööprotseduuridele. Pesumajandus ja voodipesu • Koguda, sorteerida ja töödelda pesu vastavalt kehtestatud protseduuridele. • Tagada voodipesu käsitlemine vastavalt majapidamise standardtööjuhenditele. Tervis, ohutus ja hügieen • Järgida kõiki töötervishoiu- ja ohutusnõudeid, sealhulgas puhastusvahendite ja -seadmete korrektset kasutamist. • Teavitada viivitamata hooldusprobleemidest, ohuteguritest või puudustest. • Hoida majapidamiskäru ja laoruumid puhtad ning korrastatud. Suhtlus ja meeskonnatöö • Suhelda tõhusalt majapidamisjuhi, majapidamise vahetusevanema ning laiema meeskonnaga. • Edastada täpselt teave tehtud tööde, pooleliolevate ülesannete ja külaliste soovide kohta. • Teha koostööd kolleegidega, et tagada sujuv igapäevane töökorraldus. • Säilitada alati professionaalne ja lugupidav käitumisviis.

Omalt poolt pakume: Meie inimkultuur
EHA pakub läbimõeldud ja kõrgetasemelist töökeskkonda, mis põhineb autentsusel, hoolivusel ja isiklikul vastutusel. Väärtustame koosloomist ja vastutuse võtmist ning julgustame iga meeskonnaliiget töötama oma tugevuste ja loomuliku andekuse tsoonis. Sind toetatakse järjepideva professionaalse arengu ja koolitustega, mis panustavad sinu pikaajalisse karjääriteekonda. Töötad koos meeskonnaga, kes on pühendunud taastavale külalislahkusele – kontseptsioonile, mis on üles ehitatud teadlikkuse ja vastastikuse austuse põhimõttel seestpoolt väljapoole. Tasu ja hüved Pakume konkurentsivõimelist töötasu ja hüvesid, toetavaid töötingimusi ning meeskonnakultuuri, kus sinu panust siiralt hinnatakse. See ametikoht sobib inimesele, kes tunneb end hästi külalistele suunatud meeskonnatöös, on motiveeritud pidevast arengust ning väärtustab kuulumist meeskonda, mis on pühendunud järjepidevale täiustamisele.

Muud nõuded: Kogemus ja nõuded
Kirjalik ja suuline inglise keele oskus. Palume arvestada, et kuigi tehakse mõistlikke kohandusi, toimub kohapealne meeskonnasisene suhtlus inglise keeles. Võime töötada kõrgete puhtus- ja hügieenistandardite järgi. Hea ajaplaneerimis- ja organiseerimisoskus. Täpsus ja järjepidevus. Võime töötada iseseisvalt ning meeskonna osana. Professionaalne välimus ja käitumine. Varasem kogemus toateenindajana hotellis, retriidis, spaas, majutus- või külalislahkuse valdkonnas või kõrgema taseme majutusasutuses. Tööalane kogemus puhastusseadmete ja professionaalsete puhastusvahenditega.

jobs.title: Experienced Quantitative Risk Officer
jobs.description:
Wat ga je doen?

Je neemt een centrale rol op in de kwantitatieve opvolging van krediet-, rente-, liquiditeits- en kapitaalrisico. Concreet:

  • Je ontwerpt en voert stresstesten uit voor krediet-, rente-, liquiditeits- en kapitaalrisico, voor businessplanning, ICAAP/ILAAP en ad‑hoc analyses.
  • Je beheert en ontwikkelt de stress testing tools en zorgt voor continue verbetering.
  • Je voert backtesting uit en onderhoudt rating-, PD- en LGD‑modellen voor IFRS 9 ECL, samen met de externe modelontwikkelaar.
  • Je ondersteunt interne modellering rond vervroegde terugbetaling (CPR) en deposito’s zonder contractuele vervaldag (NMD).
  • Je controleert rapporteringsvereisten en voert gedocumenteerde kwaliteitscontroles uit op interne en reglementaire risicorapporteringen.

Waarom jij graag zal werken bij Nagelmackers?

Nagelmackers is sinds 1747 een vertrouwde private bank, gebouwd op nabijheid en persoonlijk advies. Sinds 2025 maken we deel uit van CENORBANK Group, waardoor we onze lokale verankering combineren met internationale expertise en nieuwe ontwikkelingsmogelijkheden.
Je komt terecht in een warme, professionele omgeving waar menselijkheid, ondernemerschap en diversiteit centraal staan en waar jij echt meerwaarde kan creëren.

Ben je klaar om je expertise in te zetten, onze risicomodellen verder te versterken en een sleutelrol te spelen in het financiële risicobeheer van Nagelmackers? Solliciteer vandaag nog, we ontmoeten je graag.

 

Wie zoeken we?

Je bent een ervaren expert met een sterke kwantitatieve en analytische focus. Je brengt het volgende mee:

  • Je hebt minstens tien jaar ervaring in financiële risicomodellering, meting, stress testing en rapportering binnen een kredietinstelling.
  • Je beheerst modelleringstechnieken en werkt vlot met Excel, R, Python, Power BI en SQL.
  • Je kent het regelgevend kader rond retail kredietrisico, IRRBB/CSRBB, liquiditeitsrisico en kapitaalvereisten. Je bent ook vertrouwd met kredietrisicomodellering (hypotheken, investeringskredieten) en IFRS 9 ECL.
  • Je vat complexe analyses helder samen en communiceert duidelijk in het Nederlands en Frans, mondeling en schriftelijk.
  • Je werkt nauwkeurig en met een sterke focus op kwaliteit.
  • Je werkt graag samen met verschillende teams, maar ook autonoom.

jobs.title: Har du barnasinnet i behåll och vill göra verklig skillnad i någons vardag?
jobs.description:
Vi söker nu en personlig assistent till en charmig och aktiv kille i 30-årsåldern med Downs syndrom, bosatt i centrala Umeå. Det här är ett varmt, roligt och varierande uppdrag för dig som tycker om att vara delaktig, hitta på saker och bidra till en trygg och meningsfull vardag.

God Assistans bedriver personlig assistans för kunder över hela Sverige. Vi är ett företag med stort hjärta och hög kompetens som brinner för det vi gör och har lång erfarenhet inom assistans. Att värna om våra medarbetare och förenkla tillvaron för våra kunder är kärnan i vår verksamhet som kännetecknas av personligt bemötande, hög tillgänglighet och snabb service. Läs gärna mer om oss på vår hemsida:www.godassistans.se

Om uppdraget
Som personlig assistent blir du ett viktigt stöd i vardagen och får samtidigt vara med på många roliga aktiviteter. Vi söker dig som gärna har nära till skratt, är omtänksam, ansvarstagande och har hjärtat på rätt ställe. Du får gärna tycka om pyssel, teater, sång och musik, sällskapsspel, utomhusaktiviteter och bad.

Uppdraget passar dig som gillar när dagarna innehåller både aktivitet, struktur och gemenskap - och som trivs med att arbeta nära både kunden, anhöriga och kundens företrädare.

Arbetstid och omfattning
Arbetstiderna är förlagda måndag till fredag kl. 08.00-15.00, vilket motsvarar en tjänstgöringsgrad på 87,5 %. Du är ledig varje helg och röda dagar. Under sommaren får du fem veckors semester.

Vem söker vi?
Vi söker dig som är tjej eller kille och som kan tala och skriva god svenska. Du behöver vara trygg, lyhörd och ha lätt för att samarbeta. Eftersom vi ser långsiktigt på samarbetet hoppas vi att du vill bli en del av uppdraget under en längre tid.

Låter det här som ett jobb för dig?

Varmt välkommen med din ansökan redan idag. Vi håller intervjuer löpande och ser fram emot att höra från dig!

Kontaktperson: Ann-Marie Stolberg, ann-marie.stolberg@godassistans.se

Övrigt: God assistans månar om sina assistenter, har kollektivavtal och erbjuder friskvårdsbidrag på upp till 4000:- /år.

För att styrka din rätt att arbeta i Sverige behöver du kunna uppvisa svenskt pass/personbevis, uppehållskort (EU) eller uppehålls- och arbetstillstånd/LMA-kort (utanför EU).

jobs.title: Engasjert og inspirerende norsklærer for 1.–10. trinn
jobs.description:
Brenner du for norskfaget, språk, litteratur og gode læringsopplevelser? Discovery International School søker en engasjert norsklærer for elever på 1.–10. trinn som kan vekke lærelyst, språkglede og leselyst, samt utvikle gode skriveferdigheter og trygghet i muntlig og skriftlig kommunikasjon.

Hva vi ser etter

Vi ser etter en faglig sterk, trygg og engasjert lærer som ønsker å bidra aktivt til elevenes faglige, sosiale og personlige utvikling.

Vi ser etter deg som:

  • har godkjent lærerutdanning og undervisningskompetanse i norsk for 1.-10. trinn

  • fordel med kompetanse som allmennlærer eller engelsklærer

  • har svært gode norskkunnskaper, både muntlig og skriftlig

  • har sterk faglig trygghet innen norsk språk, litteratur, lesing og skriving

  • ønsker å skape engasjerende, variert og meningsfull norskundervisning som vekker nysgjerrighet og lærelyst

  • er trygg i klasseledelse og har tydelige, varme og forutsigbare rammer for elevenes læring og trivsel

  • evner å tilpasse undervisningen til elever med ulike faglige nivåer, behov og språkbakgrunner

  • arbeider selvstendig, tar ansvar, følger opp avtaler og bidrar aktivt til skolens felles arbeid

  • er fleksibel, løsningsorientert, kreativ og positiv til å jobbe i en skole i utvikling

  • har gode samarbeidsevner og kommuniserer godt med elever, foresatte og kolleger

  • ønsker å bidra aktivt til skolens videre utvikling av språkfag, tverrfaglig arbeid og IB-pedagogikk

Kompetanse i engelsk eller andre fag er en fordel. Erfaring med IB, internasjonal skole, flerspråklige elever eller prosjektbasert undervisning er også en fordel, men ikke et krav.

Godkjent politiattest må fremlegges før tiltredelse.

Arbeidsoppgaver

  • planlegge, gjennomføre og evaluere undervisning i norsk i tråd med skolens læreplan, IB-rammeverket og gjeldende læringsmål

  • undervise elever på tvers av 1.--10. trinn, inkludert i aldersblandede grupper der det er relevant

  • utvikle elevenes muntlige og skriftlige ferdigheter, leselyst, tekstforståelse og språkbevissthet

  • legge til rette for praktisk, utforskende, kreativ og engasjerende språkundervisning

  • skape et trygt, strukturert og inkluderende læringsmiljø der alle elever føler seg sett, ivaretatt og faglig utfordret

  • følge opp elevenes faglige, sosiale og personlige utvikling gjennom målsetting, vurdering og dokumentasjon

  • tilpasse undervisningen for elever med ulike behov, nivåer og språkbakgrunner, særlig der norsk eller engelsk er andrespråk

  • samarbeide tett med kolleger, IB-koordinator og skoleledelse om undervisningsplanlegging, tverrfaglig arbeid og skoleaktiviteter

  • kommunisere jevnlig og konstruktivt med foresatte om elevenes utvikling

  • følge skolens HMS-rutiner, ordensreglement og retningslinjer for elevenes psykososiale miljø

Vi tilbyr

Hos Discovery International School får du en meningsfull og spennende rolle i en liten internasjonal skole hvor du har tid til å se hver enkelt elev. Du får mulighet til å skape levende, kreativ og språkstimulerende undervisning og bli en viktig del av skolens videre utvikling.

Vi tilbyr:

  • et engasjert, flerkulturelt og profesjonelt læringsmiljø

  • en skolehverdag der relasjoner, samarbeid og elevutvikling står sentralt

  • stor grad av faglig tillit og rom for kreativ og variert undervisning

  • mulighet til å videreutvikle en skole i vekst

  • erfaring med og opplæring innen IB-pedagogikk

  • samarbeid, profesjonell dialog og tverrfaglig arbeid

  • en skolekultur preget av refleksjon, utvikling, elevfokus og skaperglede

  • konkurransedyktige betingelser etter avtale

Om arbeidsgiveren:

Discovery International School er en internasjonal grunnskole for 1-10. trinn, lokalisert i Ringerike. Vi er en IB-kandidatskole og arbeider innenfor IB-rammeverket.

Vi er en skole med et sterkt fokus på elevenes helhetlige utvikling, faglig, sosialt og personlig, i et trygt og inkluderende læringsmiljø. Undervisningen er elevsentrert og tverrfaglig med høye forventninger til både trivsel og læring.

Skolen har en struktur som skiller seg positivt ut. Alle elever har musikk og kroppsøving hver dag, samt koding og designteknologi som en del av undervisningstilbudet. Dette gir en variert og balansert skolehverdag som støtter konsentrasjon, kreativitet og praktisk ferdighetsutvikling.

Discovery International School legger stor vekt på stabilitet, samarbeid og langsiktighet. Vi ønsker å være en trygg og forutsigbar arbeidsplass for lærere som ønsker å bidra til elevenes utvikling og være en del av et profesjonelt og engasjert skolemiljø over tid.

jobs.title: Développeur / Expert Keycloak & Java (IAM & MFA) (H/F)
jobs.description:
Au sein de l'équipe Sécurité & Identité (IAM / CIAM), vous serez responsable de la conception, de la personnalisation et de l'intégration de la solution d'authentification et de gestion des accès Keycloak. Vous interviendrez notamment sur l'implémentation de parcours d'authentification sécurisés (MFA) et le développement de modules Java sur mesure.

Missions Principales
- Développement & Personnalisation Keycloak : Développement de SPI (Service Provider Interfaces), d'authentificateurs personnalisés, d'évènements et d'extensions en Java / Jakarta EE.
- Authentification & MFA : Configuration, personnalisation et intégration de flux d'authentification forte (MFA, WebAuthn, TOTP, SMS, OTP) et gestion des politiques de sécurité.
- Intégration IAM / CIAM : Configuration des Realms, des clients (OpenID Connect / OAuth2, SAML v2) et fédération d'identités (LDAP, Active Directory, Identity Providers externes).
- Personnalisation UI/UX : Adaptation des thèmes de connexion et du parcours utilisateur (Freemarker, HTML/CSS, JavaScript).

MCO :
- Maintien en condition opérationnelle
- Montées de version Keycloak
- Écriture de tests et intégration dans les pipelines CI/CD (Docker, Kubernetes/Helm).

Compétences techniques obligatoires :
Java 11+ / Jakarta EE : Développement d'extensions / SPI pour Keycloak.
Keycloak (Core) : Maîtrise des concepts d'Authentication Flows, Execution Steps, SPI (Authenticator, EventListenerProvider, UserStorageProvider).
Sécurité & MFA : Implémentation du MFA (TOTP, WebAuthn, OTP personnalisés).

Les plus appréciés : Docker, Kubernetes, Helm, Operator, Quarkus.

jobs.title: 1st Level Support (m/w/d)
jobs.description:
Wenn im Restaurant das Terminal streikt, steht der Gast schon in der Schlange. Genau dann meldet sich jemand bei uns.

SO'USE ist eine Plattform für digitales Bestellen und Bezahlen in der Gastronomie. Gäste scannen einen QR-Code oder tippen am Self-Order-Terminal, bestellen selbst und zahlen direkt – die Bestellung landet ohne Umweg in der Kasse und auf dem Küchendisplay. Dazu kommen Webshop, Tablet-Bestellung und die Anbindung von Lieferdiensten wie Lieferando, Wolt und Uber Eats. Über 1.500 Betriebe arbeiten damit täglich: vom Foodtruck über Bäckereiketten bis zu HANS IM GLÜCK.

Das heißt auch: Unsere Software läuft im laufenden Mittagsgeschäft. Der 1st Level Support ist die erste Stimme, die Gastronominnen und Gastronomen hören, wenn etwas hakt – und meistens auch die, die das Problem löst.

Aufgaben

  • Du bearbeitest die Anliegen unserer Kunden über unser Ticketsystem, überwiegend schriftlich und teilweise per Telefon.
  • Du arbeitest eng mit dem Account Management zusammen, entlastest das Team im Tagesgeschäft und sorgst dafür, dass Kunden schnell eine Antwort bekommen statt einer Warteschleife.
  • Bei kniffligen Fällen entscheidest du, ob es an den 2nd Level Support geht, und koordinierst die Weitergabe bis zur Lösung.
  • Nach dem Onboarding hörst du nicht auf zu lernen: Du gräbst dich weiter in die Funktionen unseres Systems ein, damit du beim nächsten Mal schon weißt, woran es liegt.
  • Du übernimmst Bereitschaftszeiten: Gastronomie läuft abends und am Wochenende, deshalb werden wichtige Tickets und Anrufe auch außerhalb der regulären Arbeitszeit bearbeitet. Diese Zeiten vergüten wir zusätzlich, und wie oft und in welchem Rhythmus du sie übernimmst, legen wir gemeinsam fest.

Qualifikation

  • Gastro-Background. Du hast selbst im Service, in der Küche oder in Gastronomienahen Tech-Unternehmen gearbeitet und weißt, wie sich ein voller Laden anfühlt. Das ist uns wichtig – unsere Kunden merken sofort, ob jemand ihren Alltag kennt.
  • Klare Sprache, schriftlich wie am Telefon. Du erklärst technische Dinge so, dass sie zwischen zwei Bestellungen verständlich sind.
  • Technische Affinität. Du hast keine Angst vor Systemeinstellungen, Schnittstellen oder einem Blick in den Quelltext einer Website – und du nutzt KI-Tools bereits selbstverständlich, um schneller zu Antworten zu kommen.
  • Schnelle Auffassungsgabe. Neue Prozesse und Produktdetails sind für dich kein Hindernis, sondern der interessante Teil.

Berufserfahrung im Support ist ein Plus, aber kein Muss. Wenn du aus der Gastronomie kommst und Lust auf die technische Seite hast, bring dich ins Gespräch.

Benefits

  • 45.000 bis 50.000 Euro Jahresgehalt, je nach Erfahrung, plus Bonussystem. Bereitschaftszeiten vergüten wir zusätzlich.
  • Perspektive über den Support hinaus. Wer bei uns die Kunden und das Produkt kennt, ist die beste Besetzung für Key Account Management, Kunden-Onboarding oder Customer Success. Diese Wege stehen dir offen – wir sind sie intern schon mehrfach gegangen.
  • Arbeitsplatz in Leipzigs Mitte oder remote. Wir sitzen gern zusammen im Büro, aber wenn du von woanders arbeitest, funktioniert das genauso.
  • Flexible Arbeitszeiten, flache Hierarchien und echten Gestaltungsspielraum in einem Bereich, der sich schnell entwickelt.
  • Ein Team, das dich weiterbringt: entspannter Umgang, regelmäßiges Feedback und Workshops statt Jahresgespräch.

Klingt das nach dir?

Dann schreib uns – ein kurzes Motivationsschreiben und dein Lebenslauf reichen völlig aus. Erzähl uns dabei gern, aus welchem Laden du kommst.

Du möchtest vorher mehr über uns wissen? Schau auf unserer Website vorbei oder folge uns auf Instagram (@souse_germany) und LinkedIn (SO'USE).

jobs.title: Senior Platform Engineer (m/f/d)
Daglig leder
jobs.description:
To restauranter. Ett hus. En ambisjon om å skape en ny restaurantdestinasjon i Bergen.

I hjertet av Bergen åpner vi et nytt restauranthus i Castbergkvartalet, med to forskjellige restaurantkonsepter under samme tak:

ELIO – Mediterranean Kitchen & Bar

En levende og sosial middelhavsrestaurant med gode råvarer, sharing, cocktails, vin og høy energi.

PYRO – Wood Fire & Charcoal Grill Restaurant

En restaurant med et høyere gastronomisk ambisjonsnivå, hvor åpen ild, kullgrill, førsteklasses råvarer og vin står sentralt.

Nå søker vi daglig leder for hele restauranthuset.

Vi ser etter en erfaren, operativ og kommersiell leder som ønsker å være med fra starten – og som har en genuin passion for hospitality, mat, vin og mennesker.

Dette er en mulighet til å være med på å bygge en helt ny restaurantvirksomhet i Bergen, fra organisasjon og kultur til gjesteopplevelse, drift og resultater.

OM RESTAURANTENE

ELIO – Mediterranean Kitchen & Bar

ELIO blir den levende og sosiale restauranten i huset.

En moderne middelhavsrestaurant bygget rundt gode råvarer, sharing, energi og vertskap, med en sterk bar som en naturlig del av restaurantopplevelsen.

Maten henter inspirasjon fra Middelhavet og Sør-Europa, med fisk og sjømat, kjøtt, grønnsaker og retter laget for å deles. Cocktails og vin skal ha en sentral plass.

ELIO skal være et sted gjestene ønsker å bruke ofte – til lunsj, middag, cocktails og sosiale anledninger.

Ambisjonen er å skape en restaurant med høy energi, sterk lokal tilhørighet og en atmosfære som utvikler seg gjennom dagen og kvelden. Konseptet er utviklet med sharing, en sterk bar og et ambisiøst cocktail- og vinprogram som sentrale elementer.

PYRO – Wood Fire & Charcoal Grill Restaurant

I PYRO står ilden, kullgrillen og råvaren i sentrum.

Restauranten får et høyere gastronomisk ambisjonsnivå, med førsteklasses kjøtt, fisk, sjømat og sesongens grønnsaker tilberedt over ild og kull.

Et sterkt vinprogram, høy produktkvalitet og personlig vertskap skal være sentrale deler av opplevelsen.

PYRO skal være raffinert, men ikke formell – en varm og levende restaurant som gjestene velger når de ønsker en restaurantopplevelse på et høyere nivå. Konseptgrunnlaget legger nettopp vekt på kullgrill, åpent kjøkken, premium råvarer, sterkt vinfokus og høyere servicenivå.

ROLLEN

Som daglig leder får du det overordnede operative, økonomiske og personalmessige ansvaret for hele restauranthuset og driften av ELIO og PYRO.

Jobben starter før første gjest kommer gjennom døren.

Sammen med eiere og øvrige nøkkelpersoner skal du være med på å bygge organisasjonen, rekruttere de rette menneskene, etablere struktur og rutiner og – ikke minst – skape kulturen restaurantene skal bygges på.

Når dørene åpner, skal du lede og videreutvikle virksomheten med tydelige mål for kvalitet, gjesteopplevelse, arbeidsmiljø og lønnsomhet.

Du blir en synlig og operativ leder, men skal samtidig kunne løfte blikket og arbeide kommersielt og strategisk med utviklingen av virksomheten.

DITT ANSVAR

Du får blant annet ansvar for:

  • Overordnet daglig drift av ELIO og PYRO

  • Oppbygging av organisasjonen frem mot åpning

  • Rekruttering, ledelse og utvikling av lederteam og medarbeidere

  • Bemanningsplanlegging og effektiv ressursbruk

  • Budsjett- og resultatansvar

  • Aktiv oppfølging av omsetning, lønnskostnader, timeforbruk, varekost og produktivitet

  • Service, vertskap og den samlede gjesteopplevelsen

  • Restaurant- og bardrift

  • Utvikling av en sterk salgs- og servicekultur

  • Reservasjoner, kapasitet, arrangementer og selskaper

  • Lager, varekontroll og svinn

  • HMS, internkontroll og skjenkerutiner

  • Oppfølging og utvikling av rutiner og standarder

  • Rapportering av resultater og nøkkeltall

  • Kontinuerlig kommersiell utvikling av restaurantene

Du skal forstå hvorfor tallene utvikler seg som de gjør, og bruke denne kunnskapen aktivt til å planlegge og forbedre driften.

Samtidig skal du aldri miste det viktigste av syne: gjesten og menneskene som skaper opplevelsen.

HVEM SER VI ETTER?

Vi ser etter en person som ønsker å bygge og lede et restauranthus fra starten, og som har en genuin passion for hospitality, mat, vin og mennesker.

Du har solid ledererfaring fra restaurant- og hospitalitybransjen og må ha erfaring fra HoReCa-scenen i Bergen.

Du kjenner det lokale markedet, forstår gjestene og konkurransebildet og har et relevant nettverk innen restaurant, uteliv og hospitality i Bergen.

Du er en naturlig vert og leder som trives med mennesker.

Du forstår at sterke resultater skapes gjennom gode team, fornøyde gjester, tydelig ledelse og en kultur hvor kvalitet og vertskap står sentralt.

Samtidig har du den økonomiske og kommersielle forståelsen som kreves for å drive og utvikle en betydelig restaurantvirksomhet.

Vi ser etter deg som har:

  • Genuin passion for hospitality, mat, vin og mennesker

  • Solid leder- og personalerfaring fra HoReCa

  • Erfaring fra HoReCa-scenen i Bergen

  • Relevant lokalt nettverk innen restaurant, uteliv og hospitality

  • Erfaring med budsjett- og resultatansvar

  • Sterk kommersiell og økonomisk forståelse

  • Erfaring med rekruttering og utvikling av medarbeidere og ledere

  • God forståelse for bemanning, produktivitet og kostnadskontroll

  • Høy forståelse for service, vertskap og gjesteopplevelse

  • Evne til å bygge kultur, struktur og sterke team

  • Flytende muntlig og skriftlig i minimum ett nordisk språk

  • Gode engelskkunnskaper

Erfaring med etablering, åpning eller utvikling av nye restaurantkonsepter er en klar fordel.

HVORDAN VI ØNSKER AT DU LEDER

Vi ser etter en leder som er til stede.

Du skal kjenne menneskene du leder, forstå hva som skjer i restaurantene og være synlig når det gjelder.

Du skal kunne stå midt i driften på en travel kveld, lese restauranten og støtte teamet – og samtidig kunne analysere resultatene dagen etter og forstå hvorfor omsetning, timeforbruk, varekost eller gjennomsnittlig spend utviklet seg som det gjorde.

Du setter tydelige forventninger, følger opp og utvikler menneskene rundt deg.

Du bygger ledere og skaper en organisasjon hvor dyktige mennesker ønsker å prestere, utvikle seg og bli værende.

VÆR MED FRA STARTEN

Dette er en mulighet til å komme inn før åpning og få reell påvirkning på hvordan to nye restauranter skal bygges opp, organiseres og drives.

Du kommer ikke inn for å forvalte en ferdig virksomhet.

Du kommer inn for å være med på å skape den.

Målet er å utvikle ELIO og PYRO til to av Bergens mest attraktive restauranter, med hver sin posisjon i markedet.

ELIO skal bli den levende middelhavsrestauranten gjestene ønsker å bruke ofte.

PYRO skal bli restauranten man velger når ild, kullgrill, sterke råvarer, vin og en restaurantopplevelse på et høyere nivå står i sentrum.

Sammen skal restaurantene bidra til å gjøre Castbergkvartalet til en ny restaurantdestinasjon i Bergen.

Vi søker daglig leder som ønsker å være med på å gjøre denne ambisjonen til virkelighet – gjennom sterke mennesker, godt vertskap, konsekvent kvalitet og gode kommersielle resultater.

Stilling: Daglig leder – ELIO & PYRO
Arbeidssted: Castbergkvartalet, Bergen
Omfang: 100 %
Oppstart: Etter avtale / i god tid før åpning
Rapporterer til: Eier/styre
Betingelser: Konkurransedyktige betingelser etter avtale

VIL DU VÆRE MED?

Send oss CV og en kort presentasjon av deg selv, din ledererfaring og hvorfor du ønsker å være med på å bygge opp ELIO og PYRO i Castbergkvartalet.

Vi gleder oss til å høre fra deg.

Om arbeidsgiveren:

Dilla Holding AS er et holdingselskap som eies og drives av brødrene Daljinder, Kawal og Jas Kahlon. Selskapet ble stiftet i 1995, og driver hovedsakelig med restaurantvirksomhet.

Med mange års erfaring i bransjen driver vi nå restauranter og barer i Oslo, Fredrikstad og Bergen.
