jobs.title: Senior Software Engineer (Java) to Mycronic
jobs.description:
Mycronic is a global high-tech company whose innovative solutions have been advancing electronics technology for over 40 years. Today we continue to grow and serve customers in an expanding variety of industries. What we do impacts the future of technology, and in turn, the way we live our lives tomorrow. We’re looking for people to join our talented, motivated and friendly team on the cutting-edge. Here, in an open, collaborative and flexible environment, you’ll work alongside leading industry experts and take on challenging projects that bring tomorrow’s electronics to life. If you have several years of work experience within software development and embedded systems and wants to be part of a growing company with world leading products, this is for you!

About the role

Mycronic has experienced strong growth in recent years, both organically and through acquisitions. With headquarters in Sweden, Mycronic is a global organization with subsidiaries, agents, and distributors in over 50 countries. Mycronic is divided into four divisions, and in this role, you will belong to PCB Assembly Solutions (PA). PA is a leading provider of equipment and solutions for surface mount technology (SMT) to electronics manufacturers who require rapid production adjustments while maintaining high efficiency. PA delivers systems for circuit board assembly, including both complete line solutions and individual systems for specific process steps, as well as advanced software for assembly process management and connected factories. In this role, you will be part of a team of 7 team members and collaborate with several functions across the company, such as architects, project managers and other software teams within for example AI.

You are offered

    The opportunity to work in a multi-cultural company with knowledgeable, friendly and goal-oriented colleagues.
    To work in an exciting company in a growth phase, where you can make a real impact in a fun and dynamic environment. Mycronic is a global company, yet small enough for you to truly make a difference.
    The opportunity to work with world-leading products. The future of electronics production is increasingly complex. Denser boards, a wider range of miniaturized components, more NPIs and erratic production schedules. To address these challenges Mycronic has developed the industry’s fastest, most flexible and most precise jet printing and solder paste dispensing systems. Mycronic jet printing technology makes it possible to dispense solder paste for the most challenging circuit boards and components, with micrometer accuracy, maximum speed and perfect quality solder joints. Read more here: https://www.mycronic.com/product-areas/pcb-assembly/products/smt/jet-printing/.
    Mycronic has a large software organization which will provide you with optimal opportunities to develop your knowledge in various areas of computer science – such as software architecture for robotics, machine learning, AI, optimization, and computer vision.

Work tasks

You will work in a broad developer role where you will truly have the opportunity to influence the final solution of the products. The Mycronic Jet Printer, which is the product area you will be developing the software for, includes electronics, mechanics, and software, creating exciting opportunities for those who want to work with complex software development involving multiple technical disciplines. We are continuously working to enhance our products; user-friendliness, particularly in terms of automation and user interfaces, which will also be part of your development work. Your primary focus will be on improving the products, with opportunities to contribute your ideas and collaborate as a team to create the best solutions. This may involve anything from adding capability features and reducing energy consumption to updating the GUI. Mycronic has both R&D, lab, and production in-house, meaning you will work close to the products you develop, which also gives you the opportunity to see the "real world" results of your work.

We are looking for

This is a role for someone with a strong background in software development and an interest in understanding the entire product and an ambition to grow into a software architect role. As a software developer you will have a key role in the product development since this is where all the technology in the machine comes together to provide the system functionality that meets the user. You will be involved in everything from requirements gathering to design, architecture and development and collaborate with several stakeholders. As a person, we see it as particularly important that you are goal- and detail-oriented and have strong collaboration skills. You also have a will to contribute with your ideas, and just like your colleagues, you always strive to develop yourself and contribute to the team´s collective growth. We expect you to make a strong contribution by adding new functionality, maintaining high quality and by helping to introduce new technology and processes to increase team efficiency.

You likely have:

    A master´s degree within computer science, electronics, mechatronics or similar.
    Strong software development experience with the capability and ambition to take on broader architectural responsibilities in a few years.
    Strong knowledge in Java.
    Strong knowledge of software development in Linux.
    Experience of working with software systems that interact with embedded software and hardware.
    Strong knowledge in English and good knowledge in Swedish (or have the desire to learn)

It is considered advantageous if you have...

    Knowledge in C and/or C++

Other Information

    Start date: By agreement
    Employment type: Permanent
    Scope: Full-time
    Location: Kista
    Contact Information: Senior Recruitment Consultant Johanna Sörell, johanna.sorell@academicwork.se
    The recruitment process is handled by Academic Work, and Mycronic requests that all questions regarding the process goes to Academic Work.

Our recruitment process

    Problem-solving and personality test
    Phone interview with Academic Work
    In-depth interview with Academic Work
    Interviews with Mycronic
    Reference check + decision

jobs.title: Camper Rental Station Manager - Oslo (Near Gardermoen Airport)
jobs.description:
Station Manager -- Oslo (Near Gardermoen Airport)

Arctic Campers AS is looking for an experienced, motivated, and hands-on Station Manager to take responsibility for the daily operation of our Oslo station, located close to Gardermoen Airport.

As Station Manager, you will be responsible for ensuring that customers receive an outstanding experience, employees have the support they need to succeed, and our fleet of camper vans is always prepared to the highest standard.

This is a leadership position for someone who enjoys taking responsibility, leading people by example, and being actively involved in the daily operation rather than managing only from an office.

The position is full-time and starts at the beginning of January.

Training

Before taking over responsibility for the Oslo station, you will complete a mandatory 2.5 month training program at our headquarters in Tromsø.

During this period you will learn every aspect of our operation, including:

  • Customer service and camper van handovers

  • Fleet preparation and quality control

  • Vehicle logistics

  • Camper van equipment and technical systems

  • Daily station management

  • Company procedures and operational standards

Accommodation during the training period in Tromsø will be provided by Arctic Campers.

Our working language is English, and you will become part of an international team consisting of colleagues from many different countries.

Educational and Skill Requirements

  • Previous leadership or management experience is an advantage

  • A minimum of 10 years of work experience in any profession is considered a strong advantage

  • Experience from tourism, vehicle rental, hospitality, logistics, automotive, or a similar industry is preferred

  • Experience leading and developing employees is an advantage

  • Interest in camper vans, tourism, and customer service

  • Basic technical understanding of vehicles or camper vans is an advantage

  • Valid Category B driver's licence (BE licence is an advantage)

  • Excellent English language skills (additional languages are an advantage)

  • Strong organizational and communication skills

  • Independent, structured, and solution-oriented working style

  • Positive attitude, honesty, reliability, and willingness to take responsibility

Main Responsibilities

  • Managing the daily operation of the Oslo station

  • Leading, motivating, and supporting the station team

  • Onboarding, training, and supervising permanent and seasonal employees

  • Participating in the daily operation alongside your team whenever required

  • Ensuring professional customer service and high-quality camper van handovers

  • Planning and coordinating daily staffing and operational activities

  • Maintaining an overview of the camper van fleet together with the Head of Operations and Fleet Manager

  • Coordinating vehicle movements between stations and workshops

  • Ensuring all camper vans meet Arctic Campers' quality standards before every rental

  • Monitoring and maintaining the station's technical equipment, tools, and facilities

  • Supporting troubleshooting of camper van equipment and coordinating repairs when necessary

  • Ensuring company procedures, safety standards, and operational routines are followed

  • Reporting operational performance, challenges, and improvement opportunities to management

  • Continuously improving station efficiency and customer satisfaction

  • Performing other operational and administrative tasks as required

Working Hours

This is a full-time permanent position.

Working hours are scheduled according to operational requirements and will include weekends and public holidays during the rental season.

Working Permit

Arctic Campers AS welcomes applications from both Norwegian residents and international candidates.

  • Norwegian citizens: No work permit is required.

  • EU/EEA citizens: We will assist with the necessary paperwork required to register and work legally in Norway.

  • Non-EU/EEA citizens: We do not sponsor work visas or residence permits. Applicants who require visa sponsorship are unfortunately not eligible for this position and should not apply.

Om arbeidsgiveren:

Arctic Campers AS is one of Norway's largest camper van rental companies, with stations in Tromsø and Oslo. Every year we welcome thousands of travellers from all over the world who choose our custom-built camper vans to explore Norway's spectacular landscapes.

We are a young, international company where teamwork, responsibility, and continuous improvement are highly valued. We believe that great customer experiences begin with great employees, and we are looking for a Station Manager who shares that mindset.

If you are looking for a challenging leadership position where no two days are the same, enjoy working with people, and want to be part of an ambitious and growing company, we would love to hear from you.

jobs.title: Veneasentaja / -huoltaja (Tampere)
jobs.description:
Etsimme vakituiseen työsuhteeseen veneenasentajaa / venehuoltajaa Tampereelle!

Tässä tehtävässä pääset työskentelemään monipuolisten veneiden ja niiden tekniikan parissa. Toivomme sinulta aiempaa kokemusta veneistä ja niiden mekaniikasta, mutta ennen kaikkea innostunutta ja tekemiseen tarttuvaa asennetta.

Venealan aiempi kokemus on plussaa tähä tehtävään, mutta tärkeintä on oikea asenne ja kiinnostus tekniikkaan. Venealan kokemuksen lisäksi tehtävään sopii erinomaisesti esimerkiksi autonasentajan taustalla oleva tekijä tai henkilö, jolla on kokemusta erilaisten moottorikäyttöisten laitteiden huoltamisesta ja korjaamisesta. Jos moottorit, mekaniikka ja käsillä tekeminen ovat sinun juttusi, tässä voisi olla seuraava työpaikkasi.

Mitä toivomme sinulta?

\- Kokemusta veneistä ja niiden mekaniikasta tai vahvaa mekaanista osaamista esimerkiksi autonasentajan tehtävistä

\- Kokemusta moottorikäyttöisten laitteiden huoltamisesta ja korjaamisesta

\- Oma-aloitteista ja reipasta työotetta

\- Joustavuutta ja halua oppia uutta

\- Kykyä työskennellä sekä itsenäisesti että osana tiimiä

Mitä tarjoamme?

\- Tarjoamme sinulle vakituinen työpaikan, jossa pääset osaksi tiivistä ja asiantuntevaa työporukkaa. Työaika on 37,5 h/vko.

\- Palkan kokemuksen ja osaamisen mukaan

\- Mahdollisuuden oppia venealasta lisää

Venealalla kevät ja kesä ovat kiireisintä sesonkia, jolloin tekemistä riittää vauhdilla. Syksyllä tahti hieman rauhoittuu, mutta hommaa ja tehtävää riittää ympäri vuoden. Talvikaudella työ painottuu muun muassa veneiden huoltoihin, korjauksiin, kunnostuksiin ja muihin hallin töihin.Työskentelet tiiviissä tiimissä, jossa ympärilläsi on todellisia venealan ammattilaisia. Tässä porukassa pääset kehittämään omaa osaamistasi ja kartuttamaan tietämystäsi veneistä, moottoreista ja niiden toiminnasta.

Osaavalle tekijälle on töitä tarjolla heti. Työsuhde alkaa Click Henkilöstöpalveluiden kautta, ja tavoitteena on vakituinen työsuhde.

jobs.title: Jurist inom Hälso- och sjukvårdsjuridik
jobs.description:
Karolinska Universitetssjukhuset är ett av världens främsta universitetssjukhus. Tillsammans med Karolinska Institutet utgör sjukhuset ett medicinskt centrum med högt internationellt anseende. Vi strävar mot att kunna mer imorgon än vad vi kan idag, både på vårt sjukhus och genom att utveckla och förmedla kunskap till andra. För att nå dit måste vi klara vårt uppdrag; att vara bäst på det svåra.

Du erbjuds

    att bli en del av en världsledande hälso- och sjukvårdsorganisation som ligger i framkant av medicinsk innovation och forskning
    att inom många rättsområden och framförallt inom hälso- och sjukvårdsjuridik och kommunal- och förvaltningsrätt utveckla det juridiska arbetet.

Självklart får du också ta del av våra generella förmåner som Karolinska Universitetssjukhuset erbjuder dig.

Om tjänsten

Karolinska Universitetssjukhuset är en av Europas ledande medicinska institutioner och är en central del av Region Stockholm med cirka 16 000 medarbetare. Vår Juristenhet tillsammans med vår Dataskyddsenhet består av tiotal medarbetare med viktiga stödfunktioner och specialistroller som tillsammans stöttar sjukhusets olika teman och funktioner.

Som jurist på Karolinska Universitetssjukhuset spelar du en avgörande roll i att leda och utveckla det juridiska stödet till sjukhusets medarbetare. Som jurist kommer du främst att arbeta med hälso- och sjukvårdsjuridik och kommunal- och förvaltningsrätt. Även frågor inom andra rättsområden kan vara aktuella, så som offentlighet- och sekretess, diskrimineringslagen och arkivfrågor.

Arbetet präglas av många kontaktytor inom Karolinska Universitetssjukhuset och hela Region Stockholm.

Tillsammans driver vi förbättringsarbete som bidrar till Karolinskas övergripande vision: "Vi ska bota och lindra imorgon det ingen kan bota och lindra idag."

Vi söker dig som

Du har en mycket god förmåga till avancerad rättslig analys och argumentation. Du är kreativ och har lätt för att bryta ner komplexa problem och sätta in frågor i ett större perspektiv. Som person är du lösningsorienterad, analytisk och kommunikativ med förmåga att skapa goda relationer. Du är dessutom ansvarsfull och självgående med stor integritet och förmåga att utifrån verksamhetens behov driva och följa upp det juridiska arbetet. Verksamheten är i stor utsträckning omvärldsstyrd och du behöver ha stor flexibilitet då fokus kan ändras snabbt.

Vi sätter stort värde vid personliga egenskaper såsom att vara en högpresterande person med handlingskraft och uthållighet. Du har mycket gott omdöme och en utmärkt förmåga att kommunicera effektivt med olika intressenter och är en möjlighetsorienterad person med hög social kompetens och förmåga att bygga förtroendefulla relationer. Du kan navigera och hålla flertal processer igång parallellt genom att du kan tänka innovativt i komplexa sammanhang.

Din förmåga att samarbeta med människor på alla nivåer i organisationen är av yttersta betydelse för att vara framgångsrik i rollen. Du agerar utefter sjukhusets värderingar i relation till dina medarbetare och organisationen i övrigt.

Kvalifikationer

Krav:

    Jurist (jur. kand./juristexamen).
    Flera års erfarenhet av kvalificerat juridiskt arbete inom hälso- och sjukvårdsjuridik (till exempel Hälso- och sjukvårdslagen, Patientdatalagen och Patientlagen).
    Erfarenhet av kvalificerat juridiskt arbete inom kommunal- och förvaltningsrätt (inklusive offentlighet och sekretess).

Meriterande:

    Erfarenhet från juridiskt arbete i region, kommun eller annan myndighet.
    Erfarenhet från hälso- och sjukvårdssektorn.
    Utbildningsvana.
    Notariemeritering.
    Erfarenhet av att arbeta i en stor organisation med förståelse för komplexa beslutsprocesser.

Om rekryteringsprocessen

Urval och intervjuer kan komma att ske löpande under ansökningstiden.

I vår rekryteringsprocess kan vi komma att använda oss av Assessios test MAP och Matrigma. MAP är en personlighetstest och Matrigma är ett icke-verbalt begåvningstest som båda bygger på arbetspsykologisk forskning. Testerna används som ett komplement till dina erfarenheter och kompetenser och syftet är att göra vår urvalsprocess kvalitetssäker och transparent.

I samband med din ansökan behöver du bifoga CV. Istället för ett personligt brev ber vi dig besvara urvalsfrågor samt kort motivera varför du passar för rollen. Att besvara frågorna är en förutsättning för att din ansökan ska anses komplett.

Varmt välkommen med din ansökan - Tillsammans är vi Karolinska!

Inför tillsättning av befattning som innefattar vård av barn och ungdom, kontrolleras den som erbjuds tjänsten mot misstanke- och belastningsregistret. Här kan du läsa mer om rekryteringsprocessen och om vilka kontroller som utförs på Karolinska.

Som anställd på Karolinska Universitetssjukhuset kan du komma att krigsplaceras. Läs mer om vad det innebär här.

Om du är eller tidigare har varit anställd i Region Stockholm kommer vi att ta interna referenser från din nuvarande eller tidigare chef om du blir aktuell för anställning.

För tillsvidaretjänster kan provanställning komma att tillämpas.

jobs.title: Vi søger en ny kollega til vores lille historiske børnehave midt i Helsingør
jobs.description:
Vi søger en pædagogiskmedhjælper til vores lille historiske børnehave Børneasylet midt i Helsingør.

Kunne du tænke dig at være en del af en arbejdsplads med 190 års historie, hvor alle medarbejdere har reel indflydelse på hverdagen? Et sted fyldt med sjæl, historie og eventyr? Vil du arbejde i en lille børnehave med kun 27 børn, hvor relationer, nærvær og pædagogisk refleksion står i centrum, hvor udelivet vægtes højt, og hvor børn går med bare tær om sommeren?

Omme bag den grønne port i Helsingørs travle gågade ligger en privat børnehave med fem medarbejder, herunder én leder. Vi holder til i et skævt bindingsværkshus med en hyggelig legeplads med bålplads og vildtvoksende gemmesteder.

Hos os er det nære børneliv i fokus. Vi arbejder ud fra det nye børnesyn med blik for barnets perspektiv, ressourcer og deltagelsesmuligheder i fællesskabet. Legen har stor værdi i vores hverdag, og vi vægter udeliv, relationer og pædagogisk refleksion højt.

 

Er du stadig nysgerrig?

 

Så er det måske dig, vi søger til Helsingør Børneasylet.

Stillingen søges med opstart snarest.

Vi leder efter dig, der

  • arbejder ud fra barnets perspektiv og det nye børnesyn

  • kan understøtte og deltage aktivt i børns leg

  • er nærværende, omsorgsfuld og relationsstærk

  • vil være med til at skabe deltagelsesmuligheder for alle børn

  • kommunikere anerkendende og professionelt – både med børn, forældre og kollegaer

  • værdsætter et tæt og tillidsfuldt forældresamarbejde

  • kan indgå i løbende refleksion og evaluering af det pædagogiske arbejde

  • har lyst til at bidrage til et fællesskab, hvor alle hjælpe hinanden

  • trives i et lille hus med tæt samarbejde

 

Vi står et sted, hvor vi ønsker at udvikle vores fælles kultur og samarbejde endnu mere, og vi søger derfor en kollega, der har lyst til at bidrage aktivt til fællesskabet og den pædagogiske udvikling.

Hos os får du:

  • et fagligt engageret og støttende team

  • stor indflydelse på hverdagen og pædagogikken

  • mulighed for at sætte et meningsfyldt præg på børnenes hverdag

  • en arbejdsplads med historie, charme og personlighed

 

Praktisk information

Børnehavens åbningstid er:

Mandag–torsdag: 6.30 – 17.00
Fredag: 6.30 – 16.15

Vi har en primær åbner, men det er vigtigt, at du kan arbejde inden for hele åbningstiden.

Der afholdes personalemøde to gange om måneden af to timers varighed.
Vi holder samtaler løbende, så send gerne din ansøgning hurtigst muligt.

Vil du høre mere?

Du er meget velkommen til at kontakte Børneasylet på:

Telefon: 26 21 21 70

Mail: leder@hbasylet.dk

Vi glæder os til at møde dig.

Helsingør Børneasylet – anno 1835

Løn og ansættelsesvilkår

Løn og ansættelsesvilkår sker efter gældende kommunal overenskomst. Endelig løn fastsættes efter forhandling med den forhandlingsberettigede faglige organisation på baggrund af kvalifikationer, medmindre stillingen er omfattet af en forhåndsaftale.

jobs.title: SME säljare till Securitas Umeå
jobs.description:
Företagsbeskrivning

Securitas har en viktig roll i samhället och förvaltar ett av Sveriges viktigaste uppdrag - att skydda och hjälpa människor att känna sig trygga. Nu har du chansen att bli en del av Sveriges största säkerhetsföretag. Oavsett om du vill jobba mycket eller lite, dag eller natt så behöver vi bli fler.

Securitas Sverige krigsplacerar sin personal. Detta innebär i korthet att du som anställd kommer, i händelse av krig, ha kvar din anställning och arbetsledas av Securitas.

Som landets största arbetsgivare i vår bransch kan vi erbjuda dig utvecklingsmöjligheter och variation som få andra företag kan. Vi strävar efter ett enhetligt ledarskap med balans mellan förväntningar och förutsättningar.

Du tar hand om människors säkerhet – Securitas tar hand om dig.

Jobbeskrivning

Vill du ta nästa steg inom försäljning och arbeta med en av marknadens bredaste säkerhetsportföljer? Vi söker nu en affärsdriven SME‑säljare i Umeå som äger hela affären – från nykundsbearbetning till vunnen affär och långsiktig kundutveckling. Tillsammans med kunden utvecklar du deras säkerhet och säkerställer rätt lösning över tid.

I rollen fungerar du som arkitekt för samtliga av våra lösningar vilket ger variation, utveckling och stora affärsmöjligheter. Du formar helheter som kan bestå av allt från passer-, larm- och kameralösningar, parkeringsövervakning och brandtjänster till personell säkerhet - eller enskilda produkter när det är det som skapar bäst kundvärde. En naturlig del av rollen är också att samarbeta med driftorganisationen för att säkerställa tydliga affärer och trygga leveranser.

Rollen innebär hög egen aktivitet och ansvar för att nå försäljningsmålen. Vi erbjuder fast grundlön och tydlig provisionsmodell, där din prestation påverkar din ersättning. Du blir del av ett erfaret säljteam och arbetar med ett starkt varumärke samt gediget tekniskt stöd.

Placering: Ditt arbetsområde omfattar Umeå, Skellefteå, Lycksele, Örnsköldsvik och Västerbottens inland. Du utgår med fördel från kontoret i Umeå, men andra alternativ kan diskuteras.

Vi är trygghet. Vi är Securitas.

Kravspecifikation

För den här rollen krävs flerårig erfarenhet av nykundsbearbetning och försäljning i fält. Med tanke på att vi jobbar med komplex försäljning där vi lägger ner mycket stort engagemang i varje kund, så ser vi framför oss att du har en erfaren och trygg framtoning som vår representant.

Du tar dig fram med förmånsbil, varför B-körkort är ett krav. I övrigt ser vi att du behöver följande för att lyckas i rollen:

Krav:

    Erfarenhet av tjänsteförsäljning
    Erfarenhet av nykundsbearbetning och att driva hela säljprocessen självständigt
    Flerårig erfarenhet av uppsökande B2B-försäljning  
    Erfarenhet av att både knyta nya kontakter och att utveckla etablerade kundrelationer
    God geografisk kännedom om området Umeå med omnejd
    Mycket goda kunskaper i svenska och engelska
    B-körkort

Meriterande:

    Tidigare erfarenhet från säkerhetsbranschen
    Erfarenhet av att jobba med försäljning inom industrin
    Erfarenhet av en bred och komplex produktportfölj
    Tidigare erfarenhet av försäljning i aktuell geografi

För att trivas i rollen tror vi att du är intresserad av både resultat och relation. Vi värdesätter en stark egen drivkraft, hög ambitionsnivå och en tydlig vilja att utvecklas och ta egna initiativ i rollen. Du är självgående och ansvarsfull med en affärsmässig och problemlösande förmåga. Då tjänsten innehåller många kontaktytor såväl internt som externt, så är det av stor vikt att du är lyhörd, kommunikativ och prestigelös.

Övrig information

Vi tar endast emot ansökningar via vårt rekryteringsverktyg. Vi jobbar med löpande urval, så om du är intresserad av tjänsten – skicka din ansökan redan idag!

Har du frågor kring rollen är du välkommen att höra av dig till rekryterande chef Fredrik Jansson på fredrik.j.jansson@securitas.se.

Har du frågor kring rekryteringsprocessen kontakta gärna rekryterare på julia.olander@securitas.se.

    Tjänsten är en heltidstjänst med tillträde enligt överenskommelse. Vi tillämpar 6 månaders provanställning
    Vi arbetar med urvalstester
    Vi kommunicerar i första hand via mail
    Sista ansökningsdag är 2026-08-23

För anställning inom Securitas Sverige AB krävs det att du har godkända betyg från första året i gymnasiet i svenska samt blir godkänd av Länsstyrelsen för anställning i auktoriserat bevakningsföretag enligt Lag (1974:191) om bevakningsföretag (den ansökan görs av Securitas). Beroende på befattning kan även säkerhetsprövning enligt Säkerhetsskyddslag (2018:585) bli aktuell. För att utreda och bedöma om du uppfyller kraven för att bli godkänd enligt respektive författning sker en bakgrundskontroll. Bedömningen avser laglydnad, lämplighet, pålitlighet, lojalitet samt eventuella sårbarheter. Uppgifter som inhämtas kan ex. komma från dig själv, öppna källor eller myndigheter. Vi tillämpar en helhetsbedömning vid prövning av lämplighet för respektive befattning.

Lön och anställningsförhållanden baseras på kollektivavtal mellan arbetsgivarorganisationen Säkerhetsföretagen, Unionen samt Ledarna.

Mer info om Securitas som arbetsgivare och hur det är att jobba hos oss hittar du på securitas.se

jobs.title: Hanken Business Lab Internship: Social Media and Marketing Intern
jobs.description:
Hanken Business Lab now accepts applications for a SOCIAL MEDIA AND MARKETING INTERN

from 14 September 2026 to 31 May 2027

Hanken Business Lab is a startup incubator that provides growth-oriented support services to its resident startups and entrepreneurs through mentoring, events, wide international networks, community-building activities, and access to resources in both Helsinki and Vaasa.

Were looking for a creative and driven Social Media and Marketing Intern to join our dynamic, startup-focused team. In this role, youll play a hands-on part in elevating our brand visibility, especially across platforms like LinkedIn, Instagram, TikTok, and our website. Youll work closely with our Head of Marketing and Communications to help craft engaging content that speaks to aspiring entrepreneurs, startup founders, mentors, and investors. This internship is ideal for someone who is passionate about entrepreneurship, loves storytelling through video and long-form content, and wants to gain experience across the marketing and branding spectrum in a fast-paced, purpose-driven environment.

We offer a dynamic and international work environment where youll collaborate with entrepreneurs, industry experts, cross-border partners, and fellow students daily. Youll gain hands-on experience in startup support operations, content creation, and event production. This internship is based on-site at our co-working spaces in Helsinki.

Interns at Hanken Business Lab are considered full team members. You'll participate in team meetings, join internal planning sessions, and contribute to shaping our activities, future initiatives, and your own role. The working language at Hanken Business Lab is English.

We are looking for a well-organised, reliable, and diligent 2nd-5th year BSc or MSc student. Applications from recent graduates (up to one year post-graduation) will also be considered. Students from Hanken will be given priority in the recruitment process.

Key responsibilities:

- Plan, create, and edit short-form video content (e.g. LinkedIn, Instagram, TikTok) that tells others about our events, community, and programs and promotes them to our target audiences;
- Plan and write long-form content (e.g. our website) that shares stories from our community to our target audiences;
- Support day-to-day social media activities, from scheduling posts to community engagement;
- Assist with content planning, campaign brainstorming, and organising assets;
- Help market and document our events through visuals, stories, and recaps;
- Collaborate with the Community Intern regularly, e.g. day-to-day co-working space management, collaboration with Hanken Business Lab's resident startups and entrepreneurs.

Preferred background and skills:

- Comfortable being both in front and behind the camera;
- Previous experience in content creation, storytelling, or social media marketing is considered as a plus;
- Strong communication skills, creativity, attention to detail, and a proactive, team-oriented attitude;
- Ability to successfully manage own tasks without heavy supervision and to handle stress and time pressure well;
- Fluency in both spoken and written English. Swedish and/or Finnish are considered an asset;
- Growth mindset with a positive, proactive attitude toward learning and feedback;
- Genuine interest in and care for startup ecosystem;
- Willingness and motivation to shape your own role and take ownership of your work;
- You approach marketing and communications creatively and have a drive to try and test new things;
- Knowledge and understanding of the most common social media channels and motivation to follow changes, latest developments, and trends.

Students interested in getting ECTS for their internship are welcome to contact their department to ensure that this internship meets the set criteria and can be included in the degree.

The position is 20 hours/week with flexible office hours to be jointly decided upon. The salary is 1270 €/month. The trial period is two months.

Enquiries may be directed to Head of Marketing and Communications Emilia Jansén, e-mail emilia.jansen@hanken.fi, mobile +358 50 472 9695.

A CV and cover letter (as a short video of 2-3 minutes max instead of a written document) must be submitted via Hankens recruitment database (link below) by August 24, 2026, 23:59. Please note that applications without a video attachment will not be reviewed. Please ensure that the link to your LinkedIn profile is included in your CV. Other relevant documents (e.g. certificates, recommendations, portfolio) may be submitted with the application. Shortlisted candidates will be contacted for an interview; all interviews will take place on August 27–28 and August 31.

jobs.description:
About Cognizant

Cognizant is one of the world's leading professional services companies, helping organizations modernize technology, reimagine processes, and transform experiences so they stay ahead in a fast-changing world. With over 300,000 associates globally, Cognizant combines a passion for client satisfaction, technology innovation, deep industry and business process expertise, and a global, collaborative workforce that embodies the future of work. We are consistently listed among the most admired companies in the world and among the best companies to work for. Our culture is built on a foundation of transparency, inclusion, and collaboration — empowering our people to grow and thrive both professionally and personally. At Cognizant, you won't just be part of a company; you'll be part of a community that is shaping the future of industries across the globe.

Role Overview

We are looking for an experienced Teradata Architect with strong Snowflake expertise to lead and drive a large-scale data warehouse transformation within the banking sector. In this role, you will be responsible for guiding the migration from legacy Teradata environments to a modern Snowflake-based cloud data platform, ensuring a smooth, efficient, and scalable transition.

The role requires a combination of deep technical expertise, architectural thinking, and hands-on involvement, along with the ability to collaborate across engineering, architecture, and business teams.

Location: Stockholm

Key Responsibilities

You will take ownership of understanding the current Teradata data warehouse landscape and play a central role in driving its migration to Snowflake. This includes reviewing and validating the end-to-end migration strategy and identifying areas for improvement or optimization.

You will support the design and evolution of the target Snowflake architecture, including storage, compute, and security layers, ensuring alignment with business and technical requirements. A key part of the role is working closely with engineering teams to convert Teradata SQL, stored procedures, and macros into Snowflake-compatible solutions, while refactoring scripts for improved performance and scalability.

You will collaborate with data engineers, cloud architects, and business stakeholders to ensure alignment across the transformation initiative. In addition, you will provide technical leadership and mentorship, helping to guide teams through the migration and build best-practice capabilities.

The role also includes working with existing security and access control frameworks, translating current role-based access models into the Snowflake environment, and ensuring alignment with enterprise data governance and compliance standards.

Core Requirements

You bring strong experience in Teradata architecture and data warehousing, combined with advanced proficiency in SQL across both Teradata and Snowflake environments. You have hands-on experience working with Snowflake and a solid understanding of how to migrate, transform, and optimize data warehouse solutions in a cloud context.

You have experience leading or playing a key role in at least one full-scale data warehouse migration and are comfortable working in complex transformation environments where both legacy and modern platforms coexist.

Desirable Skills

Experience working with ETL tools is valuable, with familiarity in platforms such as IDMC considered an advantage. You bring a collaborative mindset and are used to working in cross-functional teams, contributing not only to technical delivery but also to overall solution design and continuous improvement.

jobs.title: PhD Fellow in Arctic Mobility, Landscape and Spatial Justice
jobs.employer: UNIVERSITETET I TROMSØ - NORGES ARKTISKE UNIVERSITET UIT CAMPUS TROMSØ
jobs.description:
The position

At The School of Business and Economics at UiT The Arctic University of Norway, ROADS is seeking a highly motivated doctoral researcher interested in questions of mobility, infrastructure, northern landscapes, environmental change, and spatial justice in the Arctic. The successful applicant will become part of an interdisciplinary research team combining geography, environmental humanities, Indigenous studies, critical infrastructure studies, heritage research, and spatial analysis. The PhD position is funded for three years, starting 1 March 2027 and ending 28 February 2030, and is embedded within an international and collaborative research environment.

The objective of the position is to complete research training to the level of a doctoral degree. Admission to the PhD programme is a prerequisite for employment, and the programme period starts on commencement of the position.

The workplace is at UiT in Tromsø. You must be able to start in the position within a reasonable time after receiving the offer.

Working and living in Tromsø 

Tromsø/Romssa serves as an important hub for research, culture, governance, and mobility in the region of Northern Norway and Sápmi. Its position as a regional gateway between coastal, inland, and cross-border northern landscapes makes it a particularly meaningful base for ROADS. The School of Business and Economics at UiT hosts a growing community of scholars working on sustainability, governance, mobilities, Arctic transformations, and societal change. The successful candidate will become part of a dynamic interdisciplinary environment, including UiT’s Environmental Humanities thematic network that ROADS is closely connected to. 


The project

ROADS offers the first systematic study of residual road infrastructures in Northern Fennoscandia—roads and pathways that have fallen out of official purpose but continue to shape landscapes, memories, and mobility practices across the region. These include bypassed roads, abandoned transport corridors, former military and extractive infrastructures, and old roads and seasonal pathways embedded within local and Sámi land-use traditions.

While many remain visible in the landscape, their histories increasingly persist through local knowledge systems that risk disappearing as generations pass. Rather than approaching such infrastructures as obsolete remnants, ROADS conceptualizes them as living archives: material traces through which memory, power, mobility, resistance, and future possibilities continue to unfold.

Drawing on feminist and decolonial Science and Technology Studies, critical infrastructure studies, political ecology, environmental humanities and Indigenous ontologies, ROADS seeks to broaden conventional understandings of infrastructure by integrating relational, seasonal, and more-than human mobility systems into analyses of northern landscapes.

The project combines GIS-based spatial analysis, archival research, ethnography, repeat photography and artistic methods, and collaborative countermapping. It is grounded in close collaboration with local and Sámi communities and culminates in community-responsive public outputs, including a multilingual digital storymap and participatory mapping platform.

While GIS and spatial analysis provide important analytical foundations, ROADS combines these approaches with ethnographic, archival, visual, and artistic methods. The project therefore welcomes applicants interested in methodological experimentation and interdisciplinary research across the social sciences, humanities, environmental sciences, and arts. 


The PhD project, responsibilities and research methods

The PhD project and responsibilities

The successful candidate will undertake doctoral research mainly within Work Package 2: Mapping Conflict and Relational Mobility in the North. The PhD candidate will take a leading role in the WP and receive close supervision from the Principal Investigator while collaborating with the project's postdoctoral researcher and the project network.

The PhD project explores how contemporary road development in Northern Fennoscandia—including infrastructure connected to resource extraction, military activities, and regional development—interacts with older roads, seasonal pathways, and Indigenous and local mobility systems. Rather than treating infrastructure as fixed physical objects, the PhD project investigates roads as dynamic political, cultural, and material assemblages that shape relationships between people, landscapes, governance, and more-than-human worlds. 

Particular attention is given to questions such as: 

  • How do expanding road infrastructures interact with Indigenous and local land use, seasonal mobilities, and relational understandings of landscape? 
  • How are access, mobility, and territorial authority negotiated between different actors, including local communities, Sámi reindeer herders, planners, governmental agencies, and extractive industries?
  • How do roads simultaneously enable, constrain, and transform relationships between people and northern landscapes?

The PhD candidate will have the opportunity to shape the detailed direction of the dissertation within the broader aims of the project. 

Research methods

The project combines: 

  • Archival research
  • GIS and spatial analysis
  • Participatory and critical mapping
  • Ethnographic fieldwork
  • Walking interviews
  • Policy analysis
  • Visual and spatial storytelling 

GIS analysis forms an important component of the project, but it is integrated with qualitative, participatory, and community-engaged approaches. The project therefore welcomes applicants interested in combining spatial analysis with ethnographic and critical social science methods. Fieldwork will involve collaboration with local residents, Sámi communities, municipal planners, land users, and other stakeholders across Northern Fennoscandia.

Applicants are required to submit a project description (3–5 pages, literature references included) outlining how they would approach the proposed doctoral research within Work Package 2 of ROADS. The project description should demonstrate the applicant's understanding of the aims of ROADS and discuss how they would investigate questions related to infrastructure, mobility, landscape, territorial governance, and Indigenous and local land use in Northern Fennoscandia.

While the dissertation is situated within Work Package 2, applicants are encouraged to develop their own research focus within the overall objectives of the project. The final project description will be developed in cooperation with the supervisor. 

The description should reflect on relevant theoretical perspectives and methodological approaches appropriate for doctoral research. Applicants are encouraged to discuss how methods such as GIS and spatial analysis, participatory and critical mapping, ethnographic fieldwork, archival and policy analysis, visual methods, and interdisciplinary collaboration could contribute to their proposed research. The proposal does not need to include all of these approaches but should demonstrate thoughtful consideration of the methods most appropriate for the applicant's intended doctoral project. Applicants should also indicate how their academic background, research interests, and methodological competencies would contribute to the interdisciplinary research environment of ROADS while supporting the development of an original doctoral dissertation. 


Contact

For further information about the position and the ROADS project, please contact: 

Dr. Tarja Salmela, Principal Investigator, ROADS
School of Business and Economics, BFE UiT The Arctic University of Norway

Email: tarja.t.salmela@uit.no 


Qualifications

Required qualifications: 

  • Applicants must hold a Master's degree equivalent to a Norwegian Master's degree in geography, human geography, Indigenous studies, environmental humanities, archaeology, anthropology, planning, GIScience, landscape studies, political ecology, heritage studies, environmental studies, digital humanities, or another relevant discipline. Qualification with a master’s degree is required before commencement in the position. You may still apply if you are in the final stages of the master’s degree, but the master’s thesis must be submitted for evaluation within the application deadline. You must submit the thesis and transcripts of grades for the master's degree with your application. 
  • Strong academic performance and collaboration skills.
  • Proficiency in spoken and written English. Nordic applicants can document their English capabilities by attaching their high school diploma. 
  • Demonstrated interest in Arctic, Indigenous, environmental, mobility, infrastructure, or landscape research. 
  • Ability to work independently while contributing actively to collaborative research.

Desired qualifications: 

  • Archival or historical research.
  • GIS and spatial analysis. 
  • Critical GIS, participatory mapping, or countermapping. 
  • Qualitative or ethnographic research. • Indigenous methodologies and community-based research. 
  • Political ecology, infrastructure studies, environmental humanities, or mobility studies. 
  • Visual methods, digital storytelling, or creative and arts-based research.
  • Skills in Norwegian, Swedish, Finnish, or a Sámi language

We also value applicants who are motivated to develop language skills relevant to the project's geographical and cultural contexts. Applicants with backgrounds in geography, archaeology, digital heritage, landscape studies, environmental humanities, Indigenous studies, anthropology, planning, and related disciplines are particularly encouraged to apply. ROADS is grounded in long-term collaboration with local and Sámi communities and engages critically with Indigenous knowledge systems and questions of self-determination and cultural heritage. We encourage applications from researchers whose experiences and perspectives can contribute to the project's commitment to plurality, community engagement, and inclusive knowledge production.

In the assessment, the emphasis is on the applicant's potential to complete a research education based on the master's thesis or equivalent, and any other scientific work. The project description will also be considered. In addition, professional experience and other experience of significance for the completion of the doctoral programme will be taken into consideration.

We will also emphasize motivation and personal suitability for the position. We are looking for candidates who:

  • Have good collaboration skills
  • Have good communication and interaction with colleagues and students
  • Wants to contribute to a good working environment

As many people as possible should have the opportunity to undertake organized research training. If you already hold a PhD or have equivalent competence, we will not appoint you to this position.


Admission to the PhD programme 

For employment in the PhD position, you must be qualified for admission to the PhD programme at the Faculty of Biosciences, Fisheries and Economics and participate in organized doctoral studies within the employment period.

Admission normally requires:  

  • A bachelor's degree of 180 ECTS and a master's degree of 120 ECTS, or an integrated master's degree of 300 ECTS. 
  • A master's thesis with a scope corresponding to at least 30 ECTS for a master's degree of 120 ECTS. 
  • A master's thesis with a scope corresponding to at least 20 ECTS for an integrated master's degree of 300 ECTS. 

Grade requirements applies both to the master thesis as well as courses part of the master’s degree. The minimum requirements are grade B or better on the master’s degree, and an average grade of B or better on courses that are part of the master’s degree. For integrated master's degrees, applicants are required to have achieved a grade of B or higher on their master's thesis and an overall average grade of C or higher across all courses comprising the integrated degree programme. A more detailed description of admission requirements can be found here.  

If you are employed in the position, you will be provisionally admitted to the PhD programme. Application for final admission must be submitted no later than two months after taking up the position. 

Applicants with a foreign education will be subjected to an evaluation of whether the educational background is equal to Norwegian higher education, following national guidelines from Norwegian Directorate for Higher Education and Skills. Depending on which country the education is from, one or two additional years of university education may be required to fulfil admission requirements, e.g. a 4-year bachelor's degree and a 2-year master's degree. UiT normally accepts higher education from countries that are part of the Lisbon Recognition Convention.


Inclusion and diversity

UiT The Arctic University of Norway is working actively to promote equality, gender balance and diversity among employees and students, and to create an inclusive and safe working environment. We believe that inclusion and diversity are a strength, and we want employees with different competencies, professional experience, life experience and perspectives.

If you have a disability, a gap in your CV or immigrant background, we encourage you to tick the box for this in your application. If there are qualified applicants, we invite at least one in each group for an interview. If you get the job, we will adapt the working conditions if you need it. Apart from selecting the right candidates, we will only use the information for anonymous statistics.


We offer

The successful candidate will join an internationally connected and intellectually vibrant research environment at UiT The Arctic University of Norway, Handelshøgskolen, and the thematic network of Environmental Humanities at UiT. The successful candidate will become part of an innovative research project addressing pressing questions concerning infrastructure, mobility, cultural heritage, and environmental change in the Arctic.

  • The opportunity to contribute to a research project with strong academic and societal relevance
  • Close collaboration with researchers working across Arctic studies, mobility studies, infrastructure studies, environmental humanities, Indigenous studies, heritage research, and critical geography
  • Opportunities for international collaboration, conference participation, publication, and career development
  • Access to GIS and research infrastructure through UiT
  • Good career opportunities 
  • Flexible working hours and a state collective pay agreement  
  • Pension scheme through the state pension fund 
  • The remuneration for the position is in accordance with the State salary scale code 1017 with a gross annual salary ranging from NOK 580 000 to 600 000 (in a 100% position), with a 3% yearly increase

Norwegian health policy aims to ensure that everyone, irrespective of their personal finances and where they live, has access to good health and care services of equal standard. As an employee you will become member of the National Insurance Scheme which also include health care services.

More practical information about working and living in Norway can be found here: https://uit.no/staffmobility


Application 

Please note that the application will only be assessed based on the information submitted by the application deadline via Jobbnorge. It is therefore important that you include all necessary documents demonstrating your qualifications for the position.

Your application must include: 

  • Cover letter explaining your motivation and research interests
  • Academic CV
  • Official diplomas for Bachelor's and Master's degree in the original language 
  • Official transcripts of grades/academic record for Bachelor's and Master's degree in the original language
  • Official translation of diplomas and transcripts of records (ToR) to English or a Scandinavian language, if applicable
  • Explanation of the grading system for foreign education (Diploma Supplement if available)
  • Documentation of English proficiency
  • Documentation of proficiency in Norwegian (or a Scandinavian language) (if available)
  • References with contact information
  • Master’s thesis, and any other academic works
  • Publication list (if available)
  • Project description (3-5 pages)

Qualification with a master’s degree is required before commencement in the position. You may still apply if you are in the final stages of the master’s degree, but the master’s thesis must be submitted for evaluation within the application deadline. You must submit the thesis and transcript of grades for the master’s degree with your application.

All documentation to be considered must be in a Scandinavian language or English. If English proficiency is not documented in the application, it must be documented before starting in the position. 


Assessment 

The applicants will be assessed by an expert committee. The committee's mandate is to undertake an assessment of the applicants' qualifications based on the written material presented by the applicants, and the detailed description draw up for the position. A copy of the assessment report will be sent to all applicants. 

The applicants who are assessed as best qualified will be called to an interview. The interview should among other things, aim to clarify the applicant’s motivation and personal suitability for the position. 


General information 

The appointment is made in accordance with State regulations and guidelines at UiT. At our website, you will find more information for applicants. 

Remuneration for the position of PhD Fellow is in accordance with the State salary scale code 1017. A compulsory contribution of 2 % to the Norwegian Public Service Pension Fund will be deducted. You will become a member of the Norwegian Public Service Pension Fund, which gives you many benefits in addition to a lifelong pension: You may be entitled to financial support if you become ill or disabled, your family may be entitled to financial support when you die, you become insured against occupational injury or occupational disease, and you can get good terms on a mortgage. Read more about your employee benefits at: spk.no.

A shorter period of appointment may be decided when the PhD Fellow has already completed parts of their research training programme or when the appointment is based on a previous qualifying position PhD Fellow, research assistant, or the like in such a way that the total time used for research training amounts to three years. 

We process personal data given in an application or CV in accordance with the Personal Data Act (Offentleglova). According to the Personal Data Act information about the applicant may be included in the public applicant list, also in cases where the applicant has requested non-disclosure. You will receive advance notification in the event of such publication, if you have requested non-disclosure. 


Om arbeidsgiveren:

UiT The Arctic University of Norway is a multi-campus research university and the northernmost university of the world. Our central location in the High North, our broad and diverse research and study portfolio, and our interdisciplinary qualities make us uniquely suited to meet the challenges of the future. At UiT you can explore global issues from a close-up perspective.

Credibility, academic freedom, closeness, creativity and commitment shall be hallmarks of the relationship between our employees, between our employees and our students and between UiT and our partners. 

The Faculty of Biosciences, Fisheries and Economics (BFE) consists of Department of Arctic and Marine Biology, Norwegian College of Fishery Science (NFH) and School of Business and Economics.The main task of BFE is to conduct teaching and research dissemination at a high national and international level within all relevant fields. Prioritized research areas are aquatic and terrestrial ecosystems, climate, life in the arctic, marine bioprospecting, fish health, seafood products, business and macroeconomics, resources and environment, markets and management of marine resources. The interdisciplinary profile of the faculty provides good opportunity to develop research projects involving several research groups at the faculty according to its strategy.

Hanken Business Lab now accepts applications for a COMMUNITY INTERN

from 14 September 2026 to 31 May 2027

Hanken Business Lab is a startup incubator that provides growth-oriented support services to its resident startups and entrepreneurs through mentoring, events, wide international networks, community-building activities, and access to resources in both Helsinki and Vaasa.

Were looking for a creative and driven Community Intern to join our dynamic, startup-focused team. As an intern, you will work closely with the Head of Incubation and Community to support daily operations and ongoing development of our [incubation services](https://www.hankenbusinesslab.fi/incubation-services), [L&G EPIC](https://www.hanken.fi/en/news/hanken-business-lab-receives-record-funding) (Louise and Göran Ehrnrooth and Partners Incubation Community). We offer a dynamic, fast-paced, and international work environment where youll collaborate with entrepreneurs, industry experts, cross-border partners, and fellow students daily. Youll gain hands-on experience in international community management, startup support operations, and event production. This internship is based on-site at our co-working spaces in Helsinki.

Interns at Hanken Business Lab are considered full team members. You'll participate in team meetings, join internal planning sessions, and contribute to shaping our activities, future initiatives, and your own role. The working language at Hanken Business Lab is English.

We are looking for a well-organised, reliable, and diligent 2nd-5th year BSc or MSc student. Applications from recent graduates (up to one year post-graduation) will also be considered. Students from Hanken will be given priority in the recruitment process. The tasks include, but are not limited to, the following:

- Helping to maintain a professional and welcoming work environment in the Helsinki co-working space, ensuring its tidiness and functionality. This includes managing co-working space reservation requests from members, students, and other stakeholders;

Youll be a great fit and thrive here if you have:

- Growth mindset with a positive, proactive attitude toward learning and feedback.
- Proficiency in everyday office software and collaboration tools (e.g. Microsoft, Notion) and social media (e.g. LinkedIn, Instagram) as well as familiarity with and curiosity about AI tools.

Students interested in getting ECTS for their internship are welcome to contact their department to ensure that this internship meets the set criteria and can be included in the degree.

The position is 20 hours/week with flexible office hours to be jointly decided upon. The salary is 1270 €/month. The trial period is two months.

Enquiries may be directed to Head of Incubation and Community Sergei Marostenmäki-Lavrov at e-mail sergei.marostenmaki-lavrov@hanken.fi and mobile +358 50 462 34 35.

A CV and cover letter (as a short video of 2-3 minutes max instead of a written document) must be submitted via Hankens recruitment database (link below) by August 24, 2026, 23:59. It is grounded in close collaboration with local and Sámi communities and culminates in community-responsive public outputs, including a multilingual digital storymap and participatory mapping platform.

While GIS and spatial analysis provide important analytical foundations, ROADS combines these approaches with ethnographic, archival, visual, and artistic methods. The project therefore welcomes applicants interested in methodological experimentation and interdisciplinary research across the social sciences, humanities, environmental sciences, and arts.

The postdoctoral project and responsibilities

The Postdoctoral Research Fellow will play a central role in the project and contribute to both its analytical and public-facing outputs.

The postdoctoral researcher will lead the spatial and archival components of Work Package 1: Tracing the temporal lives of residual and rendered invisible infrastructures and contribute to synthesis and engagement activities in Work Package 3: Reimagining residual road infrastructures and mobilities in Northern Fennoscandia.

Key responsibilities include:

  • Conducting GIS-based spatial analysis of residual road infrastructures across Northern Fennoscandia.
  • Integrating historical maps, infrastructure records, aerial imagery, and satellite data to identify and visualize infrastructural change over time.
  • Developing innovative approaches to critical spatial visualization and mapping that foreground questions of memory, erasure, survivance, and infrastructural power.
  • Contributing to archival research and the interpretation of historical infrastructure records.
  • Participating in ethnographic fieldwork, collaborative mapping activities, repeat photography, and visual documentation initiatives alongside the Principal Investigator.
  • Co-leading participatory countermapping workshops and contributing to the development of a multilingual digital storymap and other public facing outputs.
  • Publishing research findings in leading international journals and contributing to conferences, outreach activities, and project dissemination.

The position offers an opportunity to engage with northern landscapes and communities across Northern Fennoscandia in a place-sensitive way. Fieldwork will take place in active collaboration with local and Sámi knowledge holders and cultural institutions. The postdoctoral researcher will contribute to research that is attentive to the diverse histories, experiences, and knowledge systems that shape northern mobility landscapes.

The postdoctoral researcher will work closely with the Principal Investigator while also developing an independent research profile within the broader framework of the project.

Project description requirements

Applicants are asked to submit a project description (3–5 pages) outlining how they would approach the responsibilities of the postdoctoral position outlined above, within ROADS. The description should demonstrate the applicant's understanding of the project's aims and explain how they would contribute to the spatial, archival, and interdisciplinary dimensions of the research. The description must include a progress plan.

Applicants are encouraged to reflect on relevant theoretical perspectives, methodological approaches, and analytical strategies, including the use of GIS, spatial analysis, historical sources, participatory mapping, and interdisciplinary collaboration where appropriate. The description should also indicate how the applicant's expertise and research interests would contribute to the project's broader objectives while supporting the development of an independent research profile within the ROADS framework.

Contact

For further information about the position, please contact:

Dr. Tarja Salmela, Principal Investigator, ROADS
email: tarja.t.salmela@uit.no
School of Business and Economics, BFE 
UiT The Arctic University of Norway

Qualifications

Required qualifications:

  • A PhD or equivalent degree in geography, GIScience, human geography, spatial humanities, environmental humanities, infrastructure studies, archaeology, heritage studies, Indigenous studies, anthropology, planning, landscape studies, digital humanities, or another relevant discipline. If you’re at the final stages of your PhD, you may still apply if you have submitted your PhD thesis for doctoral degree evaluation within the application deadline. You must submit the thesis with your application. Documentation of your completed PhD degree must be submitted before commencement.
  • Expertise in GIS and spatial analysis.
  • Experience working with spatial datasets, historical maps, remote sensing data, or related geospatial materials.
  • Strong academic publication record relative to career stage.
  • Proficiency in spoken and written English. Nordic applicants can document their capabilities by attaching their high school diploma.
  • Ability to work independently while contributing actively to collaborative research environments.

Desired qualifications:

  • Skills in Norwegian, Swedish, Finnish, or a Sámi language are considered an asset. We also value applicants who are motivated to develop language skills relevant to the project's geographical and cultural contexts.
  • Experience with critical GIS, participatory mapping, countermapping, or spatial humanities approaches.
  • Knowledge of Arctic, Northern, Indigenous, environmental, infrastructure, mobility, landscape, or heritage research.
  • Experience integrating qualitative and quantitative spatial methods.
  • Skills in visual storytelling, cartographic design, digital heritage, digital humanities, or multimedia research dissemination.
  • Experience conducting archival research and working with historical sources.
  • Interest in interdisciplinary and creative research methods, including visual, arts-based, or experimental approaches to landscape and infrastructure research.
  • Experience working across disciplinary boundaries and integrating spatial, archival, ethnographic, visual, or participatory methods.
  • Familiarity with community-based research, collaborative knowledge production, and Indigenous methodologies

ROADS is grounded in long-term collaboration with local and Sámi communities and engages critically with Indigenous knowledge systems and questions of self-determination and cultural heritage. Sámi scholars and other Indigenous scholars, as well as applicants with relevant experience working in Indigenous research contexts, are particularly encouraged to apply. We also encourage applications from researchers whose experiences and perspectives can contribute to the project's commitment to plurality, community engagement, and inclusive knowledge production.

In the assessment the main emphasis will be attached to the submitted works and the project proposal for the qualifying work. Emphasis shall also be attached to experience from popularization/dissemination and academic policy and administrative activity.

During the assessment emphasis will be put on the candidate’s motivation, potential for research, and personal suitability for the position. We are looking for candidates who:

  • Have good collaboration skills
  • Have good communication and interaction with colleagues and students
  • Wants to contribute to a good working environment

At UiT we put emphasis on the quality, relevance and significance of the research work and not on where the work is published, in accordance with the principles of The San Francisco Declaration on Research Assessment (DORA).

Inclusion and diversity

UiT The Arctic University i Norway is working actively to promote equality, gender balance and diversity among employees and students, and to create an inclusive and safe working environment. We believe that inclusion and diversity is a strength, and we want employees with different competencies, professional experience, life experience and perspectives.

If you have a disability, a gap in your CV or immigrant background, we encourage you to tick the box for this in your application. If there are qualified applicants, we invite least one in each group for an interview. If you get the job, we will adapt the working conditions if you need it. Apart from selecting the right candidates, we will only use the information for anonymous statistics.

We offer

The successful candidate will join an internationally connected and intellectually vibrant research environment at UiT The Arctic University of Norway, Handelshøgskolen, and the thematic network of Environmental Humanities at UiT. The successful candidate will become part of an innovative research project addressing pressing questions concerning infrastructure, mobility, cultural heritage, and environmental change in the Arctic.

The position offers:

  • The opportunity to contribute to a research project with strong academic and societal relevance.
  • Close collaboration with researchers working across Arctic studies, mobility studies, infrastructure studies, environmental humanities, Indigenous studies, heritage research, and critical geography.
  • Opportunities for international collaboration, conference participation, publication, and career development.
  • Access to GIS and research infrastructure through UiT.
  • Significant opportunities to develop a strong academic research profile.
  • Good career opportunities 
  • Flexible working hours and a state collective pay agreement
  • Pension scheme through the state pension fund

Norwegian health policy aims to ensure that everyone, irrespective of their personal finances and where they live, has access to good health and care services of equal standard. As an employee you will become member of the National Insurance Scheme which also include health care services.

More practical information for working and living in Norway can be found here: https://uit.no/staffmobility

Application

Please note that the application will only be assessed based on the information submitted by the application deadline via Jobbnorge. It is therefore important that you include all necessary documents demonstrating your qualifications for the position.

Your application must include:

  • Letter of motivation
  • Project proposal (3–5 pages)
  • Academic CV
  • Diplomas and transcripts (all degrees)
  • Documentation of English proficiency
  • Contact information to 2-3 references
  • Documentation of educational competence, if available
  • Description of your academic production, stating which works you consider most important
  • Publication list
  • Academic works, up to ten. The doctoral thesis is regarded as one work.

If you’re at the final stages of your PhD, you may still apply if you have submitted your PhD thesis for doctoral degree evaluation within the application deadline. You must submit the thesis with your application. Documentation of your completed PhD degree must be submitted before commencement.

All documentation to be considered must be in a Scandinavian language or English. If English proficiency is not documented in the application, it must be documented before starting in the position.

Assessment

The applicants will be assessed by an expert committee. The committee's mandate is to undertake an assessment of the applicants' qualifications based on the written material presented by the applicants, and the detailed description draw up for the position. A copy of the assessment report will be sent to all applicants.

The applicants who are assessed as best qualified will be called to an interview. The interview should among other things, aim to clarify the applicant’s motivation and personal suitability for the position. A trial lecture may also be held.

General information

The appointment is made in accordance with State regulations and guidelines at UiT. At our website, you will find more information for applicants.

The remuneration for Postdoctoral research fellow is in accordance with the State salary scale code 1352 with a gross annual salary ranging from NOK 630 000 to 720 000 (in a 100% position). (In special cases, a higher salary may be considered.) A compulsory contribution of 2 % to the Norwegian Public Service Pension Fund will be deducted. You will become a member of the Norwegian Public Service Pension Fund, which gives you many benefits in addition to a lifelong pension. Read more about your employee benefits at: spk.no.

The successful candidate must be willing to get involved in the ongoing development of their department and the university as a whole.

UiT wishes to promote gender equality. If two or more applicants are found to be equally qualified, the university will rank applicants from the underrepresented gender ahead of others.

According to the Norwegian Freedom and Information Act (Offentleglova) information about the applicant may be included in the public applicant list, also in cases where the applicant has requested non-disclosure.

UiT The Arctic University of Norway is a multi-campus research university and the northernmost university of the world. Credibility, academic freedom, closeness, creativity and commitment shall be hallmarks of the relationship between our employees, between our employees and our students and between UiT and our partners.

Job Description

Join H&M Group in a high-impact role where you’ll shape how store space is planned, measured and optimised across markets. As our Retail Space Planning Expert, you’ll turn data into smart strategies that improve productivity across our store portfolio, influence retail design and help create better customer experiences at scale.

WHAT YOU’LL DO

As a Retail Space Planning Expert, you define and execute strategies that optimise store space productivity across formats. You build and own the space productivity system — including capacity models and space rules — enabling Sales Markets to plan and execute space consistently, effectively and at scale.

    Develop and maintain the store capacity model, defining how space capacity is calculated and applied, acting as Business partner to Retail tech teams
    Set macro space allocation rules for full stores, including back of house, by format and segment
    Develop and own space management processes and toolboxes, covering data models, tools, workflows and adoption
    Set format productivity targets and ensure they are embedded in format and retail design briefs
    Define space performance measurements such as zone productivity, placement uplift and adjacency or cross sell analytics
    Contribute space expertise to assortment package development and commercial activation placement standards
    Act as a centre of excellence on space and capacity, defining optimal density by format and country
    Develop, train and coach stakeholders such as Retail Design teams and Sales Market colleagues



WHO YOU’LL WORK WITH

You’ll work closely with Retail  Design, Retail tech, Commercial, Assortment, Retail Space and Sales Market teams. You collaborate with business and tech stakeholders to ensure space strategies are practical, scalable and consistently executed.



WHO YOU ARE

We are looking for people with…

    A relevant degree in Business Administration, Engineering or a related field, or equivalent work experience
    5+ years of experience in retail strategy development and implementation for commercial space
    Experience leading large, complex projects from start to end, developing business strategies or solutions in a retail environment across business and tech stakeholders
    Experience working with space and assortment-related data, store layouts and store design teams
    Experience working with assortment composition for commercial or retail spaces
    Leadership experience, formal or informal, with the ability to build trust and create strong collaboration

And people who are…

    Strong analytical skills with the ability to translate complex data into simple, actionable insights
    High attention to detail and strong communication skills
    Strong stakeholder management and collaboration abilities
    Ability to balance operational detail with a strategic perspective



WHO WE ARE

H&M Group is a global company of strong fashion brands and ventures. Our goal is to prove that there is no compromise between exceptional design, affordable prices and sustainable solutions. We want to liberate fashion for the many, and our customers are at the heart of every decision we make.

We are made up of thousands of passionate and talented colleagues united by our shared culture and values. Together, we use our power, our scale and our knowledge to push the fashion industry towards a more inclusive and sustainable future.



WHY YOU’LL LOVE WORKING HERE

At H&M Group, we are proud to be a vibrant and welcoming company. We offer our employees attractive benefits with extensive development opportunities around the globe.

    A role with strong influence on store performance and space productivity at scale
    Close collaboration with global and market teams shaping how stores are designed and planned



JOIN US

Our uniqueness comes from a combination of many things — our inclusive and collaborative culture, our strong values and opportunities for growth. But most of all, it’s our people who make us who we are.

Take the next step in your career together with us. The journey starts here.
