jobs.title: Administrasjons- og servicemedarbeidar (50%)
jobs.description:
Årdal Teknologipark søkjer ein positiv, strukturert og serviceinnstilt administrasjons- og servicemedarbeidar i 50 % stilling.

Ei variert rolle der du får ein viktig funksjon i den daglege drifta av teknologiparken og bidreg til at både besøkande og leigetakarar får ei god oppleving.

Hva vi ser etter

Vi ønskjer ein person som:

  • Er strukturert og sjølvstendig

  • Har gode samarbeidsevner og eit positivt vesen

  • Likar å yte god service og skape gode opplevingar for andre

  • Er fleksibel og trivst med varierte arbeidsoppgåver

  • Tek initiativ og ser kva som trengst å gjerast

Arbeidsoppgaver

  • Vere vertskap for besøkande og gjester i Årdal Teknologipark

  • Koordinere bookingar og leggje til rette for møte, kurs og arrangement

  • Fakturering og enklare administrative oppgåver

  • Informere brukarar og besøkande om rutinar og retningslinjer i lokala

  • Bidra til orden, trivsel og god service i teknologiparken

  • Andre førefallande administrative og praktiske oppgåver

Vi tilbyr

  • Ei variert og sjølvstendig stilling i eit spennande næringsmiljø

  • Eit godt arbeidsmiljø med engasjerte menneske

  • Moglegheit til å vere med og vidareutvikle Årdal Teknologipark

  • Løn etter avtale

Om arbeidsgiveren:

Vi skal legge til rette for ny industri og næring i Årdal gjennom bygg, areal, infrastruktur og teknologi, samt koordinere og støtte samarbeid mellom eksisterande og nye aktørar i Årdal og regionen.

Våre eigarar er Årdal Utvikling, Hydro Aluminium og Årdal Energi Holding. I saman sikrar vi trygg tilrettelegging for industri- og næringsutvikling i Årdal med ei veksande eigedomsportefølje.

Selskapet arbeider tett og koordinert saman med Årdal Utvikling og Sitep, med eit felles mål om å sikre eit meir robust næringsliv i kommunen. Arbeidet vårt er forankra i det lokale næringslivet og vi er ein pådrivar for samarbeid og etablering.

Her har vi samla eit mangfald av kompetansebedrifter innan eit breitt spekter av fagområde, alt frå gründerbedrifter som produserer alger til Hydro sitt senter for forsking- og teknologiutvikling innan aluminiumsproduksjon.

jobs.title: Open call: Visiting Professors at Chalmers University of Technology
jobs.description:
Chalmers University of Technology invites applications from internationally distinguished professors to join the Academic Excellence Visiting Professor Programme 2027–2028. This highly selective university-wide initiative is designed to attract outstanding professors whose academic excellence, leadership and international networks can contribute to the development of world-leading research and education environments at Chalmers.

About Chalmers and our vision

Chalmers’ long‑term vision is to be “a globally outstanding university of technology, for a better world”, with academic quality at the highest European level and highly effective utilisation of research results in society. We are currently implementing a group strategy and major investments in excellence‑driven research to become a world‑class technical university by 2041, including strengthened base funding and outstanding conditions for research. Our campus and surrounding ecosystem form a dynamic innovation environment where researchers, students and external partners co-create sustainable solutions for industry and society.

The Academic Excellence Visiting Professor Programme is a strategic component of Chalmers’ internationalisation strategy. The programme aims to strengthen academic excellence by attracting internationally recognised academic leaders who can contribute to the long-term development of Chalmers’ research, education and international collaborations. Beyond individual academic achievements, the programme seeks to create lasting value through strategic partnerships, scientific leadership, mentorship and the development of strong academic environments.

The Visiting Professor role

As a Visiting Professor, you will contribute to the development of Chalmers’ academic environments through research leadership, international collaboration, mentorship, doctoral education and strategic academic engagement. Activities may include initiating new research collaborations, strengthening international networks, contributing to educational development, mentoring early-career researchers and supporting the long-term development of the host environment.

The Academic Excellence Visiting Professor Programme at Chalmers will run during 2027-2028.

The appointment is a part-time engagement, corresponding to up to 20% of a full-time position for a maximum of two years. Visiting professors are expected to maintain their affiliation with their home institution throughout the appointment. The level of engagement, duration and duties will be agreed jointly between the visiting professor, the host department and Chalmers. Financial arrangements will be tailored to the specific circumstances of each appointment.

Please note that the position concerns a Visiting Professor and not a regular professorship with permanent employment.

Qualifications

According to Chalmers’ Appointment Regulation for teaching and research staff, a Visiting Professor must:

    Hold a full professorship, or an equivalent appointment at the highest academic rank, at a reputable university.
    Be able to contribute to both research and education at Chalmers, including supervision and mentoring of students and early‑career researchers.
    Be prepared to take an active role in collaboration with external partners and in the academic life of the hosting department.

Who we invite

This is an open call aimed at established researchers who have an outstanding record of scientific achievement and are internationally recognised as an academic leader within their field and who wish to spend a period of time in Gothenburg.

Only a limited number of appointments will be made through this highly selective programme. Candidates will be assessed not only on their academic achievements and international standing, but also on their potential to contribute to the development of Chalmers’ academic environments and international position.

Expression of interest/application

If you are interested in exploring a Visiting Professor appointment at Chalmers, please submit an expression of interest including:

A brief cover letter describing:

    your motivation for applying for the visiting professorship;
    your proposed area(s) of collaboration and suggested research group(s).
    the part(s) of Chalmers' research, education, innovation, or other activities to which you would like to contribute; and
    your preferred timing and duration of the visit
    a short CV with selected key publications and major grants or honours
    a statement (1–2 pages) describing how you envision contributing to Chalmers’ development and its long‑term vision.

Applications will be evaluated by relevant departments after the application deadline. Shortlisted candidates will then be invited for a first digital interview.

Application deadline: August 15, 2026

Please note: Due to EU regulations (GDPR), we cannot accept applications via e-mail. Please register your application through the apply button below.

A background check may be conducted as part of the application process.

Welcome with your application.

Contact

For questions, please contact The Recruitment Unit at: rekr.stodet@chalmers.se

*** Chalmers declines to consider all offers of further announcement publishing or other types of support for the recruiting process in connection with this position. ***

Working at Chalmers

Chalmers provides a dynamic and inspiring environment in the coastal city of Gothenburg, combining academic excellence with a strong commitment to sustainability, equality, and collaboration.





Read more about working at Chalmers and our employee benefits. Learn more about life in Gothenburg and Sweden’s family-friendly policies, including generous parental leave, subsidized childcare, free education, and universal healthcare, at Move To Gothenburg.





Chalmers promotes gender balance and actively works with equality and inclusion initiatives, such as the GENIE Initiative for gender equality and excellence.

jobs.title: Anställning som postdoktor vid BKV
jobs.description:
Vi har kraften från över 50 000 studenter och medarbetare. Studenter som ger framtidshopp. Medarbetare som varje dag bidrar till att Linköpings universitet tar sig an samtidens utmaningar. Vår värdegrund vilar på trovärdighet, tillit och trygghet. Genom att vara modiga, tänka fritt och göra nytt skapar vi tillsammans, med stora och små handlingar, en bättre framtid. Välkommen att söka jobb hos oss!

Dina arbetsuppgifter

Du kommer bedriva forskning på bröstmjölkens innehåll i relation till kliniskt utfall med fokus på komplikationer hos extremt för tidigt födda barn. Det innefattar laborativa analyser på extracellulära vesiklar, micrRNA, proteomics och oxylipiner, men kan omfatta andra analyser beroende på hur det vetenskapliga fältet utvecklas. Det kan komma att ingå patientnära arbete, bl.a. när donatorer ska rekryteras och prover samplas in. I arbetsuppgifterna kan även analys och färdigställande av vetenskapliga artiklar baserade på redan insamlat material i forskningsgruppen ingå.

Som postdoktor kommer du i huvudsak bedriva forskning. Även undervisning kan ingå i arbetsuppgifterna, dock till högst en femtedel av arbetstiden.

Dina kvalifikationer

För att vara behörig till anställning som postdoktor har du avlagt doktorsexamen eller har en utländsk examen som bedöms motsvara doktorsexamen. Din examen ska vara avlagd senast vid tidpunkten då anställningsbeslutet fattas.

Det är meriterande om din examen är avlagd högst tre år före sista ansökningsdag för denna anställning. Om det finns särskilda skäl kan den komma i fråga som avlagt doktorsexamen tidigare, exempelvis vid olika typer av lagstadgade ledigheter.

Vi söker dig som har doktorsexamen inom medicinsk vetenskap. Det är ett krav att ha bedrivit laborativa studier på bröstmjölk samt ha erfarenhet av bioinformatik och/eller genomgått kurs i bioinformatik. Utöver det är det ett krav att kunna tala och skriva såväl svenska som engelska flytande. Det är meriterande att självständigt ha sökt och erhållit forskningsanslag under det senaste året.

Du är initiativrik i ditt arbete och har förmåga att koordinera labbarbete såväl i dina enskilda projekt som i hela forskningsgruppens arbete. Du är beredd på att hjälpa kollegor i forskningsgruppen både med labuppgifter och administrativt arbete. Du har förmåga att självständigt skriva forskningsartiklar och presentera dina resultat på vetenskapliga möten.

Din arbetsplats

Du kommer att arbeta på https://liu.se/organisation/liu/bkv/bkh, som ligger under https://liu.se/organisation/liu/bkv. Vi samarbetar med flera forskningsgrupper på Campus US och du kommer att vara placerad i professor https://liu.se/medarbetare/marje18 forskningsgrupp. Det ingår även ett tätt samarbete med kliniker, särskilt på H.K.H Kronprinsessan Victorias barn- och ungdomssjukhus i Linköping. Tack vare detta välutbyggda samarbete bedriver vi mycket framgångsrik translationell forskning.

Om anställningen

Anställningen är en tidsbegränsad anställning på två år med möjlighet till förlängning med en sammanlagd anställningstid om högst tre år. Anställningen som postdoktor är på heltid.

Tillträde enligt överenskommelse.

Lön och förmåner

Universitetet tillämpar individuell lönesättning, lämna löneanspråk i din ansökan.

Läs mer om förmåner för anställda https://liu.se/jobba-pa-liu/formaner

Fackliga kontaktpersoner

Information om fackliga kontaktpersoner, se https://liu.se/jobba-pa-liu/hjalp-for-sokande.

Ansökan

Du söker denna anställning genom att klicka på knappen "Ansök" nedan. Din ansökan ska vara Linköpings universitet tillhanda senast den 1 september 2026. Ansökan som inkommer efter sista ansökningsdag beaktas ej.

Vi välkomnar sökande med olika bakgrund, erfarenheter och perspektiv, det berikar och utvecklar vår verksamhet. För oss är det självklart att värna om allas lika värde, rättigheter och möjligheter. Läs om vårt arbete med https://liu.se/artikel/lika-villkor/.

Välkommen med din ansökan!

Linköpings universitet har upphandlade avtal och undanber oss direktkontakt från bemannings- och rekryteringsföretag samt försäljare av platsannonser.

jobs.title: Senior Manager Scientific Engagement
jobs.description:
Join us to deliver a smoke- free future as Senior Manager Scientific Engagement!

We’ve chosen to do something remarkable. We’re totally transforming our business and building our future with one clear purpose – to deliver a smoke-free future. Swedish Match is an affiliate of PMI and has been a leader in the industry for more than 200 years.

In the Nordic region, we are around 1,800 employees based in Sweden, Denmark, Finland and Norway and together we are collaborating to deliver a smoke-free Nordics.



Role summary:

As Senior Manager Scientific Engagement, you will lead initiatives that use scientific evidence to support appropriate regulation and increase understanding of tobacco harm reduction and smoke-free products. You will build trusted relationships with key opinion leaders, shape clear and compelling scientific narratives, and engage regulators, the scientific community, and wider society through forums, conferences, publications, and other channels. You will also act as the local focal point for pre- and post-marketing scientific matters.



This role can be based in either Stockholm, Copenhagen or Olso.



Key responsibilities:

    Develop and drive the Nordic Scientific Engagement Strategy to support appropriate regulation and understanding of tobacco harm reduction.
    Develop the scientific communication strategy and localized narrative based on recent scientific developments and current and emerging external and internal needs.
    Build and maintain a network of international and local key opinion leaders to foster advocacy and support for tobacco harm reduction.
    Provide guidance, coaching, and training on the science of smoke-free products across the organization.
    Drive function-level projects and initiatives focused on developing and implementing new processes or standards both within and outside the function.
    Navigate complex tobacco and nicotine regulatory issues through rigorous analysis and cross-functional collaboration.
    Refine and improve existing scientific engagement processes through innovative problem-solving and conceptualizing new approaches to operational challenges.
    Drive the implementation of AI-tools in Scientific Engagement.
    Ensure compliance with relevant national legalization and global policies regarding scientific activities around tobacco and nicotine.



Who you are:

    Academic background in life sciences, public health, pharmacy, medicine, toxicology, regulatory science, or a related field
    5+ years of experience in a scientific, medical, regulatory, public affairs, or external engagement role.
    Experience working in a highly regulated industry, such as tobacco/nicotine, pharmaceuticals, medtech, healthcare, food, or chemicals.
    Proven ability to translate complex scientific evidence into clear, engaging messages for different audiences.
    Experience engaging with external partners, such as regulators, scientific experts, public health stakeholders or industry bodies.
    Experience working in a cross-functional and international/matrix environment.
    Excellent written and verbal communication skills in English and at least one Scandinavian language.
    Agile and confident to work in areas with uncertainty and a rapidly moving external environment.
    Willing to travel across the Nordics and to international events.
    High confidence in representing a company, which could initially be perceived as controversial, in external forums, meetings, conferences, or public-facing discussions.



To be successful in this role, you are an influential communicator with strong project management skills and the ability to translate complex scientific concepts into clear, engaging messages. You collaborate effectively across functions in a matrixed organization and can communicate confidently with a wide range of stakeholders, including scientists, clinicians, lawyers, government officials, and business leaders, in both written and spoken formats.

What we offer

Our success depends on the dedicated people who come to work every single day with a sense of purpose and an appetite for progress. Join Swedish Match and you too can:

    Seize the freedom to define your future and ours. We’ll empower you to take risks, experiment and explore.
    Be part of an inclusive, diverse culture, where everyone’s contribution is respected; collaborate with some of the world’s best people and feel like you belong.
    Enjoy flexibility of hybrid way of working - split your time between working from our office or the comfort of your home, where it works best for you in line with business needs.
    Pursue your ambitions and develop your skills with a global business – our staggering size and scale provide endless opportunities to progress.
    Take pride in delivering our promise to society: to deliver a smoke-free future.

jobs.title: Crunched (YC-backed 25)- Growth Manager
jobs.description:
Crunched - Growth Manager (Oslo)

Location: Oslo, Norway (forward-deployed with customers, regular international travel)

Type: Full-time

Compensation: Competitive salary + equity

Stage: YC-backed, 55M NOK seed, building our core team out of Oslo

Define how the world's largest advisory firms adopt AI

Crunched is building the world's most powerful AI analyst for strategy and corporate finance workflows -- autonomous, agent-based AI that works directly inside Excel, where half of the world's business decisions are made. We're backed by Y Combinator, raised 55M NOK in seed funding, and our product is already trusted by professionals at firms like BCG, BDO, CBRE, Dentsu, Pareto, PwC, INSEAD and Harvard.

Why Crunched can win

Large AI platforms like Anthropic are serious competitors. Crunched is different because we build deeply for the top 1--2% of Excel power users and their highly specific workflows. In every direct customer evaluation against competing products so far, Crunched has won on quality. First Round heard pitches from 75 AI-for-Excel startups over the past year---and chose to invest in Crunched.

We're growing extremely quickly inside large international accounts. The Growth Manager is our most important hire right now -- the first dedicated go-to-market and customer success role at the company. You'll be embedded with our biggest customers across countries: developing the accounts, driving adoption, and building custom workflows alongside the people who use Crunched every day.

This is a core position. Being forward-deployed with customers is at the heart of how we build.

What you'll do

  • Own and grow our most strategic enterprise accounts from day one

  • Onboard new customers, teams and offices, and drive real adoption and ROI

  • Expand usage inside large advisory firms -- new offices, new teams, new use cases (for example, rolling Crunched out across new PwC offices)

  • Work closely with our tech team, turning what you learn in the field into bespoke solutions and product improvements

  • Build custom workflows alongside the analysts and consultants who use Crunched daily

  • Help open new markets across Europe, with Germany a key focus

  • Build the customer success / growth function and team as we scale

Who you are

  • Real drive and unrelenting structure -- you operate independently and own outcomes end-to-end

  • A strong interest in AI and how it is reshaping knowledge work

  • The judgment and presence to work with senior stakeholders at the world's largest advisory firms

  • Comfortable being forward-deployed and traveling to customers across borders

Best fit

A background in MBB-style management consulting , or several years in customer success at a high standard. Prior growth or customer success experience is preferred, but a strong consulting or finance background is a major asset -- it gives you credibility and a deep understanding of how our customers actually work. Experience from a customer-type firm (e.g. BDO, CBRE, Dentsu, Pareto, PwC) is a strong plus.


What you get

  • Ownership of our most important accounts from day one

  • A mandate to define how the world's largest advisory firms adopt AI

  • The opportunity to build the function and team as we scale

  • A hands-on product that delivers real productivity and ROI -- with genuine differentiators like EU data residency and best-in-class PowerPoint generation

  • Very competitive compensation: salary + equity from day one, with additional upside tied to our largest accounts open for discussion

  • Regular travel to customers across borders

Working model

Based in our Oslo office, forward-deployed with customers and traveling regularly across Norway and Europe. If you want to be close to customers and the core team while building something at high speed, this is for you.

jobs.title: Project Controller
jobs.description:
Kongsberg Maritime is looking for a Project Controller to join our Energy & Control, Finance team. In this role, you will play a key part in ensuring strong financial control and support throughout the lifecycle of our projects.

As Project Controller, you will work closely with Project Managers and colleagues across Finance, Sales, Delivery and Product management. You will contribute to delivering high-quality financial insights, maintaining project profitability, and supporting successful project execution.


What you will be doing
• Be an active member of the Project Controller team
• Establish projects in ERP systems and maintain project budgets
• Perform invoicing and crediting activities
• Support month-end closing activities, including revenue and cost recognition
• Prepare monthly project reporting and participate in project reviews
• Identify and evaluate financial risks and opportunities
• Provide financial support and analysis to project teams and stakeholders
• Contribute to continuous improvement and other ad hoc tasks within the Finance team

We're looking for someone who's service-minded, flexible, and eager for new challenges. If, you are someone who loves being given responsibility and can communicate clearly, we would like to hear from you!

We are continuously reviewing applications, apply today!


We think you should have
• Bachelor's degree in Finance, Accounting, Economics or a related field
• Understanding of commercial and contractual aspects of project business
• Strong Excel skills and experience working with ERP systems
• Experience from a similar finance or project controlling role is an advantage
• Good written and verbal communication skills in English

At Kongsberg Maritime, we believe that diversity fuels innovation. We encourage you to apply, even if you do not meet every requirement. Your unique perspective is valuable to us. Your skills, attitude and perspective could be exactly what we are looking for!


You are able to
• act on own initiative, make things happen and accept responsibility for the results.
• focus on bottom-line results, identify potential risks and monitor the financial impact of own activities.
• comply with company rules and procedures and execute plans with commitment and determination.
• use a methodical and systematic approach, plan ahead, define clear priorities and allocate resources effectively.
• communicate in a clear, precise and structured way.
• co-operate well with others, share knowledge, experience, information and support others in the pursuit of team goals.
If you're ready to take on this exciting challenge, apply now and become a part of our team!

This employment may require a pre-employment check procedure in accordance with company security standards, role or site requirements. Please note that this might affect the offer process or employment.


What we can offer you
With us, you will be offered a competitive salary and benefits package, along with development opportunities in an international environment. We offer flexible working hours, good pension & insurance schemes, and an inclusive supportive work environment. You will have the opportunity to work with sustainable and forward-looking solutions in the maritime industry.

Work location
Kongsberg, Sandefjord, Horten.

Point of contact
Liv Frøvold, Manager Project Controlling, +47 909 92 865. liv.frovold@km.kongsberg.com.


Kongsberg Maritime is a global leader in maritime technology. We deliver advanced solutions to the merchant fleet, offshore, fishing, and naval vessels, setting new standards for safe, efficient, and sustainable operations - both for new builds and existing fleets. In close collaboration with customers and research environments, we develop technology that solves real challenges at sea. Today, more than 30,000 vessels operate with our systems on board. Kongsberg Maritime has more than 8,300 employees in 35 countries.

Technologies for sustainable oceans

Energy & Control brings together Kongsberg Maritime’s strengths in Vessel Automation & Sensing Solutions, Offshore Production, Ship Design & Integration, Bridge & Remote and Electrical Systems to deliver smart, integrated solutions across the ocean space. From single products to fully integrated systems, we help customers improve efficiency, reliability and sustainability, enabling the maritime energy transition. Our global teams operate end-to-end, from sales through product development and engineering to project execution - making us a trusted partner for yards, ship owners and operators across segments.

You can read our privacy statement here: https://www.kongsbergmaritime.com/privacy/.

jobs.title: Welders, Southern Finland
jobs.description:
Skilled Welders Needed Across Southern Finland!

Are you an experienced welder looking to take the next step in your career? Join Wellpack and work on exciting and diverse welding projects in Southern Finland.

We are currently looking for skilled welders for several locations, including Vantaa, Raasepori, Vihti, Karkkila and Salo.

What we are looking for:

Welding experience:
Previous professional experience in TIG and/or MIG/MAG welding. Experience working with materials such as stainless steel, aluminium and carbon steel is considered an advantage.

Ability to read technical drawings:
You should be able to interpret technical drawings and work independently according to the provided specifications.

Language skills:
You must be able to communicate in Finnish, Swedish or English.

Quality-focused attitude:
We value a proactive and responsible approach to work, attention to detail and a strong commitment to occupational safety and quality.

Right to work in Finland:
Applicants must have a valid residence permit or other valid right to work in Finland.

Welding test:
Before starting employment, the selected candidates must successfully complete a welding test.

What we offer:

Competitive salary:
Your salary will be determined based on your professional skills, experience and the requirements of the position.

Career development opportunities:
Many of our positions offer the possibility of long-term employment and permanent career opportunities.

Diverse and challenging projects:
You will have the opportunity to work on varied projects and further develop your professional welding skills.

Assistance with accommodation:
Wellpack can help you find suitable accommodation near the workplace. We can also assist with practical arrangements related to relocation.

Excellent working conditions:
You will work in a safe and supportive environment as part of a professional and friendly team.

Ready to join us?

Take the next step in your welding career and become part of our skilled team in Southern Finland!

Submit your application through our recruitment system and tell us about your welding experience, preferred location and the type of position you are looking for.

jobs.title: AD Sales Representative (EX-Googler)
jobs.description:
We are looking for an AD Sales Representative for the world’s leading search engine company in Stockholm. This is the consultant assignment starting in early August and 12 months ahead. Priority to Ex-Googlers who have experience with Google products

As an Account Executive Ad Sales, you practice and embody selling in both internal and customer settings. You use your working knowledge of advertising and your industry vertical to help your team identify and enable longer-term opportunities, account-level strategy, and annual activation plans, and to develop new customer relationships and new revenue streams. You support your team in sales strategy development, pitching, customer relationship growth, and opportunity sizing. You contribute to cross-team collaborations to support customer growth, align on opportunity/project timelines and goals, and ensure solutions are presented to customers. You develop relationships with customers, acting as a point of contact.

Experience:

    5 years of industry experience in digital advertising, consultative sales,business development, or digital marketing, or 6 years of experience with an advanced degree. Experience working with advertisers, agencies, or clients.
    Experience with digital media planning and managing advertising budgets and campaigns, with focus on performance and omnichannel marketing including measurement strategies and an understanding of the retail landscape.
    Ability to achieve sales goals to drive business growth, by building compelling narratives and utilizing storytelling based on business strategies and marketing objectives.
    Ability to navigate and influence organizations to shape aligned strategies and road map, and drive decisions and growth.
    Ability to build a trusted and meaningful relationship with customers, C-level and executive leadership.

Responsibilities include:

    Help serve as a strategic partner to customers to manage and analyze customer interactions and data to improve customer service relationships, assist in customer retention, and drive sales growth.
    Support identification of revenue and growth opportunities within the market and customer. Partner with internal stakeholders to determine and drive the sales, revenue growth, potential of opportunities, and marketing efficiency, as well as the incremental investment recommended to achieve customer business outcomes.
    Help draw interpretable insights from deep dives and data analysis, provide data-driven strategic and tactical recommendations to customers, partner teams, and leadership based on analysis and utilize insights to influence others and drive change.
    Support the development of strategies and tactics for creating account plans in collaboration with internal stakeholders and adjust plans as appropriate.
    Support team in identifying customer business objectives and setting sales strategies for specific markets and customers in collaboration with internal partners (e.g., account managers, product specialists) based on research and understanding of the customer.
    Continuously build knowledge and stay current on the advertising environment and competitive landscape through required training and other resources.
    drive key contributions to sharing and scaling of successes, opportunities for improvement, best practices, and learnings internally and externally as appropriate (e.g., case studies, industry events, training contributions).
    Create joint business plans for new business customers based upon client business objectives to help create deeper relationships with key stakeholders, with limited guidance. Ensure progress is being made against revenue goals.
    Start to develop a network with a function locally. Support opportunities to collaborate internally to strengthen internal communication.
    Help serve as a strategic partner to customers to build, grow, and maintain high impact and long-lasting relationships with customers by understanding the client´s opportunities and challenges. Share point of view on industry insights, consumer trends, and best practices to help strengthen and grow relationships.
    Help act as a point of contact for customers/agencies around all key areas (e.g., training, product enhancement, global/regional campaigns). Support cross-functional effort to identify, escalate and solve customer issues with limited guidance.
    Support team in crafting and delivering solutions to customers and agencies to achieve customer business objectives and drive revenue growth.

jobs.title: Myynti- ja turvaratkaisujen asiantuntija
jobs.description:
**Haluatko myyntityön, jossa päiväsi eivät kulu kylmäsoittoihin tai asiakkaiden perässä juoksemiseen? Etsimme nyt myynti- ja turvaratkaisujen asiantuntijoita rooliin, jossa tärkein tehtäväsi on auttaa asiakkaita suojaamaan kotinsa ja yrityksensä Verisuren palveluilla.**

**Jos nautit tavoitteellisesta myynnistä, kaupan syntymisen tunteesta sekä asiakaskohtaamisista,rooli on juuri sinua varten.**

Myynti ja turvaratkaisujen asiantuntijanamme et lähde liikkeelle tyhjästä. Jokaiselle päivällesi rakennetaan valmiiksi laadukkaita myyntimahdollisuuksia sovittujen asiakastapaamisten, nykyasiakaskäyntien sekä huoltojen ja asennusten kautta. Tavoitteena on yksinkertaisesti luoda mahdollisimman paljon onnistuneita kohtaamisia ja kauppoja.

Tarjoamme sinulle 1500 € kuukausittaisen pohjapalkan, kannustavan palkkiomallin sekä Suomen tunnetuimman ja luotetuimman turvapalvelun myytäväksesi. Kun vahva brändi, toimiva konsepti ja jatkuva asiakasvirta yhdistyy, sinulle syntyy erinomaiset mahdollisuudet vaikuttaa omalla tekemiselläsi ansiotasoosi.

**Mitä tarjoamme sinulle?**

- **Varma pohjapalkka & motivoivat komissiot:** Tarjoamme sinulle **jatkuvan pohjapalkan 1500€/kk** sekä kannustavat ja motivoivat komissiot: uusista hankituista asiakkaista saat keskimäärin n. **300-400€ myyntikomission.**

- **Lämpimät asiakaskohtaamiset:** Varmistamme sinulle riittävästi monipuolisia myynniin mahdollisuuksia niin valmiiksi sovittujen asiakastapaamisten kuin nykyasiakkailla tapahtuvien käyntien muodossa.


- **Perehdytyksen, jota on hiottu yli 30 vuoden ajan:** Olemme kehittäneet koulutustamme sekä perehdytystämme pitkään, joten saat käyttöösi vinkit, neuvot ja tuen, joiden avulla onnistumisesi on vain sinusta itsestäsi kiinni.

- **Autoetu:** Saat käyttöösi auton, jolla ajat niin työ- kuin vapaa-ajallasi.

- **Eteneminen**: Kaikki myynnin esihenkilömme ovat aloittaneet myyjinä. Saat konkreettisen mahdollisuuden rakentaa uraasi eteenpäin. Sales Manager Naneten tarinaan pääse tutustumaan urasivujemme blogiosiosta (www.verisure.fi/ura).

- **Best Place to Work sertifioidun organisaation.** Sijoituimme Suomen keskisuurten yritysten sarjassa parhaimpien joukkoon. Katso urasivujemme blogiosiosta (www.verisure.fi/ura) myyjiemme kokemuksia Verisurella työskentelemisestä.


**Mitä päiväsi myynti- ja turvaratkaisujen asiantuntijana tarkemmin pitää sisällään?**

Tyypillinen työpäiväsi alkaa esimerkiksi klo 10:00 tapaamisella, jossa asiakas odottaa sinua luoksensa. Onnistut tapaamisella vakuuttamaan hänet palvelusta, ja pääset sopimaan järjestelmän asennuksen heti huomiselle. Jatkat tästä päivääsi toisen asiakkaasi luokse, jossa suoritat hänen järjestelmänsä huollon. Järjestelmän huollon yhteydessä tarjoat parasta mahdollista palvelua ja selvität, onko asiakkaalla muita suojaamista kaipaavia kohteita, tai mahdollisesti tuttuja, joille hän haluaisi palvelua suositella.

Päiväsi jatkuu mökkikohteella, jonne toteutat asennuksen, jonka olit sopinut viime viikolla turvattuasi ensin asiakkaan kotikohteen. Asennusten ja huoltojen yhteydessä kontaktoit myös lähialueen talot kartoittaaksesi uusia mahdollisia asiakkaita.

Viikkosi koostuu monipuolisesti erilaisista kohtaamisista niin uusien kuin nykyisten asiakkaiden kanssa, sisältäen tapaamisia, asennuksia, huoltoja ja lähialueen suoraa asiakaskontaktointia. Tärkein tehtäväsi on siis toteuttaa mahdollisimman monen uuden kodin ja yritystilan suojaaminen Verisuren palvelulla.

**Työaikasi on pääsääntöisesti ma–pe klo 10:00–18:00.** Työ on aktiivista kenttätyötä, joten tiimipalavereja ja koulutuksia lukuun ottamatta toimit pääsääntöisesti kentällä asiakkaidesi luona.

**Voisiko tämä olla sinun seuraava uramahdollisuus?**

Tehtävässä menestyminen edellyttää vahvaa motivaatiota tavoitteellista myyntityötä kohtaan sekä erinomaisia vuorovaikutustaitoja. Aiemmat näytöt suoramyynnin parista katsotaan eduksesi, mutta ne eivät ole välttämättömyys. Työssä tehtävät asennukset ja huollot eivät vaadi aiempaa kokemusta, sillä koulutamme sinut niihin.

**Tehtävässä edellytämme sinulta:**

- Ajokorttia: Tarvitset B-kortin (manuaali) ja täysikäisyyttä.


- Sujuvia vuorovaikutustaitoja suomen kielellä.


- Pystyt työskentelemään joustavasti arkisin 10:00-18:00 välillä.


- Tausta: Edellytämme on nuhteetonta rikostaustaa (edellytys turvasuojaajakortille).


**Kun kyse on työpaikasta, melko hyvä ei riitä. Parasta olla Verisure.**

Jos uusi myyntiroolimme sytytti kiinnostukseksi, klikkaa linkkiä, jätä CV sekä yhteystietosi, jonka jälkeen olemme sinuun yhteydessä. Paikat täytetään heti sopivien henkilöiden löydyttyä.Lisätietoja tehtävästä voit tarvittaessa tiedustella rekrytiimiltä sähköpostitse osoitteesta rekry@verisure.fi

Katso tulevien kollegoidesi ajatuksia urasivuiltamme ja lisätiedot sosiaalisesti mediasta Instagramista & TikTokista @verisurelaiset.

jobs.title: Associate Professor in Geomechanics and Geohazards
jobs.description:
About the Department and what they are looking for in this position

We invite applications for a full time position as Associate Professor in Geomechanics & Geohazards is available at the Department of Geosciences.

The Department of Geosciences (GEO) at the University of Oslo is part of the Faculty of Mathematics and Natural Science and is a leading research unit in Europe. The Department covers a wide breadth of topics, from mantle and lithosphere dynamics on Earth and other planets, via surface processes in the boundary layers between Earth’s surface and atmosphere, to the dynamics and interactions in the Earth's crust, soils, hydrosphere, atmosphere, and biosphere.

The Department of Geosciences has defined a strategy focusing on four main themes that cut across the Department:

1.    Dynamics of the solid Earth and planets
2.    Climate change and the coupled Earth system
3.    Environmental geosciences
4.    Geoscience in the Arctic

The Department aims to contribute to the United Nations Sustainable Development Goals and hosts important contributors to the IPCC (UN Intergovernmental Panel on Climate Change).

The staff consists of approximately 40 professors and associate professors, in addition to postdoctoral fellows, PhD candidates, researchers, and technical and administrative staff. In total, the Department currently has around 200 employees, one Centre of Excellence and, at present, seven grants from the European Research Council (ERC), along with numerous other grants from public and private institutions. The Department is organized in six sections:

  • Basin Studies
  • Crustal Processes
  • Centre for Planetary Habitability [PHAB, Centre of Excellence]
  • Environmental Geoscience
  • Physical Geography and Hydrology
  • Meteorology and Oceanography

and a group in geoscience didactics. The Department offers two bachelor study programmes “Geology and Geography” and “Geophysics and Climate” and one MSc-programme in “Geosciences”. 

This position is primarily associated with the Crustal Processes section that mostly works with geological processes related to rock deformation (fracture, friction, creep), fluid flow in crustal rocks (water, gas, magma), and fluid-rock interactions. Researchers develop studies from the atomic scale to the lithospheric scale, with applications in the domains of Solid Earth geohazards, porous media, critical raw materials, and large-scale tectonics. Research in the section uses field work, analytical and imaging techniques, modelling, data science, and experiments, and aims to unravel the processes that shape the evolution of the Earth’s crust, and their effects on the environment. The section consists of 40 people, and at present is organised under a Faculty centre between Geoscience and Physics (Njord Centre).


General information about the position

Applicants must document academic qualifications in their field at a level equivalent to an Associate Professor. The position will be based at the University of Oslo. The successful candidate must be able to teach at all levels and supervise Master’s and PhD students. The successful candidate may also be required to take on other teaching duties and administrative tasks when requested by the Department or the Faculty of Mathematics and Natural Sciences. The working time in the position is divided approximately as follows: 45% research, 45% education, and 10% administrative tasks.

The position is closely linked to the Department’s strategy by contributing to “research-based knowledge with societal relevance linked to climate, environment, energy, natural hazards, and sustainable use of resources”. The duties therefore include research, teaching, supervision, and dissemination/communication within both geomechanics and geohazards. The position will serve as a link between the Department’s expertise in various research fields relevant to geohazards (including geophysics, geomechanics, geomorphology, hydrology, hydrogeology and environmental geology). One of our aims is to advance the understanding of slow and rapid rock mass and granular material movements by developing and applying advanced methods and models that contribute to solving fundamental scientific and societal challenges related to geohazards.


Your main tasks will be

Your main research-related tasks will be:

  • Conduct cutting-edge fundamental research with broad international impact in geomechanics with applications to geohazards (earthquakes, landslides, and other gravitational instabilities).
  • Develop advanced numerical models for improving the simulation, the analysis, and the prediction of geohazards, as well as the application of tools and concepts from other disciplines (e.g. physics, data science) to geomechanics.
  • Attract substantial external research funding (e.g., from EU Horizon programmes, the Research Council of Norway, the Norwegian Directorate for Water Resources and Energy, and related funding bodies).
  • Promote collaboration with external partners such as the Norwegian Geotechnical Institute (NGI), the Norwegian Seismic Array (NORSAR), and other relevant institutions.
     

Your main teaching-related tasks will be to actively contribute to teaching at both bachelor’s and master’s level in topics related to geomechanics and geohazards, including landslides in granular materials and water/rock interactions. At present, the following 10 ECTS courses are offered at the Department of Geosciences: 

  • GEO3034 (Geohazards)
  • GEO4131 (Geomechanics) 
  • GEO4151 (Earthquakes and Volcanoes)
  • GEO4171 (Floods, Avalanches, Landslides) 

The candidate is expected to take primary responsibility for up to two courses and supervise master’s theses in these subject areas. Course responsibility does not imply giving all lectures, but to organise lectures and lab-exercises in the course. Experience and/or interest in fieldwork is also desirable.

We expect mainly physical attendance at the University of Oslo.


More information about the position

Applicants must document academic qualifications in their field, equivalent to an Associate professor position. The successful applicant must be able to teach at all levels and to supervise Master and PhD students. 

The successful applicant may furthermore be required to take on other teaching duties and administrative tasks, by request from the Department or the Faculty of Mathematics and Natural Sciences. 


What skills are important in this role?

Assessment of candidates will be based on scientific and educational excellence, as for example reflected in the quality of peer-reviewed publications, scientific relevance, ability to attract external funding, and other evidence of impact. The main emphasis will be on the candidate’s performance during the last five years. We expect the candidate having a scientific track record at a high international level that demonstrates the ability to fund and lead research projects.

Required qualifications:

  • The successful applicant must have completed a PhD in geology, geomechanics, or geophysics or related fields, with a focus on e.g., geomechanics, structural geology, civil engineering or geomorphology. 
  • Documented post-doctoral or equivalent experience and a strong scientific track record within areas of the mechanics of geomaterials (solid rocks and/or granular materials), computational methods in mechanics or geophysics, and solid earth geohazards including earthquakes, landslides and other gravitational instabilities.
  • Ability to collaborate across scientific disciplines.
  • Documented potential for acquisition of external research funding.
  • Pedagogical qualifications and teaching and supervision experience at all levels will be an important factor in the evaluation process and should be well documented in a teaching portfolio. The applicant should describe her/his qualifications in view of the Scholarship of Teaching and Learning (SoTL) framework which includes:
    • Focus on student learning
    • A clear development over time
    • A researching approach
    • A collegial attitude and practice
  • The successful candidate who at the time of appointment cannot document sufficient teaching qualifications (minimum formal requirement is a 200 hours pedagogical programme) will be required to obtain such qualifications within a two-year period.
  • The successful candidate must demonstrate mastery of both English and one of the Scandinavian languages as working languages, in order to be able to teach and otherwise be able to participate in all functions the position may involve. If the successful candidate does not have sufficient mastery of a Scandinavian language, B2 level, the candidate will be required to learn sufficient Norwegian within  three years of employment.

Desired qualifications:

  • Candidates should be able to establish, lead and conduct research projects, also as a collaborator. 
  • An international network, experience with outreach activities, collegiality, and the ability to contribute to a good working environment.
  • Experience in scientific and administrative management, as the person appointed will be expected to take on some administrative duties.
  • Additional competences in experimental and applied and/or field studies will be considered an advantage.

All candidates and projects will have to undergo a check versus national export, sanctions and security regulations. Candidates may be excluded based on these checks. Primary checkpoints are the Export Control regulation, the Sanctions regulation, and the national security regulation.


What are we looking for in you?

Personal skills:

  • Ability to create and contribute to a well-functioning, inclusive and productive research environment
  • Strong networking skills, ability to collaborate and conduct scientific leadership
  • Ability to cooperate and communicate well with other members of staff

The successful candidate should have an international profile with respect to the above criteria. The candidate for this position will be selected based on excellence and fit with the section’s research profile.


We can offer you
  • Exciting and meaningful tasks in an organization with an important societal mission, contributing to knowledge development, education, and enlightenment that promote sustainable, fair, and knowledge-based societal development.
  • Committed colleagues in a good working environment. 
  • Good welfare schemes.
  • Opportunity of up to 1.5 hours a week of exercise during working hours.  A workplace with good development and career opportunities.
  • Membership in the Statens Pensjonskasse, which is one of Norway's best pension schemes with beneficial mortgages and good insurance schemes.
  • Salary in position as Associate Professor (position code 1011) in salary range NOK from 850 000 - to 950 000, depending on competence and experience. From the salary, two % is deducted in statutory contributions to the State Pension Fund. 

Inclusive work life and diversity at UiO

UiO is an open and internationally-oriented university that strives to be an inclusive and diverse workplace and academic environment. You can read more about UiO’s work on equality, inclusion, and diversity at UiO's policy for diversity, equality and inclusion - University of Oslo.

We fulfill our mission most effectively when we draw upon our variety of experiences, backgrounds, and perspectives. We are looking for great colleagues, could you be the next one? We will do our best to accommodate your needs. Relevant adjustments may include modifications to working hours, task adaptations, digital, technical, or physical adjustments, or other practical measures. 

We especially encourage women to apply.

If you have an immigrant background, a disability, or CV gaps (Norwegian), we encourage you to indicate this in the job application portal. We always invite at least one qualified candidate from each group for an interview. In this context, disability is defined as an applicant who identifies as having a disability that requires workplace or employment-related accommodations. 

The selections made in the job application portal are used for anonymized statistics that all state employers include in their annual reports.

More information about gender equality initiatives at UiO can be found here.


How to apply

The application must include:

  • Application letter
  • A research position paper (max. 5 pages) describing the applicant’s vision and scientific ambitions for the nearest future
  • A detailed CV, including a complete list of education, positions, pedagogical experience, administrative management, project acquisition and coordination experience, and other qualifying activities.
  • Copies of educational certificates, PhD diploma, transcript of records and letters of recommendation
  • A complete list of publications and academic merits and awards (if not included in the CV)
  • Full text of up to 10 selected scientific publications the applicant wishes to include in the evaluation
  • A document discussing the importance, interrelation, and relevance of the selected papers for this position
  • Educational portfolio of 3–6 pages documenting educational competence and experience, including a reflection note in which your own teaching practice and view of learning is anchored in the SoTL framework (focus on student learning, development over time, a researching approach and a collegial attitude and practice) 
  • List of reference persons: 2–3 references (name, relation to candidate, e-mail and phone number)

Application with attachments must be submitted via our recruitment system Jobbnorge, click "Apply for this job".

When applying for the position, we ask you to retrieve your education results from Vitnemålsportalen.no. If your education results are not available through Vitnemålsportalen, we ask you to upload copies of your transcripts or grades. Please note that all documentation must be in English or a Scandinavian language.


General information

As a general rule an interview will be used in the appointment process, usually supplemented with a trial teaching session. The basis for assessment will be the scientific production of the applicant, the teaching portfolio, pedagogical and educational qualifications, the applicant’s qualifications within leadership and administration, other qualifications as well as general personal suitability for the position. In ranking the competent applicants, the full range of qualifications will be considered and explicitly assessed.

Rules for appointments to associate professorships. 
https://www.uio.no/english/about/regulations/personnel/academic/rules-appointment-professor.html

Rules for the assessment and weighting of pedagogical competence for appointments to permanent academic posts which include teaching duties: 
https://www.uio.no/english/about/regulations/personnel/academic/rules-basic-pedagogical-competence.html

Guide for applicants for Professor and Associate professor positions - University of Oslo https://www.uio.no/english/about/regulations/personnel/academic/guide-applicants.html

According to the Norwegian Freedom and Information Act (Offentleglova), information about the applicant may be included in the public applicant list, also in cases where the applicant has requested non-disclosure.

The University of Oslo has an agreement for all employees, aiming to secure rights to research results, see: http://www.uio.no/english/for-employees/employment/work-results/


Om arbeidsgiveren:

The University of Oslo is Norway’s oldest and highest rated institution of research and education with 26 500 students and 7 200 employees. Its broad range of academic disciplines and internationally esteemed research communities make UiO an important contributor to society. 

The geosciences are the studies of the planet Earth and its comparative planetology; the atmosphere, the hydrosphere and cryosphere, the Earth's surface and its interior. The Department of Geosciences conducts research and teaching in most of the domains of geoscience; geology, geophysics, physical geography, geomatics, hydrology, meteorology and oceanography. The Department is the broadest geoscience research and education environment in Norway. We perform research at a high international standard and have five ERC (European Research Council) research projects ongoing.

The Department encompasses six scientific sections; Meteorology and Oceanography, Geography and Hydrology, Study of sedimentary basins, Environmental geosciences. and Crustal Processes. We host now a third in the line of three Centre of Excellences:  PHAB – Centre for Planetary Habitability, and have a Norwegian Research School for PhD students (Research School for Dynamics and Evolution of Earth and Planets, DEEP).

The Department aims to contribute to the new and important UN Sustainability Development Goals, and are important contributors to IPCC (UN’s Inter-governmental Panel on Climate Change). The staff consists of 40 professors and associate professors, in addition to postdoctoral fellows, PhD students, researchers, technical- and administrative staff. The Department has around 200 employees.

jobs.title: Junior Analyst to the Italian Trade Agency in Stockholm
jobs.description:
Do you have good organizational and project management skills, speak Italian and English fluently and want to work in a role where you support the Italian Trade Agency facilitating the process of engaging investors from Sweden, Denmark, Norway, and Finland investigating in Italy? Then this role might be right for you!

This is a consultancy opportunity starting 1st - 31st of August 2026, with a strong possibility of extension.



About the company

The Italian Trade Agency (ITA) is the Italian government agency promoting the internationalization of Italian companies and attracting foreign investment to Italy.

With a global network of 78 offices in 66 countries, ITA supports businesses through market insights, business matchmaking, and investment services. Its Foreign Direct Investment (FDI) Unit assists foreign companies with every stage of establishing and expanding their operations in Italy, from location scouting and business setup to ongoing aftercare.



Job description

In this context, the Italian Trade Agency Office in Stockholm is seeking a motivated Junior Analyst for the Foreign Direct Investment Unit with a University Degree to support the FDI activities.

The ideal candidate should be a person with analytical skills, used to scouring databases, the internet, and other sources to identify potential investors for Italian-based projects or similar business opportunities.

The candidate, who will work under the coordination of the Director of ITA Office in Stockholm in connection with the FDI Division in Rome, will also be required to perform administrative and back-office tasks, as well as communication tasks and regular reporting processes.

In this role, it´s important to be enterprise-oriented and have a client-minded attitude, with commercial awareness and strong client-oriented skills. Travels to Italy and abroad may be required.



About the role

During the Promotion Project, the candidate will support the ITA FDI team in order to facilitate the entire process of engaging investors interested in investing in Italy from Sweden, Denmark, Norway and Finland, building confidence and trust, even in aftermarket support.



Primary responsibilities:

• Support in the generation of leads through multiple sources, both online and offline, to maximize the outcome in terms of inquiries, active contacts, calls, and meetings.
• Support in realizing reports, presentations, and documents to track, assess and disseminate the activities of the Unit through the existing ITA communication channels.
• Organizing promotional activities related to the attraction of foreign investments, such as events, seminars, conferences, training courses, incoming trips of corporate players and investors to Italy and abroad.
• Liaise with companies, investors, corporate players, other foreign and Italian counterparts, sharing news, solicitations, promotional opportunities and more.
• Draft periodic reports highlighting potential opportunities for Italian companies.
• Aggregate market research, industry resources, news, and articles as necessary to share with the team of the Office in scouting the FDI environment.



For the implementation of those activities the candidate must have:

• Good organizational and project management skills; ability to prioritize projects, manage time efficiently, work in a fast-paced entrepreneurial environment.
• Strong interpersonal and communication skills, both written and spoken; ability to produce reports, briefings, and memos on short notice both in Italian and English.
• Ability to take charge of a project and run it to completion with minimal supervision; ability to identify issues and problems and solve them directly.
• Good skills in the use of social media
• Availability to travel in the Nordics countries and in Italy
• Availability to work with different cultures, proactive attitude, and team spirit.



Minimum Requirements

• University Degree
• Fluent Italian and English in speech and writing.
• Remarkable computer skills
• Tax residence in Sweden



Preferential Requirements

Preference will be given to candidates with the following additional skills and qualifications:

• Fluent Swedish, Danish, Norwegian or Finnish in both speaking and writing.
• University Degree and/or MBA and/or Ph.D. in International Trade, Finance, International Relations, International Business Law, or related subjects.
• Two years or more of experience in investment promotion, or strategic consultancy, business law firms, finance, particularly in investment banking, or in sales activities.



Contract term and Salary

The selected candidate will be offered a fixed-term contract with the possibility of extension.
The salary is fixed at 37.000 SEK/month.



Interested?

If the role sounds interesting, please apply today as we will process applications continuously. We are looking forward to receiving your application!

jobs.title: Myyjä kodinturva-alalle
jobs.description:
**Myyjänämme edustat Suomen suosituinta kodinturva-alan hälytysjärjestelmää ja työskentelet Great Place to Work -sertifioidussa organisaatiossa. Mikäli tämä kuulostaa sinulle sopivalta työpaikalta, jatka lukemista alta!**

**Huomioithan, että tämä ei ole kesätyötehtävä. Etsimme myyjiä, jotka haluavat työskennellä meillä kokoaikaisesti myös kesän jälkeen.**

**Miltä arkesi näyttää meillä?**

Myyjänämme liikut Verisuren tarjoamalla käyttöetuautolla ja toimit hälytysjärjestelmäpalvelumme asiantuntijana. Työsi keskiössä on asiakkaan tiloissa tehtävä turvakartoitus, jossa arvioit kohteen turvallisuustarpeet ja suunnittelet siihen parhaan ratkaisun. Tavoitteenasi on rakentaa asiakkaalle räätälöity turvasuojaus ja varmistaa hänen kotinsa tai yritystilojensa turvallisuus.

Viikkokalenterisi koostuu valmiiksi sovituista turvakartoituksista sekä itse hankkimistasi asiakaskäynneistä, koulutuksia ja tiimipalavereja unohtamatta. Kun turvakartoitukset alkavat onnistua ja tuottamaan kauppoja, koulutamme sinut asentamaan kaupatut hälytysjärjestelmät asiakkaidesi kohteisiin. Pääset parhaimmillaan tarjoamaan asiakkaallesi kokonaisvaltaisen palvelukokemuksen ensikohtaamisesta tapaamiseen, ja lopulta järjestelmän asentamiseen. Työpäiväsi ovat liikkuvia ja vaihtelevia, ja työtä tehdään arkipäivisin lähtökohtaisesti klo 12:00–20:00. Perehdytyksen jälkeen aikataulut muuttuvat joustavammiksi ja pääset itse vaikuttamaan siihen, miten järjestät asiakaskäyntisi.

**Kelle tämä työ sopii?**

Mikäli koet syttyväsi tavoitteiden saavuttamisesta ja konkreettisista onnistumisista, löytyy sinulta hyvät eväät työssä menestymiseen. Myös tietty pilke silmäkulmassa kilpailullisuuden suhteen antaa hyvää lisäpotkua tekemiseen. Arvostamme aiempaa kokemusta suoramyynnin tai turvallisuusalan parista, mutta voit olla myös esimerkiksi tavoitteellista myyntityötä etsivä alanvaihtaja, joka etsii uusia haasteita uralleen. Kurkkaa urasivuiltamme www.verisure.fi/ura, millaista arki Verisuren myyjänä voi olla.

**Mitä edellytämme:**

- B-luokan ajokortti (manuaali) ja valmius liikkua työtehtävissä Verisuren käyttöetuautolla.

- Sujuvat yhteistyö- ja vuorovaikutustaidot suomen kielellä, kyky kohdata asiakkaat ammattimaisesti ja ratkaisukeskeisesti.

- Motivaatio oppia palvelut ja tuotteet sekä kyky toimia tavoitteellisesti ja vastuullisesti.

- Tavoitteellisuutta ja innokkuutta suoramyyntiä kohtaan.

- Kyky toimia itsenäisesti, suunnitella ja toteuttaa työtehtäviä ilman jatkuvaa ohjausta perehdytyksen ja koulutuksen jälkeen.

- Kokemusta asiakastyötä tai itsenäistä tekemistä sisältävistä rooleista.

- Käytännön valmiudet ottaa asiakaskohtaamiset ja päätöksenteko hallintaan kenttätyössä.

- Turvasuojaajakortin edellyttämä nuhteettomuus rikosrekisterissä. Neuvomme kortin hankinnassa aina työsuhteen alkaessa.


**Tarjoamme sinulle:**

- Kannustavan palkkamallin, maksamme noin 300€/kauppa provisioista. Keskimäärin myyjämme tienaavat noin 3000-5000€ / kk, ja parhaiten tienaavat yltävät 10 000€ / kk tai sen yli.

- Takuupalkan 2000€/kk työsuhteen kolmena ensimmäisenä kuukautena, joka koostuu 500€ pohjapalkasta ja 1500€/kk takuuprovisiosta. Tuemme alkuvaiheen onnistumistasi maksamalla korotettuja provisioita työn ensimmäisten kuukausin aikana.

- Käyttöetuauton, jolla pääset liikkumaan sekä työ- että vapaa-ajalla.

- Kattavan perehdytyksen ja tuen koko työsuhteesi aikana. Aloitat työsi neljän päivän koulutuskurssilla toimistolla, jonka jälkeen perehdytys jatkuu kentällä yhdessä kouluttajien sekä esihenkilösi kanssa. Katso Youtube kanavaltamme (Verisure Suomi) videoltakouluttajamme Peterin esittely siitä, miten koulutamme sinut tehtävään.

- Miellyttävän ja välittävän työyhteisön. Olemme myös tutkitusti hyvä työnantaja. Meille on myönnetty Great Place to Work -sertifikaatti. Lisäksi sijoituimme Suomen parhaat työpaikat -gaalassa keskisuurten yritysten kategoriassa.

- Yhteistä tekemistä ja paljon erilaisia tapahtumia. Pääset esimerkiksi tutustumaan sekä näkemään eri kaupungeissa työskenteleviä myyjiä koko firman myyntitapahtumien yhteydessä, tai nauttimaan koko organisaatiolle järjestettävässä Inspiration Day –kesätapahtumassa.

- Myyntikilpailuja, joista voit voittaa mm. Ulkomaanmatkoja. Katso tästäInstagram tililtämme video myyjiemme palkintomatkasta Saksaan.

- Mahdollisuuden edetä urallasi – tällä hetkellä lähes jokainen kenttämyynnin esihenkilö on edennyt tehtäväänsä talon sisältä. Katso tarinoita urasivuiltamme sekä sosiaalisen median tileiltämme.

- Kattavat henkilöstöedut, kuten käyttöetuauto, kattava työterveyshuolto Mehiläisellä, hammaslääkärietu, lounasetu, liikunta-, kulttuuri- ja hyvinvointiedut.


Pääset tutustumaan meihin sekä Verisuren myyntityöhön tarkemmin sosiaalisen median tiliemme kautta TikTokissa ja Instagramissa @verisurelaiset.

**Kun kyse on työpaikasta, melko hyvä ei riitä. Parasta olla Verisure.**

Verisuren myyjänä seisot ylpeästi tuotteesi takana ja turvaat samalla ihmisten kodit sekä yritystilat suomen suosituimmalla sekä luotetuimmalla kodinturva-alan palvelulla. Lähetä hakemus tehtävään sivulla olevasta linkistä. Käsittelemme hakemuksia hakuaikana, ja paikat täytetään aina sopivien henkilöiden löytyessä.

Lisätietoja tehtävästä voit tarvittaessa tiedustella rekrytiimiltä sähköpostitse osoitteesta rekry@verisure.fi.

jobs.title: Full-Stack Developer
jobs.description:
About the Role
We are looking for a skilled Full-Stack Developer to join a development team in Gothenburg working on the evolution and reliability of business-critical workshop systems supporting an upcoming vehicle project. You will be involved throughout the software development lifecycle, from requirements and technical analysis to development, testing, troubleshooting, and continuous improvement. The ideal candidate has around 3-5 years of professional experience in full-stack development and strong expertise in at least one of TypeScript, C#/.NET, or Python. Experience with modern web development, backend or BFF solutions, cloud environments, and identity and access management is highly valuable.
Key Responsibilities
In this role, you will:

    Design, develop, and maintain new and existing software functionality.
    Build and maintain integrations with external systems and services.
    Investigate issues, troubleshoot applications, and improve existing solutions.
    Participate in code reviews and contribute to development best practices.
    Produce clean, maintainable, well-tested, and efficient code.
    Create and maintain relevant technical documentation.
    Contribute to requirements gathering, technical design, and solution analysis.
    Work closely with developers, product owners, analysts, testers, and other stakeholders.
    Help ensure reliable, high-quality deliveries that provide value to end users.

Required Skills & Experience

You should have strong hands-on experience in at least one of the following areas:

    TypeScript, particularly for frontend and BFF development, preferably with Next.js.
    C#/.NET for backend development.
    Python for backend and/or data-oriented development.

You should also have experience with at least one major cloud platform, such as:

    Azure
    AWS
    GCP

Nice to Have
Experience in any of the following areas would be an advantage:

    Identity and Access Management (IAM).
    Role-Based Access Control (RBAC).
    Policy management and authorization.
    Microsoft Entra or similar identity platforms.
    Keycloak.
    Grafana and application monitoring.
    Generative AI and AI-assisted development tools.
    Automotive or OEM-related software environments.
    Cloud-based application architecture and services.

About You
We are looking for someone who is proactive, curious, and comfortable taking ownership of technical challenges.
You are not afraid to ask questions when requirements are unclear, and you are equally comfortable raising concerns when you identify potential risks or improvements. You enjoy investigating problems, working collaboratively, and finding practical solutions.
You are likely to be:

    A structured and responsible problem solver.
    Passionate about building reliable, user-focused software.
    Comfortable working in a dynamic and changing environment.
    A collaborative team player with strong communication skills.
    Quality-conscious and attentive to maintainability.
    Proactive and willing to take initiative.
    Comfortable working with both technical and non-technical stakeholders.

Professional fluency in English is required. Knowledge of Swedish is considered an advantage.

Applications are reviewed continuously, and the position may be filled before the advertised closing date. We therefore encourage interested candidates to apply as soon as possible.

We develop and operate the entire platform ourselves and control the full payment flow. This gives us deep technical ownership, real responsibility, and engineers who influence architecture, not just implementation.

Dintero operates in a space that is complex in two dimensions:

  • Technical complexity -- distributed systems, high throughput, strict uptime requirements

  • Regulatory complexity -- payment schemes, compliance, auditability, and financial correctness


We are also at the forefront of innovation in the payment space:

  • First to implement Passkeys with Mastercard

  • Early adopters of real-time clearing APIs

  • First new acquirer in Norway in over 20 years

This is a role for engineers who want to work on serious backend systems that must work, every time .

Production at Scale

  • 150M+ API calls per month

  • 10 senior engineers -- small team, high ownership

  • Infrastructure designed for high availability and robust transaction flows

What You Will Work On

  • Design and own backend services end-to-end

  • Build APIs used directly by merchants and partners

  • Make architectural decisions with long-term impact

  • Work with scalability, observability, and operational quality

  • Ship to production frequently and take ownership of what you build

In short: less coordination, more engineering.

Tech Stack

Deliberate choices. Minimal hype.

  • AWS (Fargate, Lambda, DynamoDB, Aurora)

  • Microservices

  • Node.js and TypeScript

  • Infrastructure as Code

  • API-first

We value sound engineering decisions over chasing trends.

Your Profile

You have experience working with complex systems in production.

  • 5+ years of backend development experience

  • Experience with distributed systems and architectural trade-offs

  • Comfortable owning systems end-to-end

  • Experience where reliability, correctness, or compliance matter

  • Cloud experience (Preferably AWS)

Scandinavian language (Norwegian, Swedish, or Danish) is a plus, but not required.

This Role Is a Strong Fit If You Have Worked With

  • Payment systems or financial infrastructure

  • High-throughput APIs or event-driven systems

  • Regulated domains (fintech, banking, etc.)

This Role Is Likely Not Right If You

  • Prefer frontend-focused work

We are intentionally a small team. Everyone contributes to core decisions.

Why Dintero

  • Real ownership of critical systems

  • Work that has direct real-world impact

  • A financially solid fintech company with strong growth

Compensation

  • Competitive salary (aligned with Tekna levels)

Engineers building the platform should share in the value creation.

VIHTI

Etsimme Prisma Nummelan käyttötavaraosastolle MYYJÄÄ! Tehtävä on vakituinen ja sen työtunnit ovat 30 h/vko. Tutustu Nummelan Prisman tunnelmaan somesta, ja saatatpa bongata tulevien työkavereiden kasvojakin!

Prisma Nummelan monipuolisella käyttötavaraosastolla pääset työskentelemään laajan tuotevalikoiman parissa. Valikoimaamme kuuluu mm. viihde-elektroniikkaa, kodinkoneita, vaatteita sekä sisustus-, piha- ja puutarhatuotteita. Tässä tehtävässä työsi painottuu erityisesti viihde-elektroniikan osastolle, jossa autat asiakkaita löytämään juuri heidän tarpeisiinsa sopivia tuotteita – olipa kyseessä uuden puhelimen valinta, television hankinta tai sopivien lisätarvikkeiden etsiminen. Lisäksi osallistut muun elektroniikan ja kodinkoneiden myyntiin sekä tuet tarvittaessa koko käyttötavaraosastoa monipuolisissa tehtävissä.

Käyttötavaraosaston myyjän työ sopii sinulle, joka innostut asiakaspalvelusta ja vauhdikkaasta työarjesta. Huolehdit siitä, että tuotteet ovat siististi ja houkuttelevasti esillä, hallitset varastoa ja rakennat kampanjoita. Lisäksi huolehdit huoltoihin liittyvistä asioista ja reklamaatioista. Yksi tehtävä on kuitenkin ylitse muiden: asiakkaiden ystävällinen kohtaaminen. 😊

Toivomme, että pidät asiakaspalvelusta, fyysisestä työstä ja tiimityöskentelystä. Aiempi kokemus tai harrastuneisuus viihde-elektroniikan parissa on edellytys, joten kerrothan osaamisestasi hakemuksella. Edellytämme 18 vuoden ikää ja mahdollisuutta työskennellä Prisman aamu- päivä- ja iltavuoroissa vaihtelevasti n. klo 7–22 välillä.

💚 Supervoimia S-etukortillesi! Miltä kuulostaisi -25 % alennus S-ryhmän ravintoloista? Tai -15 % alennus käyttötavaroista mm. Prismoista ja Sokokselta? Suomen parhaimmiksikin kutsutuista henkilöstöeduista voit lukea esimakua täältä.

Lisätiedot ja hakeminen
Työsuhteen tyyppi: vakituinen
Työaika: osa-aikainen 30 h/vko
Haku päättyy: 23.8.2026. Toivomme kuulevamme sinusta pian, sillä haastattelemme jo hakuajalla ja valinta tehdään sopivan henkilön löydyttyä.

Me SSO:ssa arvostamme ihan tavallisia töitä, mutta vielä enemmän arvostamme niitä epätavallisen upeita ihmisiä töiden takana. Uskomme, että ihmiset ratkaisevat onnistumisen. Location: Oslo, Norway

Type: Full-time, on-site

Design how professionals think with AI the world's most advanced AI analyst

Crunched builds autonomous AI systems that operate inside Excel-automating strategy, modelling, and financial workflows without breaking how people already work.

Our AI analyst is already used by professionals at BCG, Nordover Capital, INSEAD, Harvard, Explore, Arkwright, Connaught, and Placepoint.

We're backed by Y Combinator, have raised 55M NOK, and recently spent several months in San Francisco. Now, we're assembling the core Oslo team, and we're hiring a Senior UX Designer to own the user experience of our AI analyst.

Why Crunched can win

Large AI platforms like Anthropic are serious competitors. Crunched is different because we build deeply for the top 1--2% of Excel power users and their highly specific workflows. In every direct customer evaluation against competing products so far, Crunched has won on quality. First Round heard pitches from 75 AI-for-Excel startups over the past year---and chose to invest in Crunched.

This is not a surface-level UI role. This is about designing trust, clarity, and control in a complex, AI-driven product-embedded directly into Excel.

What you'll do

  • Own the end-to-end UX of Crunched's AI analyst-from concept to shipped product

  • Design interaction models for AI-driven workflows, not just screens

  • Apply user psychology and behavioral principles to reduce cognitive load and build trust

  • Build and evolve a systematic UX framework grounded in real user feedback

  • Design within the constraints of Excel while subtly expanding beyond it

  • Partner closely with engineers to ensure designs are feasible, performant, and shippable

  • Continuously test, learn, and iterate with real users across Europe and the US

  • Shape the long-term UX strategy and design language of Crunched

Who you are

You're a senior, strategically strong UX designer who is still deeply hands-on.

You think in systems, flows, and mental models-not just components. You enjoy getting things done and take pride in shipping work that actually changes how people operate.

You likely bring:

  • Deep understanding of user psychology and decision-making in complex tools

  • Strong experience designing data-heavy, B2B, or professional software

  • A systematic approach to UX, grounded in research, feedback loops, and iteration

  • Experience designing for AI-powered products (or complex automation tools)

  • An impeccable eye for aesthetics, leaning toward simplicity without being sterile or boring

  • A high-ownership mindset and comfort with ambiguity

You don't just make things look good.

You make them make sense.

Design philosophy

At Crunched, UX is not decoration.

We care about:

  • Clarity over cleverness

  • Calm interfaces for high-stakes work

  • Power without intimidation

  • Simplicity that respects expert users

We expect strong opinions-backed by reasoning and user insight.

At Oda, we develop affordable grocery services to make the logistics of living surprisingly easy. First we built Norway’s leading online grocery store and now, partnered with Mathem in Sweden, we’re on our way to becoming the world’s most effective grocery system, delivering to thousands of Scandinavian doorsteps every week.

As part of our team, you’ll work with smart, passionate colleagues who bring their whole selves to work every day. It’s a fast-moving, collaborative environment where everyone is welcome and everyone’s opinion matters. Whether you're shaping the future of online retail, tackling complex logistical problems, or making everyday life better for our customers, your work will have a real impact.   • Good communication skills: Comfortable in speaking and writing English. If you also know Norwegian or another Nordic language, that’s a big plus!

  • Comfortable working both independently and as part of a team

  • A strong work ethic and a "can-do" mindset

  • Service-minded and always looking for the best solutions
