Arvostamme erityisosaamistaitoja, kuten neuropsykiatrisen valmentajan tutkintoa, niin koulutuksen kuin työkokemuksenkin kautta. Poutapolulla arvostamme erilaisia persoonia ja toivomme, että työotteesi on arvojemme mukaisesti iloinen, reipas ja osaava. Avohuollon ohjaajan työ on itsenäistä ja vastuullista sisältäen esihenkilön ja työyhteisön vahvan tuen. Asiakaslähtöinen hyvinvointi on tavoitteenamme, haastavien tilanteiden keskellä onnistumisen kokemuksia syntyy päivittäin ja työ opettaa aina jotain uutta! Sinulla on mahdollisuus suunnitella omat työvuorosi. Monipaikkaisen ja liikkuvan työn luonteen vuoksi tehtävässä tarvitaan ajokorttia ja mahdollisuutta oman auton käyttöön.

Tiimissämme keskustelemme avoimesti, tarvitsemme erilaisia mielipiteitä ja vahvuuksia. Uskomme empatiaan ja huumoriin, johtamiseen ilman hierarkiaa. Pidämme lupauksemme, meillä kaikki ovat tasa-arvoisia.

Tarjoamme kilpailukykyisen palkan (G26, kaikilla ikälisillä 3434,74 eur) ja hyvät työsuhde-edut (kulttuuri- ja liikuntaetu, kattava terveysvakuutus). Haluamme nauttia yhteisistä työvuosista ja kerryttää niitä lisää, yhdessä.

Olethan yhteydessä, jos arvomaailmamme kohtaavat!

jobs.title: RESPONSABLE DE SITE ITINERANT (H/F)
jobs.description:
Responsable de Site Itinérant (H/F)

Un poste de terrain, au cœur de nos résidences
Vous aimez les environnements variés, les nouveaux défis et les missions qui ont du sens ? Vous souhaitez mettre votre expertise au service de plusieurs établissements plutôt que d'un seul ?

Qui sommes-nous ?
KOSY Appart'Hôtels, exploité par Habitat Gestion, c'est :
- Un réseau de 16 résidences,
- Présents dans 9 villes,
- Exploitant près de 1 400 logements en France,
- Avec plus de 25 ans d'expertise.
Implantés à Forbach, Saint-Avold, Reims, Nancy, Troyes, Mâcon, Grenoble, Aix-Les-Bains et Avignon.
Nous accueillons étudiants, professionnels et voyageurs en leur proposant des solutions d'hébergement tout confort, de la nuitée au séjour longue durée. Nos appartements, du studio au T2, sont entièrement meublés et équipés, avec Wi-Fi et de nombreux services à la carte.
Vous recherchez un poste où autonomie, diversité des missions et proximité avec la direction sont une réalité ? Rejoignez Kosy et participez au développement de notre réseau de résidences.
Pour en savoir plus : www.kosy-apparthotels.com

Votre mission :
Rattaché(e) à notre directeur opérationnel, votre mission s'articule autour de deux axes principaux :
- Renforcer les équipes lors des pics d'activité, des rentrées universitaires, des périodes touristiques ou tout autre besoin opérationnel.
- Remplacer les responsables de résidence pendant leurs absences (congés, formations, maladie, etc.) afin de garantir le bon fonctionnement de chaque établissement.

Dans ce cadre, vous serez amené(e) à :
- (Co)-piloter l'exploitation quotidienne d'une résidence ;
- Garantir un accueil client de qualité et veiller à la satisfaction de nos résidents et clients ;
- Accompagner, coordonner et soutenir les équipes présentes sur site (interne ou externe) ;
- Suivre l'activité commerciale et respecter les objectifs de taux d'occupation ;
- Assurer le suivi administratif et opérationnel de l'établissement ;
- Veiller au respect des procédures, des standards qualité et des règles de sécurité ;
- Accompagner les équipes lors des périodes de forte activité et contribuer à l'amélioration continue de leurs process.

Profil souhaité :
Vous justifiez d'une expérience réussie dans la gestion d'un établissement d'hébergement (résidence de services, résidence étudiante, appart'hôtel).
Vous êtes reconnu(e) pour :
- votre autonomie ;
- votre capacité d'adaptation ;
- votre sens de l'organisation ;
- votre réactivité ;
Vous appréciez les environnements variés, savez rapidement prendre vos marques dans un nouvel établissement et aimez relever de nouveaux défis.
Ce poste implique des déplacements de 2 à 3 semaines par trimestre, principalement sur nos résidences de Reims, Mâcon, Saint-Avold et Grenoble, afin d'assurer les remplacements ou de renforcer les équipes selon les besoins de l'exploitation.
Vous êtes directement rattaché(e) à notre directeur opérationnel.
En dehors des périodes de remplacement, le poste est rattaché au siège, à Nancy.
Pourquoi nous rejoindre ?
- Une grande autonomie dans vos missions.
- Une forte diversité d'environnements et de rencontres.
- Une proximité immédiate avec la direction générale.
- L'opportunité de développer vos compétences sur plusieurs typologies d'établissements.
- Une entreprise à taille humaine, attachée à la proximité, à la qualité de service et à l'accompagnement de ses équipes.

Informations complémentaires
- CDI - 39h
- Statut : Agent de Maîtrise
- Convention collective de l'immobilier (IDCC 1527)
- Mutuelle d'entreprise
- Prise en charge des déplacements et hébergement par Kosy lors des missions.
- Rémunération annuelle brute : 33 000 € sur 13 mois

jobs.title: Teknisk Driftskoordinator - ejendomsdrift i servicefirma
jobs.description:
Har du styr på bygningsdrift og kendskab til byggegarantier? Drømmer du om at arbejde i en central rolle indenfor ejendomsdrift og som tæt sparringspartner for kollegaer? Trives du i en hverdag, hvor du primært arbejder fra kontoret i Silkeborg, men også af og til er ude på besigtigelser?

Så vil vi rigtig gerne lære dig bedre at kende!

Hos Dalbøges Ejendomsservice får vi flere opgaver og derfor søger vi en ny kollega, som får en central rolle i den daglige drift af de ejendomme, vi passer.

Du bliver bindeled mellem vores dygtige viceværter og kunder. Nogle dage er du ude og besigtige en ejendom, følger op på garantisager eller flyttesynsopgørelser. Andre dage sidder du på kontoret og udarbejder tilbud, planlægger opgaver eller hjælper med at få en ny ejendom godt i gang.

Det er en alsidig rolle med stor frihed og et stort ansvar – men uden store armbevægelser. Hos os er alle en vigtig del af holdet.

HVORFOR ER DET LIGE NETOP DIG, VI ER PÅ UDKIG EFTER?

Du tager ansvar og får tingene til at ske.

Du bevarer overblikket, når der er mange bolde i luften, og du trives med at finde løsninger sammen med både kunder, kolleger og samarbejdspartnere.

Vi forestiller os, at du:

·         Har erfaring med ejendomsdrift, bygningsdrift eller facility management.

·         Har en god teknisk forståelse og gerne en håndværksmæssig eller byggeteknisk baggrund.

·         Har arbejdet med tekniske gennemgange, mangellister og/eller garantisager.

·         Har forståelse for flyttesyn og processerne rundt om synene.

·         Har lyst til at være den, som viceværterne kan sparre med i hverdagen, og sætter en ære i at deres opgaver er godt koordineret.

·         Er god til at skabe overblik og følge op på opgaver.

·         Er serviceminded og god til at skabe tillid hos kunderne.

·         Er fortrolig med almindelige IT-systemer og Office 365.

Det vigtigste er ikke, hvilken titel du har i dag. Det vigtigste er, at du har lyst til at tage ansvar, skabe struktur og være med til at udvikle vores forretning.

HVILKE OPGAVER KAN DU SE FREM TIL?

Du kommer blandt andet til at arbejde med:

·         Sparring og planlægning af opgaver sammen med vores viceværter.

·         Besigtigelse af ejendomme, og udarbejdelse af tilbud og serviceaftaler.

·         Opstart af nye ejendomme og sikring af en god overgang til den daglige drift.

·         Håndtering og opfølgning på garantisager og mangler overfor entreprenører.

·         Dialog med kunder, håndværkere og samarbejdspartnere.

·         Løbende udvikling af vores arbejdsgange og kvaliteten i driften.

HVEM ER VI?

Vi er Dalbøges Ejendomsservice og vi leverer professionel ejendomsservice til udlejningsejendomme, ejerforeninger og erhvervskunder.

Vi er en virksomhed i vækst, en del af PHM Group og har flere Gazelle-priser bag os. Samtidig har vi bevaret en kultur, hvor der er kort fra idé til handling og hvor alle hjælper hinanden.

Hos os er der ikke langt fra tanke til beslutning. Vi tror på frihed under ansvar, sund fornuft og ordentlighed – både over for kunderne og hinanden.

DET MED SMÅT

Din daglige base bliver vores kontor i Silkeborg, men en del af arbejdstiden vil foregå ude på de ejendomme vi passer. Du vil blandt andet være med til at starte nye ejendomme i Aalborg, når vi udvider vores aktiviteter.

Vi tilbyder en hverdag med stor fleksibilitet, gode kolleger og en uformel omgangstone.

Stillingen er som udgangspunkt på fuld tid.

VIL DU MED?

Du behøver ikke skrive en lang ansøgning.

Send os i stedet dit CV og et par linjer om, hvorfor du synes, jobbet lyder spændende.

Vi holder samtaler løbende og ansætter, når vi har fundet den rette kollega.

jobs.title: People Business Partner
jobs.description:
Are you a people-focused professional who thrives on making a difference?

As a People Business Partner, you will support parts of our business and handle all operational HR matters. Your main task is to coach and develop managers in your business functions, helping them succeed in their roles and responsibilities. With our people strategy in mind, you will drive and advise on all people aspects. Does this sound interesting? We look forward to your application!

Some of your key responsibilities:

    Provide day-to-day support for managers and employees in operational HR matters, including all investigation and requirements for disciplinary matters, compensation issues and rehabilitation
    Act as a single point of contact for managers in your business functions
    Guide, coach and advice managers in employee development, performance, employee relations and HR-issues, in line with the company policy
    Trade Union negotiations
    Facilitate training sessions for managers and employees
    Be part of people development projects across the company

What you will experience

As a Stena Line employee in Sweden, we offer you a salary package including pension benefit and benefits package consisting of travel concessions and onboard discounts, health cash plan and well-being activities.

Based in our Gothenburg office, this role follows an office-first approach, allowing you to work closely with a collaborative team of People Business Partners, People Rehab Partner and Talent Acquisition Partners, together, we support and work with the business to provide proactive, people-focused support where it matters most.

Who are you?

At Stena Line, your personal qualities matter just as much as your skills and expertise. Regardless of the role, being welcoming, caring, and reliable guides you in your everyday work and the challenges you face. We believe that you are result oriented with a solution focused mindset. You are a team-player and knows how to communicate and influence others.

Qualifications:

    Bachelor degree or equivalent within HR or similar area
    Solid experience from working as a People Business Partner or similar HR-role, preferable from a matrix organisation with operational focus
    Experience handling HR-matters such as rehabilitation, disciplinary actions, negotiations with unions and people administration
    Fluent in Swedish and English, both written and spoken, and experienced user of MS Office
    Ability to travel on a regular basis
    Experience in shipping, logistics, and/or the transport sector is a plus

Interested?

This is a full-time, permanent position. You will be based in Gothenburg within our Scandinavian People department. To apply, please register your profile and send in your application in English as soon as possible but no later than August 23nd, 2026. Please note that due to GDPR we do not accept applications via e-mail or postal service.

If you have any questions regarding the position or about the recruitment process you are welcome to contact Hedwig Blixt, Talent Acquisition Partner, Hedwig.Blixt@stenaline.com.

Please note that we kindly decline any offers from recruitment or staffing agencies regarding this recruitment.

About Stena Line

As a leader in sustainable shipping, Stena Line has Europe's most comprehensive route network focusing on transportation of both passengers and freight. We have over 8,750 employees in our Stena Line family across Scandinavia, around the UK and the Baltics, making a contribution to our company.

Stena Line exists to be a trusted link between people, places and societies. We play a vital role in keeping everything connected. We make sure people and goods arrive where they need to be, enabling business to thrive and societies to grow. We connect family and friends, and make it, possible to explore new destinations or revisit favorite places. The journey starts with us.

Working at Stena Line means having a safe and stable workplace and a great work-life balance. We are committed to maintaining and developing a sustainable working environment, free from harassment, that gives equal opportunities to everyone. We embrace equality, diversity and inclusion – and welcome all applicants.

jobs.title: Globe Advokater søger en advokatsekretær (30-37 timer om ugen)
jobs.description:
Vil du være med på en spændende vækstrejse i et moderne advokatfirma?

Globe Advokater er et ambitiøst og dynamisk advokatfirma med kontor i hjertet af København. Vi er særligt kendt for vores stærke profil inden for udlændingeret og rådgiver både private, virksomheder og internationale klienter i komplekse juridiske problemstillinger.

Samtidig er vi i gang med at udvide vores forretningsområder og arbejder i stigende grad med blandt andet ejendomshandler, familie- og arveret, straffesager og bistandssager. Vi har fokus på høj faglighed, effektiv sagsbehandling og en nærværende klientoplevelse.

Vi oplever stor aktivitet og søger derfor en dygtig og engageret advokatsekretær på 30-37 timer om ugen, som har lyst til at blive en vigtig del af vores fortsatte udvikling.

Dine arbejdsopgaver vil blandt andet omfatte:

  • Sekretærbetjening og administrativ sagsbehandling

  • Kontakt med klienter, myndigheder og samarbejdspartnere

  • Udarbejdelse af juridiske dokumenter og korrespondance

  • Kalenderstyring, dokumenthåndtering og øvrige administrative opgaver

  • Oprettelse og håndtering af sager samt understøttelse af kontorets advokater

Vi forestiller os, at du:

  • Har erfaring som advokatsekretær eller fra en lignende stilling

  • Er struktureret, serviceminded og arbejder selvstændigt

  • Har gode skriftlige og mundtlige formuleringsevner

  • Trives i et travlt miljø og har sans for detaljen

  • Har lyst til at være en del af et mindre, ambitiøst team, hvor man hjælper hinanden og får stor indflydelse på hverdagen

Det vil være et stort plus, hvis du tidligere har arbejdet med:

  • Ejendomshandler

  • Bistandssager

  • Straffesager

  • Familie- og arveretlige dokumenter

  • Sagsportalen og digitale sagsgange generelt

Det er desuden en fordel, hvis du har erfaring med Legis, da vi anvender systemet i vores daglige sagsbehandling og ønsker en medarbejder, der kan bidrage aktivt til at udvikle og optimere vores arbejdsgange.

Vi tilbyder:

  • En spændende og alsidig stilling med stor selvstændighed og ansvar

  • Mulighed for at præge udviklingen i et advokatfirma i vækst

  • Et uformelt, fleksibelt og ambitiøst arbejdsmiljø

  • Tæt samarbejde med engagerede kollegaer

  • Gode muligheder for faglig og personlig udvikling

Ansøgning
Send din ansøgning og CV til info@globeadvokater.dk. Vi afholder samtaler løbende og ansætter, når den rette kandidat er fundet. Ansøgningsfrist er den 17. august 2026.

Vi glæder os til at høre fra dig.

jobs.title: Senior IAM Engineer
jobs.description:
About the Company

At Avaron, you get the security of permanent employment combined with the variety of working at different customers. We place specialists across everything from tech, IT and industry to project management and business support – and whatever the assignment, you have a consultant manager who is there for you and your development.

About the Role

You will join a highly skilled IAM team working at the heart of a complex enterprise environment where identity, security, and platform engineering are tightly connected. The team designs, builds, and operates Identity and Access Management platforms across both on-prem and cloud environments, with solutions that are deeply integrated into DevOps toolchains and digital platforms.

In this role, you will help evolve the IAM landscape by turning technical and business needs into secure, scalable solutions. You will work closely with development, security, cloud, and infrastructure teams, and play an important part in strengthening IAM capabilities that support the organization’s broader cloud journey. It is a great opportunity for you if you enjoy combining architecture, hands-on engineering, and security in a modern platform environment.

Job Description

    You will design and implement IAM solutions and architectures for hybrid environments.
    You will operate, maintain, and further develop IAM platforms and supporting infrastructure.
    You will support cloud and platform onboarding by establishing secure IAM patterns.
    You will troubleshoot identity-related issues across integrated systems and drive resolution in a structured way.
    You will work with compliance and security policies to ensure robust and secure access management.
    You will collaborate closely with cross-functional teams to improve the overall security posture.
    You will contribute to IAM capabilities that enable scalable, secure, and compliant cloud services.

Requirements

    5 years or more experience within IAM engineering, with expert hands-on experience in access management tools.
    Good knowledge of networking fundamentals such as TLS, DNS, proxies, firewalls, and VPNs.
    Advanced knowledge of certificate management and PKI, including handling SSL/TLS certificates.
    Advanced knowledge of identity federation technologies such as OpenID Connect and OAuth2.
    Experience managing different IDP solutions.
    Good knowledge of Single Sign-On and Multi Factor Authentication solutions, for example FIDO2.
    Advanced knowledge of DevSecOps tools and platform management with Kubernetes, Docker, Git, and GitHub Actions.
    Advanced knowledge in programming languages such as Java, Python, Go, Spring, or JavaScript.
    Good knowledge of Linux, LDAP, OpenShift, and infrastructure as code with Terraform, Ansible, and Helm.
    Experience working in hybrid and multi-cloud enterprise environments, including secure integration across multiple cloud providers and on-premises platforms.
    Hands-on experience with one or more enterprise identity platforms such as Microsoft Entra ID, Keycloak, or Curity.
    Experience operating in complex and highly integrated IT environments.
    Advanced troubleshooting capabilities and a strong understanding of IT infrastructure, with the ability to diagnose and resolve complex identity and access issues across diverse systems and environments.

What We Offer

    Permanent employment at Avaron AB
    Occupational pension
    Wellness allowance of SEK 5,000 per year

Application

Selections are made on an ongoing basis – apply as soon as you can.

jobs.title: Payroll Specialist
jobs.description:
Maersk is a global leader in integrated logistics and have been industry pioneers for over a century. Through innovation and transformation, we are redefining the boundaries of possibility, continuously setting new standards for efficiency, sustainability, and excellence.

At Maersk, we believe in the power of diversity, collaboration, and continuous learning and we work hard to ensure that the people in our organisation reflect and understand the customers we exist to serve.

With over 100,000 employees across 130 countries, we work together to shape the future of global trade and logistics.

Join us as we harness cutting-edge technologies and unlock opportunities on a global scale. Together, let's sail towards a brighter, more sustainable future with Maersk.

Payroll specialist

At Maersk, we have a vision larger than the ocean: to be a true integrator of container logistics connecting and simplifying our customers’ supply chain. We count on our people to make it happen.

Besides focusing on creating value for our customers and the business, a key priority for us is to drive personal and professional development for our people to prepare for further career progression.

We value the diversity of our talent and will always strive to recruit the best person for the job.



We Offer

Energizing and pioneering, this is an environment that keeps you motivated.

You’ll be joining a genuinely diverse and talented team that is truly passionate about providing first class HR partnership to the business. And thanks to our global scale, you’ll be well-placed to explore Maersk opportunities around the world.

The many other highlights include industry-leading talent develop initiatives and competitive benefits.

You will be joining a Fortune 500 company and will get the opportunity to challenge yourself in a truly aspiring, international, and fast-paced environment with our team in Gothenburg and all over the world. In cooperation with colleagues and vendors your role will be to ensure a flawless payroll service to Swedish and Norwegian employees. This will give you a unique opportunity to interact with colleagues, across the globe and from all business areas within the Maersk group, all while having a continuous focus on your professional and personal development too.

Key Responsibilities

The purpose of the role is to support the regional payroll organization, working with a matrixed group of stakeholders and vendors to ensure great employee experience and regulatory compliance from a payroll delivery perspective. Key responsibilities:

    Manage pre-payroll, on-cycle payroll, off-cycle payroll processes
    Extract the T&A data and provide the same to payroll provider
    Validate payroll results & provide approvals for final pay credits based on control reports
    Annual payroll reconciliation and new Payroll Year preparation
    Ensure timely Social Insurance Tax Payment and Reporting
    Manage advance payments
    Adjust basic time configuration of systems after initial implementation, as approved/required
    Track vendor deliverables on payroll SLAs vide defined payroll metrics
    Be risk aware and help identify, report, mitigate and track risks in the payroll delivery process
    Support the Payroll team lead in providing necessary data and clarifications to questions raised by audit – internal and external
    Manage the timely submission of RICC controls  
    Participate in Time and Attendance initiatives including system upgrades, communication of changes to People Partners, testing and documenting all changes for historical and record retention policies, project support as needed
    Interfaces with People Partner to support employee/ manager queries
    Identify improvement opportunities in regional processes and raises them to global process managers

Who we are looking for

You are data, systems and process savvy in the Payroll, HR, Time & Attendance domain and are excited about putting your deep expertise at work in the transition into new technology and processes at Maersk.

You want to propel your career further by gaining unique project experience in an international environment and would like to play a key role in building the future payroll delivery landscape and solutions.

As we progress with the transformation you are comfortable with your role changing shape and scope. You will be responsible for high quality delivery of Payroll Services and continuously driving improvements to ensure great employee experience process optimization and compliance.

• 3-5 years of hands-on experience in managing Payroll, Time & Attendance and HR processes, within a complex international organization

• Knowledge of compliance and legal regulations for payroll & benefits

• Broader HR Operations experience as well as exposure to an outsourced payroll model would be a benefit

• Ability to effectively engage and mobilize diverse local HR stakeholders

• A proactive, ‘let’s get it done’ attitude geared towards continuous improvement

• Flexibility and adaptability to operate in a fast-paced, developing project environment, taking ownership and setting directions with minimal guidance

• Resilience: the change process, is anything but straightforward; accepting uncertainty and bouncing back from setbacks while keeping your enthusiasm is a tall order, but we need it

• Collaborative working style, fostering cooperation and teamwork to find solutions

• Fluency in Swedish and English is essential

• If you have worked with ‘transportavtalet’, is an advantage too

• Highly analytical approach with a strong eye for detail

• Structured working style and focus on delivering results as per agreed timescales and scope

Selection is ongoing, so we look forward to your application!

jobs.title: R&D Professional (Physical Metallurgy): Temporary Position
jobs.description:
At Alleima, we believe in delivering the highest quality products to our customers. That is why we invest heavily in research and development, and our unit for Physical Metallurgy is in the forefront of this effort. As part of our Strategic Research organization, the unit provides expert support to all of our divisions: Tube, Strip and Kanthal. We generate high-quality testing results, develop new and existing testing methods, and participate in cutting-edge research development projects, all to ensure we stay ahead of the curve.

If you hold a Master’s degree in Metallurgy, Materials Science, or Physics and are interested in working with surface analysis, heat treatment, and physical properties, we invite you to apply for a temporary position at the Strategic Research Labs at Alleima. We are looking for driven individuals with a strong commitment to delivering high-quality results. This is a great opportunity to gain valuable experience as part of our innovative team in Sandviken, Sweden—don’t miss your chance to join us!

This position is expected to start from 2026-09-01 to 2026-12-31.

Your Role

The unit Physical Metallurgy, which is an integral part of Strategic Research Labs consists of several characterization and analytical techniques. These include surface analysis techniques known as glow discharge optical emission spectroscopy (GD-OES), Physical property measurements, X-ray diffraction (XRD), light and electron microscopes (LOM+SEMs+TEM+EPMA), sample preparation laboratories and dilatometers. We have a group of highly competent and skillful engineers and technicians. The current position mainly involves collaborating with group members working with GD-OES, Interferometer, Physical & Magnetic properties and Heat Treatment. The responsibilities of the current position are as follows:

      -        Perform measurements according to the expectations of our clients and be able to communicate the results.

      -        Collaborate effectively with other laboratory engineers in planning and executing the measurements.

      -        Take responsibility for the machines & instruments by collaborating with the suppliers in the case of maintenance and breakdowns.

      -        Support other lab members in future investments in the areas you work with.

About You

We are looking for an enthusiastic individual with a Masters’s degree in Metallurgy, Materials Science, or Physics. While prior experience in our competence area is a plus, what matters to us is your eagerness to learn, develop and grow. If you have spent time in a laboratory environment, that´s an advantage. Knowledge of metallic materials, manufacturing processes, microstructures, that’s fantastic, but don´t worry if you´re not an expert just yet – we´re here to help develop those skills. Experience working with GD-OES, Interferometer, and instruments for measuring Physical properties can also be a merit. You should be able to communicate in Swedish, both verbally and in writing. As we work in a global environment, communication skills in English will be good/advantageous.

Your personal qualities are essential for this role. At our core, we value strong personal qualities such as curiosity, creativity, self-motivation, patience, and a solution-oriented mindset. You are well-organized and structured, with a clear sense of ownership and commitment to your responsibilities. You thrive both independently and as part of a team, demonstrating adaptability and a willingness to support others when needed. If you’re driven to thrive and grow in our dynamic environment, we´re excited to welcome you on board as the catalyst for our success!

We are a company with an open-minded culture, actively working to create a workplace that is characterized by diversity and inclusion.

Additional Information

As a part of the hire process alcohol and drug tests are conducted according to our procedures for a safe working environment.

jobs.title: Senior Automation Engineer, DK - Esbjerg
jobs.description:
Do you want to develop advanced automation solutions for critical energy and marine infrastructure?

As a Senior Automation Engineer at Semco Maritime, you will join our Automation & Electrical team, working with complex control systems for energy facilities, marine installations and offshore platforms.

You will take technical ownership of automation solutions throughout the project lifecycle, from functional design and software development to commissioning, troubleshooting and lifecycle support. You will also contribute to the continued development of our technical standards and provide professional guidance to colleagues and project teams.

The role includes opportunities to work with advanced drive and motor-control solutions, including commissioning, troubleshooting and retrofit activities involving Danfoss VLT and VACON products.

At Semco Maritime, safety is a core value. In this role, you will contribute to maintaining and promoting a strong safety culture while delivering reliable and pragmatic solutions for critical installations.

Your place of work will be our Global Headquarters in Esbjerg, located at the heart of the Danish energy industry and directly on the waterfront. The position is full-time, and you can expect approximately 10–30 travel days per year.

Your tasks & responsibilities

You will work across the full project lifecycle in close collaboration with project managers, electrical designers, customers and other technical specialists.

Your main responsibilities will include:
  • Taking technical ownership of automation solutions and defining system architecture, interfaces and software structures.
  • Designing and developing PLC software, functional descriptions and structured code for complex marine, offshore and energy systems.
  • Developing automation solutions for BMS, PMS and hybrid energy systems, including ESS, shore power and generator control.
  • Integrating, configuring and commissioning variable-frequency drives and motor and pump-control systems, including various solutions.
  • Performing network and system integration across automation, electrical and third-party systems.
  • Conducting FAT, SAT and commissioning activities both onshore and offshore.
  • Troubleshooting live systems and resolving complex technical issues on critical installations.
  • Reviewing and quality-assuring automation designs, software and technical documentation.
  • Supporting and mentoring less experienced engineers and contributing to the development of internal standards and best practices.
  • Maintaining close technical dialogue with project management, customers, suppliers and other engineering disciplines.

Your profile & qualifications
You have a technical background in automation, electrical engineering or mechatronics and solid experience from the energy, power generation, oil and gas, offshore wind or maritime industries.
You are comfortable working with complex systems where safety, reliability and uptime are essential. You approach your responsibilities proactively, communicate clearly and are capable of taking technical ownership while remaining a strong team player.

We expect that you:
  • Have at least five years of experience with PLC programming in Siemens TIA Portal, preferably using SCL.
  • Have experience developing automation solutions for energy, marine or offshore applications.
  • Have a strong understanding of automation architecture, industrial networks and protocols such as Profinet, Modbus TCP and CAN/J1939.
  • Have knowledge of energy systems, power management or hybrid solutions such as ESS and shore power.
  • Have experience with variable-frequency drives, motor control and commissioning. Experience with Danfoss VLT or VACON products will be considered an advantage.
  • Can translate functional and operational requirements into scalable, structured and well-documented software.
  • Are capable of reviewing technical solutions and guiding colleagues on complex automation-related matters.
  • Thrive in a project-driven environment with close interdisciplinary collaboration and customer interaction.
  • Are willing to participate in commissioning and service assignments both onshore and offshore.
  • Are professionally fluent in English. Danish language skills will be considered an advantage.

Welcome to Semco Maritime 

At Semco Maritime, we create change. For people. For projects. And for the global energy sector. With us, you will join a community of over 2,300 of the most dedicated thinkers and doers in the energy industry who are driving real change and making their own personal mark on the global energy landscape. 

While everyone knows why the energy transition is vital, we are concerned with the journey. How to get there. By providing the answers needed to make change real. Because we believe that global energy ambitions can only be realized through hard work and clever pragmatic solutions. This is what we do. This is what we invite you to participate in. 

Safety is at the core of everything we do, and we are committed to protecting our people, partners, and the planet as we work towards a sustainable energy future. 

So yes, working for us will change the energy sector – and may well change you too.  

We know that our people are our greatest strength. We strive to build an inclusive workplace where everyone can be themselves, contribute their perspectives, and feel part of the team. We welcome applicants from all backgrounds and believe that diverse teams help us find better solutions and move the energy transition forward.   

Care to join the movement? 
Change. With us. 

Semco Maritime is an international engineering and contracting company with 2,300 employees and 40 years of dedication rooted in both the conventional energy sector and the offshore wind industry. This puts us in a unique position to bridge today's and tomorrow’s solutions, constantly seeking clever and pragmatic ways to realise global energy ambitions. We do this through comprehensive project management across all phases of energy projects together with world-leading partners across the globe.

jobs.description:
Me etsimme heimoomme innostunutta ja huippua tyyppiä, jolla hymy ei hyydy ja jonka tiimitaidot ovat huipussaan. Vapaus, heimous, nälkä ja sydän - nämä ovat arvoja, jotka ohjaavat meidän toimintaamme ja ovat yhteisen tekemisemme peruskallio.

Sä olet taatusti täydellinen tyyppi meidän heimoon, mikäli...

- ...sulla on kyky vastaanottaa "vapautta", tehdä ja toteuttaa. Me nimittäin pyritään jakamaan vapautta ja halutaankin, että sen voimin sä vaikutat, osallistut ja otat vastuuta arjesta ja osastostasi sekä sen toiminnasta.
- ...sulla on heimoutta eli oikeaa tiimipelaamisen taikaa. Meidän mielestä hyvän heimon voimatekijöitä ovat luottamus, kunnioitus, avoimuus ja menestymisen asenne. Hyvä heimo muodostaa toimivan tiimikulttuurin, mikä on edellytys huipputuloksiin pääsemiselle. Meidän heimon kulttuurissa vaaditaan, että asiat käsitellään keskustellen kasvokkain eikä selän takana juoruillen ja yhteistä tekemistä sabotoiden. Mikäli siis rakastat ihmisten välistä draamaa ja villejä käänteitä, ei tämä paikka ole sulle.
- ...sulla on nälkää tehdä hommia hyvällä draivilla ja haluat menestyä tiiminä. Haastat itseäsi menemään kohti uusia jännittäviä tilanteita, ja olet valmis oppimisen uhalla myös mokaamaan.
- ...sulla on sydäntä heittäytyä tekemiseen täysillä, antaa ja vastaanottaa palautetta sekä olla valmis kasvamaan ja kehittämään itseäsi ja ajatteluasi. Ymmärrät, että ainoa pysyvä asia on muutos, ja haluat olla siinä mukana.

Tää kaupan työ on hurjan monipuolista ja asioita tehdään ripeällä tahdilla! Meillä on huikeat asiakkaat, jotka pyritään aina kohtaamaan aidosti, lämpimällä ja rempseällä otteella. Ihanien asiakkaiden lisäksi meillä on huikea tiimi eli heimo, jolla duunia painaa! Tässä työssä sä työskentelet myyjänä molemmissa toimipisteissämme K-Market Kissanmaalla ja K-Market Ilmarinkadulla. Työajat painottuvat pitkälti arki-iltoihin sekä viikonlopun vuoroihin.

Odotamme sulta...

- Me odotetaan sulta tähän rooliin kokemusta päivittäistavarakaupasta ja sen monipuolisesta maailmasta. Me odotetaan, että sulla on oikea asenne, osaat tehdä virheitä ja oppia niistä, haluat kasvaa ja kehittyä tiimissä ja oot valmis heittäytymään uuteen ennakkoluulottomasti. Mikäli sä oot huikee tyyppi huikeella asenteella, tuut oppimaan miten meillä toimitaan.
- Psst! Vaaditaan sulta 18 vuoden ikää!

Tarjoamme sulle:

- Me tarjotaan sulle kaikki yllä mainittu eli ihana heimo, huikeat asiakkaat sekä kehittyvä ja ajan hermoilla taituroivat K-Marketit. Me tarjotaan sulle kuuntelevaa ja heimolaisiaan arvostavaa johtajuutta ja kulttuuria, jossa epäkohdat nostetaan matalalla kynnyksellä esille.
- Psst! Lisäksi tarjotaan sulle tottakai kattavat K-ryhmän henkilökuntaedut!

Työsuhde alkaa elo-syyskuun aikana.

Lähetä hakemuksesi osoitteeseen joona.pesonen@k-market.com / matilda.tistelgren@k-market.com. Paikka täytetään heti sopivan henkilön löydyttyä, kuitenkin viimeistään 23.8.2026

Me K-ryhmässä arvostamme monimuotoisuutta ja uskomme, että erilaiset taustat ja näkökulmat ovat avain menestykseen. Pyrimme luomaan työympäristön, jossa jokaisella on mahdollisuus kehittyä. Yhdenvertaisuus, syrjimättömyys ja oikeudenmukaisuus ovat keskeisiä periaatteitamme rekrytoinnissa, palkitsemisessa ja urakehityksessä.

jobs.title: Verksamhetsansvarig för Låktatjåkko fjällstationen
jobs.description:
Verksamhetsansvarig för Låktatjåkko fjällstationen

Här får du kombinera närvarande ledarskap, värdskap och operativ drift med ansvar för ekonomi, personal och utveckling av en verksamhet utöver det vanliga.

Låktatjåkko Fjällstation är en del av Lapland Resorts och ligger i väglöst land, cirka nio kilometer från Björkliden. Fjällstationen erbjuder boende, restaurang och personliga fjällupplevelser i en miljö där väder, transporter och naturens förutsättningar är en naturlig del av vardagen.

Om rollen

Som verksamhetsansvarig har du det övergripande ansvaret för verksamheten på Låktatjåkko Fjällstation.

Du ansvarar för den dagliga driften, gästupplevelsen, ekonomin och ett team på cirka 10–13 medarbetare bestående av Låktavärdar och kökspersonal, något som varierar mellan säsongerna.

Du leder verksamheten nära både gäster och medarbetare och säkerställer att fjällstationen bedrivs med hög kvalitet, god service, säkerhet och ekonomi.

Rollen är delvis operativ. Det innebär att du planerar, leder och följer upp verksamheten, samtidigt som du vid behov arbetar tillsammans med teamet i den dagliga driften. Du rapporterar till F&B-manager och samarbetar nära med flera olika avdelningar.

Dina huvudsakliga ansvarsområden

I rollen ansvarar du bland annat för att:

    leda, planera och följa upp den dagliga verksamheten

    säkerställa en trygg, personlig och professionell gästupplevelse

    ha personalansvar för cirka 10–13 medarbetare

    rekrytera och introducera personal till verksamheten

    planera bemanning och schema utifrån verksamhetens behov och budget

    genomföra avstämningar, FeedForward-samtal och medarbetarsamtal

    följa upp intäkter, kostnader, inköp, lager och svinn

    planera leveranser och logistik utifrån fjällstationens särskilda förutsättningar

    säkerställa att hygien-, livsmedels- och säkerhetsrutiner följs

    ansvara för det löpande arbetsmiljöarbetet inom verksamheten

    utveckla fjällstationens arbetssätt, erbjudande och gästupplevelse

    delta i det operativa arbetet när verksamheten kräver det

Vem söker vi?

Vi söker dig som är en trygg, tydlig och lösningsorienterad ledare. Du trivs med ett stort eget ansvar och har förmåga att skapa struktur även när förutsättningarna förändras.

Du är prestigelös och bekväm med att växla mellan ledarskap, administration och operativt arbete. Du förstår att närvarande ledarskap på Låktatjåkko innebär att ibland arbeta sida vid sida med teamet.

För att trivas behöver du uppskatta fjällmiljön och vara bekväm med att arbetsplatsen ligger avskilt och nås till fots eller med olika transportlösningar beroende på säsong.

Vi tror att du har:

    Flera års erfarenhet av personalansvar och ledarskap

    1-2 års erfarenhet från hotell, restaurang, destination, turism eller liknande verksamhet

    erfarenhet av rekrytering, introduktion och personalplanering

    förståelse för ekonomi, budget och kostnadsuppföljning

    god förmåga att planera, prioritera och fatta beslut

    god kommunikativ förmåga på svenska och engelska

    ett genuint intresse för värdskap och gästupplevelser

    förmåga att arbeta självständigt och ta ansvar för helheten

Det är meriterande om du har erfarenhet av:

    fjäll-, destinations- eller säsongsverksamhet

    livsmedelshygien och egenkontroll

    arbetsmiljö- och säkerhetsarbete

    schemaläggning och arbete med kollektivavtal

    inköp, lager och logistisk planering

Som person är du

    trygg och tydlig i ditt ledarskap

    strukturerad och ekonomiskt medveten

    flexibel och lösningsorienterad

    prestigelös och operativ när det behövs

    närvarande och engagerad

    bekväm med att fatta beslut

    mån om både gästupplevelsen och medarbetarnas arbetsmiljö

Vi erbjuder

Hos oss får du möjlighet att leda och utveckla en verksamhet i en av Sveriges mest spektakulära fjällmiljöer.

jobs.title: Project assistant: Formulation development of novel tuberculosis compounds into long acting injectables at SDU in Odense
jobs.description:
A two-year position within pharmaceutical sciences focusing on formulation development and biopharmaceutical understanding of the performance of novel compounds for the treatment of tuberculosis is available at the Department of Physics, Chemistry, and Pharmacy in the pharmacy research group. 

Starting date: 01 October 2026, or as soon as possible thereafter. 

Application deadline: 31 August 2026

Project background

Long-acting injectables (LAIs) are pharmaceutical products intended for weekly, monthly or with an even lower administration frequency, which provides a continued drug release and thereby a steady exposure of the delivered compound. LAIs are typically administered intramuscularly (IM) or subcutaneously (SC) as oil solutions, in situ forming gels, microspheres, implants, micro- or nanosuspensions, with focus on suspensions in the present work. For individuals suffering of tuberculosis LAIs can provide a huge benefit in disease treatment, due to the long duration time the disease requires. 

LAIs have, with huge clinical success, been applied in the treatment of antipsychotic conditions and the area contains some of the most successful LAI formulations seen from a therapeutic perspective. In the 1960s, oil-based parenteral depot formulations, containing antipsychotics, were introduced in the clinical practice. Since then, the micro- and nanosuspension technology has significantly advanced and many of the more recent LAIs are nano-or microsuspensions. Hence, this is currently one of the important technologies in the field of LAIs and also the focus of the present project. 

The common approach to manipulate the performance of LAI suspensions release rate relies on changing particle size distribution of the crystalline API. This strategy is fundamentally explained by the Noyes-Whitney equation, which describes the dissolution rate of particles in sink conditions. According to the Noyes-Whitney equation, the dissolution rate is proportional to the total surface area of the drug particles. Some commercial products confirms thus and also a few academical studies have reported correlations between the particle size and the in vivo release, hence it is clearly a point that should be clarified when working with a new compound for a LAI suspension. Aside from particle size, other formulation aspects can significantly impact performance, such as formulation composition and the level of flocculation. In addition, API crystal form properties, such as morphology, level of amorphous contents and residual solvent in the API, may have a significant impact on dissolution, indicating that the selection of version and form is crucial not only for manufacturability and stability purposes, but also for performance.

This project aligns closely with Quality by Design (QbD) principles, emphasizing risk assessment, formulation understanding, and robust design space development, but systematically investigating the formulation impact on in vivo release of LAI suspensions in nonclinical models using the obtained data to generate a risk matrix for in vivo impact of potential particle size variations. A successful outcome of this project will provide a formulation that can be taken to clinical trials for the treatment of tuberculosis with the tools to understand the biopharmaceutical performance of LAI suspensions with the relevant compounds supported by quality tools on the stability. 

The work will be conducted in close cooperation with Professor René Holm and other colleagues working on the project.

Qualifications

  • We are looking for a candidate with a strong interest in working with pharmaceutical formulation and evaluation focused on formulation and characterization of suspensions. 

  • The candidate will hold a BSc, a M.Sc. in pharmacy, chemistry, or closely related area. 

  • Previous experiences with one or more of the following are considered an advantage: 

    • formulation design of suspensions, 

    • particle size characterization, 

    • chemical stability studies,

    •  bioanalysis, and 

    • in vivo studies.

The candidate must be independent and fluent in English both orally and written. 

For further information about the position please contact Professor René Holm (reho@sdu.dk).

Natural Science Research – Interdisciplinary Strength

The Department of Physics, Chemistry and Pharmacy is one of four departments at the Faculty of Science, SDU and is located in Odense. At the Department, we contribute to solving some of society’s greatest challenges within energy, environment, health, and sustainability. We succeed because we build bridges between disciplines and transcend traditional boundaries. Our interdisciplinary mindset is not only a fundamental condition, but also our strength. And it is a strength that ensures our research and education are recognized both nationally and internationally.

Our vision is to create and apply knowledge across the natural sciences. We are unique in housing research within physics, chemistry, and pharmacy under one department, which provides excellent opportunities to explore the intersections between these disciplines. Read more about our vision here.

Employment shall take place in accordance with the framework agreement between the Ministry of Finance and AC (the Danish Confederation of Professional Associations).

Application must include cover letter, CV and certificate. All documents in connection with the application should not contain CPR number (civil registration number) – in that case, the CPR number must be crossed out.

All attached files must be in Adobe PDF format. Cover letter and CV can contain max. 5 Mb.

We recommend that you read how to apply before you apply.

The University wishes our staff to reflect the diversity of society and thus welcomes applications from all qualified candidates regardless of personal background.

About SDU

The University of Southern Denmark was established to create value for and with society. Whether our contributions come in the form of excellent research, innovative solutions, education or learning, we must make a positive difference to society and contribute to a sustainable future. We do this by cultivating talents and creating the best environments for research and learning. It is therefore crucial that SDU retains, develops and recruits talent. At the same time, we need to ensure consistently high quality in all our activities – and we can only do that with the right people. The University’s researchers, lecturers, students, managers and technical/administrative staff are the foundation of our success.

jobs.title: Postdoctoral Research Fellow in Algal Microbiome Engineering
jobs.employer: UNIVERSITETET I TROMSØ - NORGES ARKTISKE UNIVERSITET UIT CAMPUS TROMSØ
jobs.description:
The position

At the Norwegian College of Fishery Science, Faculty of Biosciences, Fisheries and Economics (BFE) at UiT The Arctic University of Norway, there is a vacant position as a postdoctoral researcher affiliated with the Microalgae & Microbiomes Research Group. The position is for a fixed term of 3 years. It is a prerequisite that the applicant can carry out the project over the full course of the employment period. No person may hold more than one fixed term position as a Postdoctoral Research Fellow at the same institution.

The postdoctoral project focuses on programmable marine microbiomes and mechanistic interactions within the diatom phycosphere, with particular emphasis on synthetic biology, microbial ecology, and molecular interactions between marine microalgae and associated bacteria. The successful candidate will contribute to the development of experimental model systems for studying metabolite exchange, microbial community interactions, and engineered microbial consortia in marine environments.

The position is affiliated with ongoing research activities in marine microbiology, synthetic biology, and systems biology at UiT. The research combines microbiology, molecular biology, microbial cultivation, genome-informed molecular ecology, synthetic biology, and multi-omics approaches to better understand and engineer marine microbial ecosystems relevant to carbon cycling and marine biotechnology.

As a Postdoctoral Research Fellow, you will have the opportunity to advance your scientific career and further qualify for academic positions. If you do not already have the educational competence that meets the requirements for an Associate Professor position in Norway, UiT will arrange such competence during the employment period.

The workplace is at UiT in Tromsø. You must be able to start in the position within a reasonable time after receiving the offer.


The project/position's field of research

The postdoctoral researcher will develop and apply experimental approaches for studying mechanistic interactions between marine microalgae and associated bacterial communities within the diatom phycosphere. The project will focus on the development of programmable and experimentally tractable microbial model systems using synthetic biology, microbial cultivation, and molecular biology approaches.

The successful candidate will work with cultivation and engineering of marine bacteria and microalgae, construction of synthetic microbial consortia, and investigation of microbial metabolite exchange relevant to nutrient cycling and carbon fixation in marine ecosystems. The project may also involve transcriptomics, genomics, metabolomics, and bioinformatics analyses to investigate molecular interactions between diatoms and associated microorganisms.

The position is part of a broader research program focused on programmable marine microbiomes, marine microbial ecology, and biotechnology applications relevant to climate resilience, sustainable aquaculture, and marine carbon cycling. The postdoctoral researcher will work in an interdisciplinary and international research environment and is expected to contribute actively to scientific publications, collaborative research activities, and external funding development.

You must submit a project proposal (max 2 pages) that describes how you scientifically can contribute to designing diatom phycosphere communities through the uses of engineered genetic circuits or other synthetic biology tools. The proposal should include your view on the state-of-the-art and opportunities for achievable but ground-breaking science with regards to engineering microbial consortia and non-traditional synthetic biology hosts. The proposal must include a progress plan.


Contact

For further information about the position, please contact Group Leader Hans Christopher Bernstein:

  • email: hans.c.bernstein@uit.no 

 or the Head of Department Bjørn Petter Finstad: 

  • email: bjornpetter.finstad@uit.no 

Qualifications

Required qualifications: 

  • A Norwegian doctoral degree or an equivalent foreign doctoral degree recognized as equivalent to a Norwegian PhD in microbiology, molecular biology, biotechnology, synthetic biology, marine biology, microbial ecology, systems biology, chemical engineering, bioengineering, or another relevant discipline. If you're in the final stages of your PhD, you may still apply for the position, provided that you submit parts of your dissertation along with your application. This enables the evaluation committee to assess the quality and likelihood of completion by the desired employment date. You must include a statement from your supervisor or institution stating the expected completion date for your PhD degree. Documentation of your completed PhD degree must be submitted before commencement.
  • Excellent written and oral English language skills. Nordic applicants can document their capabilities by attaching their high school diploma.
  • Documented experience in experimental microbiology, molecular biology, and scientific publishing, including publication of research in peer reviewed international journals. Experience in one or more of the following areas is required:
    • synthetic biology
    • microbial cultivation
    • marine microbiology or marine microbial ecology
    • microalgae research
    • molecular cloning and genetic engineering
    • microbial ecology
    • microbial co-cultivation systems

Desired qualifications: 

  • Experience working with non-model microorganisms and/or developing molecular tools for environmental microorganisms is considered particularly advantageous.
  • Experience with one or more of the following areas is considered an advantage:
    • microbial genomics, transcriptomics, or metagenomics
    • bioinformatics and analysis of omics datasets
    • metabolomics or analytical chemistry
    • microbial community analysis
    • programming/scripting in R, Python, or similar languages
    • systems biology or computational biology
  • Knowledge of a Scandinavian language or willingness to learn Norwegian is considered an advantage.

The successful candidate must be able to work independently and as part of an interdisciplinary research team. Emphasis will also be placed on motivation, potential for research, scientific creativity, organizational skills, communication abilities, and personal suitability for the position.

In the assessment the main emphasis will be attached to the submitted works and the project proposal for the qualifying work. Emphasis shall also be attached to experience from popularization/dissemination and academic policy and administrative activity.

At UiT we put emphasis on the quality, relevance and significance of the research work and not on where the work is published, in accordance with the principles of The San Francisco Declaration on Research Assessment (DORA).


Inclusion and diversity  

UiT The Arctic University i Norway is working actively to promote equality, gender balance and diversity among employees and students, and to create an inclusive and safe working environment. We believe that inclusion and diversity is a strength, and we want employees with different competencies, professional experience, life experience and perspectives.  

If you have a disability, a gap in your CV or immigrant background, we encourage you to tick the box for this in your application. If there are qualified applicants, we invite least one in each group for an interview. If you get the job, we will adapt the working conditions if you need it. Apart from selecting the right candidates, we will only use the information for anonymous statistics. 


We offer
  • Involvement in an interesting research project 
  • Good career opportunities 
  • A good academic environment with dedicated colleagues  
  • Flexible working hours and a state collective pay agreement  
  • Pension scheme through the state pension fund 

Norwegian health policy aims to ensure that everyone, irrespective of their personal finances and where they live, has access to good health and care services of equal standard. As an employee you will become member of the National Insurance Scheme which also include health care services.

More practical information for working and living in Norway can be found here: https://uit.no/staffmobility 


Application

Please note that the application will only be assessed based on the information submitted by the application deadline via Jobbnorge. It is therefore important that you include all necessary documents demonstrating your qualifications for the position.

Your application must include:

  • Application letter
  • Project proposal (max 2 pages)
  • CV
  • Diplomas and transcripts (all degrees)
  • Documentation of English proficiency
  • Contact information to 2-3 references
  • Documentation of educational competence, if available
  • Description of your academic production, stating which works you consider most important
  • The academic works (published or not) you wish us to take into consideration in the assessment

If you're in the final stages of your PhD, you may still apply for the position, provided that you submit parts of your dissertation along with your application. This enables the evaluation committee to assess the quality and likelihood of completion by the desired employment date. You must include a statement from your supervisor or institution stating the expected completion date for your PhD degree. Documentation of your completed PhD degree must be submitted before commencement.

All documentation to be considered must be in a Scandinavian language or English. If English proficiency is not documented in the application, it must be documented before starting in the position. 


Assessment

The applicants will be assessed by an expert committee. The committee's mandate is to undertake an assessment of the applicants' qualifications based on the written material presented by the applicants, and the detailed description draw up for the position. A copy of the assessment report will be sent to all applicants. 

The applicants who are assessed as best qualified will be called to an interview. The interview should among other things, aim to clarify the applicant’s motivation and personal suitability for the position. A trial lecture may also be held.


General information

The appointment is made in accordance with State regulations and guidelines at UiT. At our website, you will find more information for applicants. 

The remuneration for Postdoctoral research fellow is in accordance with the State salary scale code 1352 with a gross annual salary ranging from NOK 650'-760' (in a 100% position). (In special cases, a higher salary may be considered.) A compulsory contribution of 2 % to the Norwegian Public Service Pension Fund will be deducted. You will become a member of the Norwegian Public Service Pension Fund, which gives you many benefits in addition to a lifelong pension. Read more about your employee benefits at: spk.no.

The successful candidate must be willing to get involved in the ongoing development of their department and the university as a whole.

UiT wishes to promote gender equality. If two or more applicants are found to be equally qualified, the university will rank applicants from the underrepresented gender ahead of others.

According to the Norwegian Freedom and Information Act (Offentleglova) information about the applicant may be included in the public applicant list, also in cases where the applicant has requested non-disclosure. 


Om arbeidsgiveren:

UiT The Arctic University of Norway is a multi-campus research university and the northernmost university of the world. Our central location in the High North, our broad and diverse research and study portfolio, and our interdisciplinary qualities make us uniquely suited to meet the challenges of the future. At UiT you can explore global issues from a close-up perspective.

Credibility, academic freedom, closeness, creativity and commitment shall be hallmarks of the relationship between our employees, between our employees and our students and between UiT and our partners. 

The Faculty of Biosciences, Fisheries and Economics (BFE) consists of Department of Arctic and Marine Biology, Norwegian College of Fishery Science (NFH) and School of Business and Economics.The main task of BFE is to conduct teaching and research dissemination at a high national and international level within all relevant fields. Prioritized research areas are aquatic and terrestrial ecosystems, climate, life in the arctic, marine bioprospecting, fish health, seafood products, business and macroeconomics, resources and environment, markets and management of marine resources. The interdisciplinary profile of the faculty provides good opportunity to develop research projects involving several research groups at the faculty according to its strategy.

jobs.title: Associate Director, Clinical Regulatory Writing
jobs.description:
Are you passionate about transforming science into clear and compelling regulatory documents that drive successful drug development? We are seeking a talented and experienced Associate Director, Clinical Regulatory Writing to join our CVRM (Cardiovascular, Renal and Metabolism) Clinical Regulatory Writing team in Gothenburg, Sweden. With more than 2,400 employees from over 50 countries, our vibrant Gothenburg site is a truly inspiring place to work - where the history and future of scientific breakthroughs come together. We believe that the diversity of our people is crucial to bringing new discoveries to life.



Accountabilities:

The CVRM Clinical Regulatory Writing group provides expert strategic leadership and communications expertise to clinical drug programs, ensuring delivery of high-quality, label-focused documents aligned with project strategy, regulatory requirements, and communications best practices. Role holders not only author critical clinical-regulatory documents but also act as critical reviewers to achieve the highest quality standards. Team members also represent the Clinical Regulatory Writing skill set on both drug and non-drug projects, advocating for best practices and continuous improvement.



Key Responsibilities

As an Associate Director, Clinical Regulatory Writing, you will:

    

Provide strategic leadership and communication expertise to clinical drug programs across the CVRM portfolio.

    

Author and critically review clinical-regulatory documents, ensuring the highest regulatory, technical, and quality standards.

    

Represent Clinical Regulatory Writing on project teams, advocating for communication best practices.

    

Provide strategic communications leadership within clinical delivery or submission teams, establishing standards and promoting quality and efficiency.

    

Act as NDA/MAA submission lead, driving the development of the clinical Submission Communication Strategy (cSCS) and successful submission delivery.

    

Lead both internal and external authoring teams and cultivate strong partnerships with vendor medical writers to ensure timely, high-quality document delivery.

    

Translate complex clinical data into clear, concise, and accurate messages tailored to specific audiences.

    

Support the development and upskilling of colleagues within the Clinical Regulatory Writing function.

    

Champion continuous improvement and operational excellence in communications.



Essential Skills/Experience:

    

Bachelor's degree in Life Sciences or a related discipline.

    

Significant medical writing experience within the pharmaceutical industry or a Contract Research Organization (CRO).

    

Proven ability to advise and lead communications projects and teams.

    

Strong understanding of drug development and the communications process from early development through to launch and lifecycle management.

    

In-depth knowledge of technical and regulatory requirements relevant to clinical regulatory writing.



Desirable Skills/Experience:

    

Advanced degree in scientific discipline (e.g., Ph.D.).



If you are driven to deliver impactful regulatory communications, excel in multidisciplinary teams, and want to shape the future of clinical development, we encourage you to apply.



Apply with your CV and cover letter by 30 August!

jobs.title: Myyjiä, S-market Pohjolankatu Iisalmi
jobs.description:
Primary location:
KUOPIO

S-MARKET POHJOLANKATU IISALMI etsii nyt MYYJIÄ vakituisiin työsuhteisiin - ihan tavallisiin töihin, harvinaisen mukavien työkavereiden joukkoon

Sopimustunnit: 4-37,5 t/vk
Työt alkavat: sopimuksen mukaan syksyllä 2026

Työtä kuvataan usein korulauseilla, mutta meidän mielestämme tavallisuudessa ei ole mitään pahaa. Me Osuuskauppa PeeÄssällä sanomme olevamme ihan tavallisissa töissä - eikä se tarkoita tylsää porukkaa, päinvastoin. Työ on hyvää ja sujuvaa arkea, jossa teemme myös muiden arjesta, ja välillä juhlastakin, vähän parempaa. Ja joskus juhlitaan itsekin. Jos työpaikkailmoitusten kliseet kyllästyttävät, tule meille ihan tavallisiin töihin.

S-market Pohjolankatu on Iisalmen keskustaan avautuva uusi kauppapaikka, jossa pääset mukaan rakentamaan myymälän toimintaa alusta asti. Uudessa S-marketissa luodaan yhdessä tekemisen tavat, jotka helpottavat niin asiakkaiden asiointia kuin tiimin yhteistä työskentelyä. Laajojen aukioloaikojen myymälässä päivät ovat monipuolisia ja vaihtelevia, ja jokaisen työntekijän panos näkyy heti. Onnistuminen syntyy siitä, että myymälä on kunnossa, asiakkaat kohdataan hyvin ja työkaverit pidetään mukana.

Myyjänä päiväsi kuluvat vaihtelevassa rytmissä kassatyön, kuorman purun ja hyllytyksen parissa - välillä olet myös asiakasetsivä, joka auttaa löytämään sen oikean jogurtin. Työhösi kuuluu lisäksi hävikin ja saatavuuden hallintaa, eli pidät huolen siitä, että hyllyt ovat täynnä ja hävikki pysyy mahdollisimman pienenä. Perehdytämme sinut monipuolisesti koko kaupan saloihin: kassasta kuormaan, kampanjoiden esillepanoon ja varaston hallintaan asti. Työ on liikkuvaa ja nopeatempoista, joten päivät kuluvat vauhdilla eikä tekeminen käy yksitoikkoiseksi.

Tämä työ sopii sinulle, jos viihdyt asiakkaiden parissa, tartut hommiin reippaasti ja tykkäät tehdä töitä yhdessä muiden kanssa - ja jos arvostat poikkeuksellisen hyviä henkilökunta-aleja, kannustavaa työporukkaa ja sitä pientä ylpeyden tunnetta, kun asiakas lähtee kaupasta hymy huulilla. Työ on vuorotyötä, ja odotamme hakijoilta valmiutta työskennellä vaihtelevissa työvuoroissa toimipaikan laajojen aukioloaikojen mukaan, myös öisin ja juhlapyhinä.

Edellytämme sujuvaa suomen kielen taitoa.
Arvostamme kaupan alan työkokemusta ja koulutusta.

Mitä se ihan tavallinen työ meillä on
- Henkilökuntaetuja: alennuksia ruoasta, juomasta, meikeistä, elektroniikasta, ravintoloista, hotelleista, pankkipalveluista ja monesta muusta mukavasta asiasta.
- Epassin etuja: jopa 250 € arvosta vuodessa.
- Rahaa: työehtosopimuksen mukainen palkka, 11,16 €/t - 14,93 €/t kokemusvuosista riippuen. Lisät tuovat kivasti extraa, ne maksetaan myös TES:n mukaisesti.
- Tulospalkkaus: mahdollisuus ansaita ylimääräinen jopa 2 kuukauden palkka vuodessa.
- Työpaikka, johon on kiva tulla ja olla. Ei tarvitse olla yhtä iloista perhettä, mutta älä ylläty, jos työkavereista tulee ihan vaan kavereita.
- Mahdollisuus vaihtaa tehtäviä tai alaa: jos itse haluat.

Jos ihan tavallinen työ hyvässä porukassa kuulostaa sinun jutultasi, hae mukaan jo tänään.

Hakuaika päättyy: 23.8.2026.

Lisätietoja: marketpäällikkö Mari Levoskin, mari.levoskin@sok.fi tai kenttäpäällikkö Joonas Marjanen, joonas.marjanen@sok.fi, puh. 050 348 6353


Osuuskauppa PeeÄssä on yli 134 000 asiakasomistajan omistama palvelualan yritys Pohjois-Savossa. Tavoitteenamme on olla Parhaan Elämän Edelläkävijä Savossa. Meille se tarkoittaa merkityksellistä työtä, reilua työnantajuutta ja arjen sujuvuutta. Olemme ylpeitä siitä, että voimme tuottaa osuustoiminnallista hyötyä ja kehittää sitä jatkuvasti arvojemme mukaisesti: #tunteella, #toimeliaasti, #ylpeästi ja #yhdessä.

jobs.title: Architecte du bâtiment (H/F)
jobs.description:
Barcelone - Espagne
Rejoignez le futur pôle d'ingénierie et développement du groupe AXOR
Dans le cadre de son développement, AXOR Ingénierie souhaite faire de Barcelone son futur pôle d'ingénierie, de coordination et de développement pour l'ensemble du groupe.
Déjà implanté sur plusieurs marchés, le groupe accompagne ses clients dans la conception, l'ingénierie, la fabrication et le déploiement de structures métalliques destinées aux bâtiments industriels, tertiaires et résidentiels.
Nous recherchons aujourd'hui un Architecte Responsable d'Agence capable d'allier expertise technique, pilotage de projets et esprit entrepreneurial.
Votre mission
Rattaché à la Direction Générale du groupe, vous assurez la responsabilité technique et opérationnelle de l'agence de Barcelone.
Vous intervenez sur les projets de l'esquisse jusqu'à la réalisation, tout en participant à la structuration de l'activité locale, à la coordination des équipes et au développement futur du pôle Barcelone.
Vos principales responsabilités
Expertise technique et suivi des projets
- Assurer la mise au point des projets de l'esquisse au DCE : plans, coupes, façades, carnets de détails ;
- Établir et superviser les pièces écrites et graphiques relatives aux dossiers administratifs : PC, PA, permis de démolir ;
- Produire et suivre les pièces graphiques relatives aux marchés de travaux ;
- Gérer, coordonner et synthétiser les éléments des différents intervenants : maîtrise d'ouvrage, services d'urbanisme, bureaux d'études, bureaux de contrôle, partenaires techniques ;
- Analyser la faisabilité technique des projets et proposer des solutions adaptées.
Développement, coordination et management
- Participer à la structuration de l'agence de Barcelone et de ses méthodes de travail ;
- Contribuer au recrutement, à l'intégration et au pilotage progressif des futures équipes ;
- Développer un réseau de partenaires et représenter AXOR auprès des acteurs du secteur ;
- Participer au développement de nouvelles activités liées aux structures métalliques, à l'enveloppe du bâtiment et aux solutions constructives innovantes.
Profil recherché
- Formation Architecte ou équivalent ;
- Expérience confirmée en cabinet d'architecture, bureau d'études, ingénierie, construction ou environnement similaire ;
- Bonne connaissance de la réglementation bâtiment : ERP, RT 2012, RE 2020, Code du Travail, ICPE, PMR, CDAC/CNAC ;
- Maîtrise des outils professionnels : Autocad, Revit, Photoshop, SketchUp, BIM ou équivalent ;
- Expérience en coordination de projets, pilotage d'activité ou management appréciée ;
- Esprit entrepreneurial, autonomie et capacité à structurer une activité locale ;
- Rigueur, réactivité, sens du relationnel et goût pour le travail en équipe ;
- Goût pour l'innovation constructive et les environnements internationaux.
Langues
- Français courant indispensable ;
- Espagnol professionnel indispensable ;
- Anglais apprécié ;
- Turc apprécié.
Ce poste s'adresse à vous si..
En plus d'une solide compétence technique, nous recherchons une personne capable de s'investir durablement dans un projet ambitieux, avec l'envie de participer activement à la construction et au développement d'une organisation appelée à jouer un rôle stratégique dans la croissance du groupe.
Cadre de la collaboration :
- CDI ;
- Poste basé à Barcelone ;
- Déplacements ponctuels à prévoir en France et auprès des partenaires du groupe ;
- Rémunération selon profil et expérience.

jobs.description:
Haemme reipasta avustajaa päivittäisen arjen tueksi vuonna 1975 syntyneelle, MS-tautia sairastavalle miehelle. Työssä avustat monipuolisesti kaikissa päivittäistoiminnoissa, kuten siirtymisissä esimerkiksi pyörätuoliin, pukeutumisessa sekä kodin ulkopuolisilla asioinneilla.

Työtehtäviin kuuluvat myös kodinhoidolliset työt, kuten siivous, ruuanlaitto ja omakotitalon pihatöihin liittyvät tehtävät. Työnantaja perehdyttää työtehtäviin, joten aiempi kokemus avustajan työstä ei ole välttämätön.

Työaika on ma, ke ja to klo 8–16, yhteensä 24 tuntia viikossa. Lisäksi on mahdollisuus lisätunteihin vapaa-ajan avustajana. Perheessä on koira ja toivomme, että tulet toimeen myös eläinten kanssa.

Työpaikalle pääsee kulkemaan näppärästi bussilla, sillä Fölin bussipysäkki on n. 200m päässä. Tuntipalkka on B1-palkkaluokan mukaisesti 13,73€, työsuhteen alussa on koeaika.

Työsuhde alkaa heti sopivan avustajan löydyttyä. Jos koet olevasi luotettava, reipas ja haluat olla mukana tekemässä arjesta sujuvampaa, laita vapaamuotoinen hakemus sähköpostilla osoitteeseen tanja.halme@avustajakeskus.fi.

jobs.title: Cleaning Inspector/Service Manager
jobs.description:
Cleaning Inspector (Quality Control Inspector)

We are looking for a reliable and detail-oriented Cleaning Inspector to join our professional cleaning company in Denmark.

As a Cleaning Inspector, you will be responsible for ensuring that residential and commercial cleaning services meet the

company's quality standards. You will conduct inspections after cleaning, identify areas that require improvement, provide

feedback to cleaning staff, and ensure customer satisfaction.

Key Responsibilities:

* Inspect completed cleaning work at residential and commercial properties.

* Ensure all cleaning tasks meet company quality standards.

* Report any issues and follow up on corrective actions.

* Train and guide cleaning staff on proper cleaning procedures and quality expectations.

* Communicate professionally with clients when necessary.

* Complete inspection reports using a mobile phone or tablet.

* Monitor cleaners' performance and maintain high service standards.

Requirements:

* Previous experience in professional cleaning or quality inspection is preferred.

* Strong attention to detail and high standards of cleanliness.

* Good communication skills in English (Danish is an advantage but not required).

* Ability to work independently and manage multiple locations.

* Valid driver's license is an advantage.

* Reliable, responsible, and punctual.

We Offer:

* Competitive salary based on qualifications and experience.

* 37 Hours per week

Training and career development opportunities. A supportive and professional work environment.

* Opportunity to grow within a fast-growing cleaning company.

We are looking for someone who takes pride in delivering excellent quality and ensuring every client receives outstanding service.
