jobs.title: Exploration Manager
jobs.description:
Boliden is a high-tech metals company with its own mines and smelters that works long-term to guarantee society's access to base and precious metals. For a century, our work has been part of the value chains that have shaped modern society. At Boliden, we know that the metals we mine and make available will continue to play a crucial role in the future – what matters is how we produce them. Become a part of us and drive change for generations to come.

Your opportunity

Do you want to join us at Boliden and lead exploration strategy and discovery delivery across one of Europe’s most prospective mining regions?

We are looking for a Department Manager in Exploration to drive growth, prioritization, and value creation in the Central Fennoscandia region. The region is centred on the Skellefte District, one of Europe's premier volcanogenic massive sulphide (VMS) districts. It includes three operating mines, as well as several exploration ventures and projects.

Who you will work with

As Department Manager for Exploration in the Central Fennoscandia region, you are accountable for the full exploration value chain, from early-stage greenfield to near-mine initiatives across the Skellefte district.

Together with your first line managers, you lead the prioritization of exploration projects, balance long-term discovery potential with short-term business needs and allocate resources to maximize value creation and organic growth across the whole region.

What you will do

The department's goal is to extend the life of mine for all operating units within the region, provide opportunities for growing and expanding the operations, and search for new discoveries to sustain the region.

You will lead and develop the regional exploration portfolio, ensuring alignment with Boliden’s overall growth strategy and long-term resource development pipeline. You will also take part in discussions regarding project prioritization and ongoing exploration activities outside of your immediate area of responsibility.

The role includes:

    Strategic leadership - Contribute actively to overall exploration strategy, prioritization and investment decisions.
    Discovery alignment – Continuously assess and evaluate the growth potential of the region and align it with business goals and expectations.
    Resource & portfolio management - Own regional budgets, forecasts and portfolio performance, ensuring optimal allocation of capital across projects.
    Personnel – Lead three section managers with a total of around 30 employees.
    Safety, wellbeing & environmental performance – Ensure strong performance in safety, wellbeing and environmental responsibility across the department.
    Stakeholder & regulatory relations – Liaise with stakeholders and governmental authorities, while ensuring projects follow applicable laws and regulations for mining and exploration companies in each country.
    Contractor & consultant management – Negotiate with and manage cooperation with contractors and consultants.

You report to the Exploration Director and participate in Boliden’s Exploration Management Team, contributing to strategic decisions across the full exploration portfolio. The position is based at the Boliden Office or at one of Boliden Mines’ locations. Frequent travel is required, as well as regular presence at the Boliden Office.

What you bring

You have a university degree in geosciences and substantial experience in mineral exploration or mining, including a proven track record in leadership roles. You also have experience managing exploration portfolios, leading multidisciplinary teams, and working in complex stakeholder environments.

We place emphasis on your ability as a manager to motivate others and provide clear leadership in line with Boliden’s leadership principles. You are committed to developing the team, the region, and the company. You are results-oriented, with a focus on discovery and on creating both short- and long-term value. We expect you to share our values of Care, Courage, and Responsibility.

You need to be fluent in English. Swedish and/or Finnish language skills are considered a merit. A Category B driving licence is required.

Why work with us

At Boliden, we believe in promoting a workplace where care, courage, and responsibility are central to everything we do. We offer a workplace where we believe in collaboration and where what you contribute will have a direct impact on future generations. We are a company made up of responsible and creative people all working towards the same vision; to become the most sustainable and respected metal supplier in the world.

You will have a direct impact on shaping the future resource base of Boliden and have a role in delivering sustainable growth for the company.

Apply today to be part of something truly meaningful!

At Boliden, diversity and inclusion are drivers of innovation. We know that different perspectives and experiences strengthen us and help us stay at the forefront of an important and exciting industry. Therefore, we encourage applications from people with diverse backgrounds and viewpoints. Together, we build a workplace where everyone can feel safe and inspired to reach their full potential.

Want to know more about the position? Contact hiring manager Jon Keisu Lundh, +46 70 242 71 81, Jon.Lundh@boliden.com.

For questions about the application process, please contact Talent Acquisition Partner Terese Lindholm, terese.lindholm@boliden.com.

For union information please contact Mats Lindblom, SACO, +46 73 350 04 19, Andreas Mårtensson, Unionen, +46 70 541 83 93 and Peter Markström, Ledarna, +46 910 77 40 09.

Submit your application by: Sunday, 30 August 2026

We may select candidates for interviews on an ongoing basis, so don’t hesitate, send in your application. We look forward to it!

As part of Boliden’s qualitative recruitment efforts and systematic safety work, assessments and background checks may be included in the recruitment process.

If you are a representative of a recruiting company, please refrain from contacting us about this advertisement. We appreciate your consideration.

jobs.title: Charity Fundraiser, Copenhagen, 15 to 37 hours a week
jobs.description:
Job title:
Charity Fundraiser, Copenhagen. No experience required.

The job

You stand in Copenhagen and stop strangers. You have thirty seconds to make them care about something that matters, and then you ask them to put their money where their heart is.

Most walk past. Some stop. A few say yes, and those are the ones that fund real work by real organisations.

It is the oldest job there is: convince a human being, face to face, with nothing but your voice.

What you actually get out of it

Forget the job. Here is the skill.

By month three you will be able to walk up to anyone, anywhere, and start a conversation that goes somewhere. You will be able to hear no fifteen times and go straight into the sixteenth conversation without flinching. You will know how to ask for something and get it.

Almost nobody has that. The people who do run companies, close deals, get hired over better candidates, and talk their way into rooms they were not invited to.

You cannot learn it from a book. You learn it by doing it four hundred times. We pay you while you do.

The money

Good Guaranteed base +

Commission on top, no ceiling. Holiday allowance and pension on top of that.

The hours

Anywhere from 15 to 37 a week.

Where it goes

We started in February 2026. We are already growing, which means the ladder above you is short and mostly empty. We promote from inside, and people have moved up to team leader in months, not years. Get good and you will be leading people before most of your friends finish their first probation period.

Straight talk

This job is not for everyone, and we would rather tell you now.

Apply

Hit apply. One minute. No CV, no cover letter, no motivation essay.

https://fremtidensfundraising.dk/ansoeg/fundraiser/

We reply within two working days. Interviews every week. Start within two weeks.

Three positions. Questions, call August on 25 78 10 13.

Do you want to join us on the MILWAUKEE® growth journey?

TTI Nordic is a well-consolidated company, which markets and sells a wide range of power tools, hand tools, outdoor products, accessories, and PPE equipment under the leading market brands MILWAUKEE® and Ryobi®. We sell through a large network of distributors in the Nordic and Baltic countries. End customers are typically professional users and quality-conscious DIY people.

We are looking for a Key Account Manager to further strengthen Milwaukees position in the exciting market, building strong partnerships with new and existing customers across Finland, as well as our Category Sales Managers internally. We are looking for a colleague with a can-do attitude, as we strive to always come up with the best possible solutions to support both our customers and colleagues across the region. You come with experience as a Key Account Manager or Product Manager and have a clear expertise of the Finnish market situation, to easily identify the best solution for greater success with different kinds of customers, across the region.

The key factors for your success are experience in Key Account Management, determination, and the ability to build long-term and trusting customer relationships. Together, we constantly strive for even better solutions for customers and colleagues – but we also have fun. We are a growing company with a strong and clear ambition to become no. 1. We offer a competitive salary and bonus opportunity, a company car, and good career opportunities.

Do you want to go on the journey with us? Then we look forward to hearing from you!

In this role, you will be responsible for coordinating and overseeing plant modification activities within a designated work package. You will ensure that all work is carried out safely, on schedule, within scope, and in accordance with the required quality standards.

You will report functionally to the Site Coordination Lead and work closely with the Work Package Owner on a day-to-day basis. As the primary on-site contact, you will support activities related to foundations, concrete works, and installations.

Key Responsibilities

    

Coordinate and oversee daily plant modification activities within the assigned work package, ensuring safe execution, timely delivery, and compliance with project scope and quality requirements.

    

Act as the primary point of contact between the project team, contractors, and subcontractors regarding on-site plant modification activities.

    

Monitor project progress, identify deviations, recommend improvements, and escalate issues or changes when necessary.

    

Track and report project status, progress, risks, and deviations to the Project Manager and Work Package Owner.

    

Provide technical support and guidance to resolve site-related issues associated with plant modification activities.

    

Ensure that all work complies with applicable technical, safety, and quality standards.

    

Proactively identify, assess, and mitigate risks that may impact project scope, schedule, or cost.

    

Escalate issues that may affect overall project delivery to the appropriate project stakeholders.

    

Support the evaluation of change requests and project variations by assessing their impact on cost, schedule, and quality.

    

Collaborate with other Site Coordinators and cross-functional project teams to ensure efficient coordination across interfaces.

    

Assist in preparing and reviewing daily, weekly, and monthly project reports, ensuring all documentation is accurate and up to date.

Applications are reviewed on an ongoing basis, and the assignment may be filled before the application deadline.

Requirements

    

Minimum of 7 years of experience in site coordination for large-scale infrastructure projects.

    

Strong knowledge of FG Condensate Treatment processes, Heat Pumps, plant modification methods, and construction practices, including site management and applicable health and safety regulations.

    

Fluency in English and Swedish, both spoken and written.

    

Proven experience coordinating on-site activities, overseeing contractor performance, and ensuring plant modification work is completed according to the work package and schedule.

    

Ability to coordinate site activities while ensuring alignment with the overall project timeline and budget.

    

A bachelor's degree in Engineering, Construction Management, or a related discipline is preferred. However, extensive hands-on experience in site coordination and execution of major infrastructure projects is considered equally or more valuable.

    

Demonstrated commitment to maintaining high standards of health, safety, and quality across all site operations.

Preferred Qualifications

    

Experience managing risks associated with plant modification activities, including safety-related risks and schedule delays.

    

Ability to perform effectively in a fast-paced, high-pressure site environment while maintaining focus on project objectives.

Personal Skills

    

Excellent communication and interpersonal skills.

    

Strong analytical, problem-solving, and decision-making abilities to resolve on-site challenges effectively.

Additional Qualifications

    

Proactive approach to identifying and mitigating risks and resolving issues before they impact project delivery.

    

Strong ability to maintain safety, quality, and operational excellence throughout all site activities.

    

Comfortable working under pressure while ensuring successful project execution

jobs.title: Project Manager Service
jobs.description:
RaySearch develops innovative software solutions to improve cancer care. About 1000 clinics in more than 40 countries use RaySearch software to improve treatments and quality of life for patients. RaySearch was founded in 2000 and is listed on Nasdaq Stockholm. The headquarters is located in Stockholm, with subsidiaries in the US, Europe and Asia - Pacific. Today we are more than 400 employees with a common vision of improving cancer care with innovative software. Our great staff is crucial for our success and we offer a fantastic working environment in modern offices, flexibility and good opportunities for development. We believe in equal opportunities, value diversity and work actively to prevent discrimination.

Do you want to improve cancer care with innovative software? As Project Manager at RaySearch's Service Department, you will work with full product delivery and project implementation while collaborating with customers and colleagues globally. Join us in a quest to fight cancer!

About the role

As our Project Manager, you will belong to an expanding service organization and be part of our Global Service team. You will work with product deliveries across the RaySearch product suite, supporting clinics in Europe in implementing and deploying our oncology software solutions. You will lead several projects in parallel and work closely with Application Specialists, IT Specialists and other Project Managers. You will also collaborate with colleagues in Development, Finance and Sales Operations throughout your projects. When you start your position, you will get an introduction by your manager and work closely with a mentor who will help you familiarize yourself with our organization and ways of working.

You will be part of a growing Service department in a growing company that drives innovation in the MedTech industry. This is a full-time position at RaySearch’s head office located in Stockholm.

Your main tasks:

    Be the link between RaySearch and our customers during projects + lead the implementation and upgrade of projects.
    Be responsible for planning and coordination as well as follow-up on actions and deadlines.
    Act as intermediary between team members from Service, Development and Sales to coordinate the projects, and to participate in the allocation of resources in collaboration with Team Managers.
    Communicate with customers and internal stakeholders.
    Participate in activities to continuously improve internal processes and routines.

Your profile

To be successful in this position we think that you are a team player with excellent interpersonal skills who understand the importance of communication. Also, we believe that you are interested in innovative technology and curious to learn more about our products and the use and utility for our customers. You are not afraid of challenges, and you easily adapt to new situations and solve problems as they arise. Multitasking comes natural for you as you are both a strong organizer and administrator.

Requirements:

    2+ years’ experience from project delivery management within IT/MedTech.
    University degree (or equivalent) in relevant field.
    Experience in leadership and from working with structured project methodology.
    Great verbal and written communication skills in English.
    A service minded, positive attitude and ability to work independently.
    Experience from maintaining compliance and project documentation.

It is meriting if you have:

    Experience from the medtech and/or healthcare industry.
    Project management certifications.

Our Culture

Culture at RaySeach is the driving force behind our organization, where everything we do is driven by a shared passion for innovation and the fight against cancer. Our dedication is reflected in our ability to deliver exceptional results, pay close attention to detail, and consistently go the extra mile. Our employees stand out as experts in their field, driven by a relentless focus on solving problems, no matter how complex. At RaySearch, we take pride in leading the way in cancer treatment, leveraging cutting-edge technology to develop innovative solutions that make a real difference in patient care.

Our Offer

At RaySearch, we offer a diverse and inclusive work environment, fostering openness, sincerity, and collaboration. Located in Hagastaden, Stockholm's Life Science Hub, our modern and creative workspace includes an in-house gym, yoga, and social activities like ping pong, table football, and regular after-work events. Our bistro serves a fantastic lunch buffet, and we offer morning- and afternoon-fika every day. Our rooftop terrace also provides a stunning 360-degree view of Stockholm, enhancing the work experience. All of this comes attached with a competitive compensation and benefits package.

Application

Please apply to the position through the application form below. We do not accept applications by e-mail. Selection and interviews will be ongoing.

jobs.title: Student Assistant in Architecture & Technology
jobs.description:
Are you studying IT, software engineering, computer science, or a related field and looking for a student position where you can work with enterprise architecture, documentation, and modern technology? At Nordic RCC, you will join a team helping build the digital foundations that support the Nordic power system and the green transition.

If you are looking to make an impact in supporting the green transition of the energy sector across Finland, Norway, Sweden and Denmark, you might be the person we are looking for.

Join a fast-developing Nordic company and become a part of an agile environment where we develop innovative solutions. Nordic RCC is an important contributor to the green energy transition, supporting the Nordic transmission system operators in ensuring efficient and secure operations of the Nordic electricity power system.

Your role

As a student assistant in Architecture & Technology, you will be part of a dynamic team that includes architects across multiple domains. In this role, you will support the Architecture & Technology team in documenting our architecture landscape and develop guidelines and standards for architecture documentation. You will work closely with Enterprise, System and Application Architects and gain first-hand experience of how architecture is used to guide technology decisions across a growing organisation.

What you will do

  • Assist the architecture team in ensuring the quality of existing documentation

  • Create architecture models according to standards and guidelines, and support in architecture modelling and documentation activities

  • Assist in implementation governance tools

  • Contribute to governance activities, including architecture reviews and assessments

  • Research emerging technologies, trends, and industry best practices

  • Prepare presentations, reports, and decision material for management and stakeholders

We’re looking for someone with

  • Relevant Background: You are currently pursuing a bachelor’s or master’s degree in Computer Science, Software/IT Engineering, Information Technology, or a related field

  • Collaborative Attitude: You enjoy working with others and are comfortable interacting with both technical and non-technical stakeholders

  • Interest in Architecture & Technology: You are curious about how organisations design, govern, and evolve their technology landscape

  • Structured Working Style: You have an eye for detail and enjoy creating order, structure, and clarity in documentation and information

  • Analytical and Curious Mindset: You have a strong curiosity for technology, and enjoy analysing complex topics, identifying patterns, and creating structure and clarity from information

  • Proactive Approach: You take initiative, ask questions, and are not afraid to explore new topics independently while seeking guidance when needed

Through this role, you will gain practical experience with enterprise, system, and application architecture, on-premises technologies, and technology strategy. You will have the opportunity to work alongside experienced architects and technology professionals while contributing to initiatives that support Nordic RCC's mission and the green energy transition.

The role is designed to provide meaningful hands-on experience, allowing you to apply your academic knowledge in a real-world environment while developing both your technical and professional skills.

The position will require approximately 10-15 hours per week, depending on your study workload. We are flexible during exam periods and expect that you have at least 1½ - 2 years left of your studies.

If you do not tick all the boxes, but think you could be a good match, don’t hesitate to apply for this position.

What We Offer: A Flexible and Inclusive Workplace

You will join a diverse organization of 25 nationalities, where inclusivity is celebrated, with more than 30% women on board (and a commitment to improving this balance). We are located in Copenhagen Towers office in Ørestad, with the flexibility to balance on-site and remote work 2 days a week.

At Nordic RCC, we live by the values of fellowship, curiosity, respect, and transparency—values defined by our employees that shape how we collaborate and innovate. If you see yourself thriving in such an environment, we’d love to hear from you.

The position is conditioned upon a satisfactory background check as well as a national security clearance, both of which will be facilitated by Nordic RCC. You can read more on security clearance here. Please also note that the process includes any spouse, registered partner, cohabitant, steady partner, co-resident, child over 18 living at home and parent with the same address as the candidate must also consent to provide information to the same extent as the candidate for security clearance.

Application deadline and contact information

Please apply online as soon as possible (in English) and no later than 15 September. We will conduct interviews on a continuous basis. If you have any questions, please contact Camilla Schneider Bergman, Head of Architecture & Technology M: +45 29 11 16 39. (Not available until 1 September)

To ensure a fair and unbiased recruitment process, we kindly request that you do not include photographs in your CVs or application materials.

A cover letter is not required, but we kindly ask you to include a few sentences in your CV explaining why you are interested in the position. Applications are only accepted through our online recruitment system.

jobs.title: Ryhmäliikunnanohjaaja – tule Verden tuuraajatiimiin
jobs.description:
Etsimme Kuntokeskus Verdeen innostavia ja luotettavia ryhmäliikunnanohjaajia tuuraustehtäviin.

**Haluaisitko ohjata ryhmäliikuntaa joustavasti oman aikataulusi mukaan?** Verden tuuraajatiimissä voit ottaa vastaan vapaita tunteja silloin, kun ne sopivat sinulle. Tuuraustyö sopii hyvin esimerkiksi muun työn tai opiskelun rinnalle sekä liikunta-alan yrittäjälle.

**Mitä työ sisältää?**

Verdessä järjestetään ryhmäliikuntaa seitsemänä päivänä viikossa. Tuntivalikoimaamme kuuluu muun muassa lihaskuntoharjoittelua, pumppia, kuntopiiriä, zumbaa ja sisäpyöräilyä.

Kevät- ja syyskaudella järjestämme noin 20 ryhmäliikuntatuntia viikossa maanantaista sunnuntaihin. Vakituisten ohjaajiemme rinnalle etsimme uusia tuuraajia esimerkiksi sairastumisten ja muiden poissaolojen varalle.

Voit ottaa tuurauksia vastaan oman aikataulusi ja tilanteesi mukaan. Hyvin sujuneiden tuurausten kautta voi myöhemmin avautua mahdollisuus myös omiin vakituisiin tunteihin.

Kenelle työ sopii?

Toivomme sinulta liikunta-alan koulutusta ja/tai kokemusta ryhmäliikunnan ohjaamisesta. Ennen kaikkea etsimme ohjaajia, jotka nauttivat ihmisten kohtaamisesta ja osaavat luoda tunnille kannustavan ja hyvän ilmapiirin.

Asiakkaamme ovat pääasiassa noin 30–50-vuotiaita aikuisia, joista monet liikkuvat säännöllisesti. Meille on tärkeää, että jokainen voi tulla tunnille omana itsenään ja saada onnistumisen kokemuksia omasta lähtötasostaan riippumatta.

**Saatat sopia joukkoomme, jos**

- sinulla on koulutusta tai kokemusta ryhmäliikunnan ohjaamisesta

- olet energinen, kannustava ja luotettava

- viihdyt erilaisten ihmisten parissa

- haluat tehdä ohjaustyötä joustavasti muun elämäsi rinnalla.


Työ sopii hyvin myös esimerkiksi toiminimiyrittäjälle.

jobs.title: Management Support Role to Service Operations - At the Heart of the Nordic Power System
jobs.description:
Are you motivated by supporting highly skilled engineers and contributing to the secure operation of the Nordic power system? Do you thrive in an environment where operational reliability, collaboration, and continuous improvement are essential?

At the Nordic Regional Coordination Centre, in the Service Operations department, you will work closely with a team of engineers delivering critical services to the Nordic Transmission System Operators around the clock. In the role, you will act as a daily sparring partner and facilitator for the engineering team, helping ensure effective coordination between control center duties and development activities outside the operator chair.

This role offers a unique opportunity to contribute to the security of supply and the Nordic green energy transition, while supporting the development of engineers working in a highly specialized operational environment.

Nordic RCC – supporting security of supply and the green energy transition

Nordic Regional Coordination Centre (RCC) provides critical services and insights to support the national Transmission System Operators (TSOs) in Finland, Norway, Sweden and Denmark — to ensure the efficient operation and use of the Nordic power system and high security of power supply at any time.

Based in Copenhagen, Nordic RCC is one of six RCCs in Europe, equally owned by the Nordic region's four electricity TSOs: Fingrid, Statnett, Svenska Kraftnät, and Energinet.

As European power systems integrate and evolve to meet climate goals, Nordic RCC provides regional coordination, integrated services, regional insights and recommendations to the Nordic TSOs and their control centres, to support cross-border operational security 24/7.

Join Nordic RCC, a fast-developing company determined to make a significant impact in the energy sector and to provide for a secure and efficient transition to the green, sustainable energy system.

Right now, we are looking for a management support role who would like to make a difference!

Job description:

You would be supporting an engineering team that works in a hybrid setup, combining:

  • Operator-on-shift roles in the Nordic RCC coordination centre, supporting Nordic TSOs around the clock

  • Work outside the operational shift including projects, operational follow-up, and continuous improvement activities

Your primary focus will be daily coordination, professional sparring, and supporting the development of effective structures and ways of working across the team, supporting and facilitating the performance of these roles.

You will NOT be part of the Operator on-shift roster, who is performing the coordination centre tasks and services 24/7.

The position does not initially include formal personnel management, as the engineers in the setup today report directly to the Head of Department in Service Operations. You will work closely with the Head of Department on topics like department structure and set-up, and by providing day-to-day coordination and operational support, as well as mentoring and sparring on subject matter topics with the team.

Responsibilities:

  • Driving department strategy and development in collaboration with the Head of Department (HoD) supporting effective coordination between coordination centre duties and non-operational activities, both within the team and externally towards other departments

  • Facilitating knowledge sharing, supporting and securing continuous training and collaboration

  • Supporting engineers in their professional development, and acting as a sparring partner, particularly those early in their careers

  • Identifying opportunities to improve structures, processes, and operational workflows

  • Supporting planning, prioritization, and follow-up across shifts, projects, and operational tasks

  • Contributing to continuous improvement of service quality and operational efficiency as well as securing the level of contingency and business continuity

  • The role will include sharing of responsibilities as part of 3rd line support with Head of Department as the department runs 24/7 operational services

Requirements:

You bring experience from a technical or operational environment and enjoy supporting the development and collaboration of highly skilled professionals.

We expect that you:

  • Have experience working in a technical, operational, or knowledge-intensive organization

  • Demonstrate strong ability to mentor, support, and collaborate with technical specialists

  • Have experience identifying and improving structures, processes, and ways of working

  • Are comfortable working in a complex environment with the responsibility of 24/7 operational services

  • Communicate clearly and effectively across technical and organizational boundaries

Additional beneficial competencies include:

  • Experience from the power system, electrical infrastructure, or energy sector

  • Engineering or technical background

  • Experience working in control centre or operational environments

  • Familiarity with organizations delivering 24/7operational services

We encourage you to apply even if you do not meet all the listed requirements.

What we offer

You will be joining a company of competent, diverse, and enthusiastic colleagues. We are currently 25 nationalities with over 30% women (striving to improve this balance) and all ages.

Your daily workplace will be in our newly furnished office premises in Copenhagen Towers, Ørestad. We offer workplace flexibility to ensure a healthy work-life balance, including the possibility to work from home some of the time. 

Our values of fellowship, curiosity, respect, and transparency have been defined by all employees. They identify how we behave and shape the way we work together, and we expect you to see yourself in them.

The position is conditioned upon a satisfactory background check as well as a national security clearance, both of which will be facilitated by Nordic RCC. You can read more on security clearance here. Please also note, that the process includes that any spouse, registered partner, cohabitant, steady partner, co-resident, child over 18 living at home and parent with the same address as the candidate must also consent to be examined.

Application deadline and contact information

Please apply online as soon as possible (in English) and no later than September 13th  2026. We may conduct interviews on a continuous basis.

A cover letter is not required, but we kindly ask you to include a few sentences in your CV explaining why you are interested in the position. Applications are only accepted through our online recruitment system.

To ensure a fair and unbiased recruitment process, we kindly request that you do not include a photograph in your CV or any other materials.

jobs.description:
Jord- og betonarbejder søges til projekter på Sjælland

LUBI søger for en kunde dygtige og engagerede jord- og betonarbejdere til spændende projekter rundt på Sjælland. Du vil blive en del af et team, der arbejder på forskellige bygge- og anlægsopgaver i både større byområder og regionale projekter.

Der er tale om arbejde på flere lokationer, hvilket giver variation i din hverdag og mulighed for at arbejde på forskelligartede opgaver.

  • Lokation: Sjælland

  • Opstart: Hurtigst muligt

  • Arbejdstid: 37 timer pr. uge

Dine arbejdsopgaver

Du vil arbejde med klassiske opgaver inden for jord- og betonarbejde som en del af et professionelt team:

  • Udførelse af jordarbejde og klargøring af byggepladser

  • Støbning og arbejde med beton

  • Diverse forefaldende opgaver på byggeplads

  • Samarbejde med kollegaer og andre faggrupper

Krav og kompetencer

Vi søger medarbejdere, som trives med fysisk arbejde og kan indgå i et team:

  • Erfaring med jord- og/eller betonarbejde er en fordel

  • Du er mødestabil og arbejdsom

  • Du kan arbejde selvstændigt og i team

  • Du har kørekort (kategori B)

  • Du kan kommunikere på dansk, engelsk eller tysk

  • Fleksibel i forhold til arbejdssteder

Straffeattest skal kunne fremvises

Hvad kan vi tilbyde

Du bliver en del af et engageret team med gode arbejdsforhold:

  • Spændende og varierede arbejdsopgaver

  • Mulighed for arbejde på flere projekter

  • Et godt arbejdsmiljø

  • Fast fuldtidsstilling

  • Opstart hurtigst muligt

Lyder det som noget for dig?

Så send din ansøgning allerede i dag – vi indkalder løbende til samtaler og ansætter, når de rette kandidater er fundet.

Har du spørgsmål til stillingen kan du kontakte os på tlf. +45 44 40 89 94 for at høre nærmere.
Oplys JOB ID 22709 ved telefonisk henvendelse.

Vi glæder os til at høre fra dig!

jobs.title: Salgs- og rekrutteringskonsulent til JWC Staffing Agency
jobs.description:
Salgs- og rekrutteringskonsulent til JWC Staffing Agency

30 timer om ugen – med mulighed for fuldtid

Har du et skarpt salgsgen, trives med en travl hverdag og motiveres af at skabe resultater gennem stærke relationer?

Hos JWC Staffing Agency søger vi en engageret salgs- og rekrutteringskonsulent, der vil være med til at udvikle vores forretning og sikre de bedste medarbejdere til byggebranchen.

Du bliver en nøglespiller i vores fortsatte vækst, hvor du får ansvaret for både at udvikle vores kundeportefølje og sikre en professionel rekrutteringsproces fra første kontakt til medarbejderen er godt i gang hos kunden.

Dine arbejdsopgaver

Du får en alsidig hverdag, hvor salg, rekruttering og koordinering går hånd i hånd.

Dine primære opgaver bliver at:

· Opsøge og udvikle nye kunder inden for bygge- og anlægsbranchen.

· Vedligeholde og udvikle eksisterende kunderelationer.

· Planlægge og koordinere rekrutteringsforløb fra start til slut.

· Udarbejde og publicere stillingsopslag.

· Aktivt søge efter kandidater via jobportaler, sociale medier, og netværk.

· Gennemføre telefoninterviews, jobsamtaler og kandidatvurderinger.

· Koordinere ansættelser, onboarding og opfølgning.

· Arbejde målrettet med salgsbudgetter, pipeline og KPI'er.

Vi forestiller os, at du

· Har erfaring med salg – gerne inden for byggebranchen eller bemandingsbranchen.

· Trives i en hverdag med højt tempo og mange forskellige opgaver.

· Er en dygtig relationsskaber og kommunikerer naturligt med både kunder og kandidater.

· Arbejder struktureret og bevarer overblikket – også når tempoet er højt.

· Er selvstændig, initiativrig og tager ansvar for dine opgaver.

· Motiveres af at skabe resultater og nå dine mål.

· Taler - forstår og skriver dansk og kan begå dig på engelsk.

Det er en fordel, men ikke et krav, hvis du har erfaring fra byggebranchen eller selv har en håndværksmæssig baggrund.

Vi tilbyder

Hos os får du ikke bare et job – du bliver en del af en virksomhed i udvikling, hvor der er kort fra idé til handling.

Vi tilbyder blandt andet:

· En spændende og alsidig stilling med stor indflydelse på din egen hverdag.

· Mulighed for at præge virksomhedens fortsatte vækst.

· Et uformelt arbejdsmiljø med dygtige og hjælpsomme kolleger.

· Gode muligheder for både faglig og personlig udvikling.

· Attraktiv lønpakke med pension og bonusordning.

· Computer, telefon og de nødvendige arbejdsredskaber.

· Mulighed for hjemmearbejde efter aftale.

· Frihed under ansvar og fleksibilitet i hverdagen.

Hvem er vi?

JWC Staffing Agency leverer vikar- og rekrutteringsløsninger til bygge- og anlægsbranchen i hele Danmark.

Vi er en ung virksomhed med store ambitioner. Selvom JWC Staffing Agency er en relativt ny virksomhed, består vores team af medarbejdere med mange års erfaring inden for bemandings- og byggebranchen. Derfor bygger vores samarbejde på værdier som ordentlighed, troværdighed og professionalisme.

Hos os bliver du en del af et mindre team med højt humør, en uformel omgangstone og stor respekt for hinandens kompetencer. Vi tror på, at de bedste resultater skabes gennem samarbejde, og derfor arbejder vi ud fra filosofien: "Vi løfter i flok."

Hos os er kolleger ikke konkurrenter. Vi deler viden, hjælper hinanden og fejrer succeserne sammen. Den kultur afspejler sig både i vores daglige samarbejde og i vores bonusstruktur.

Vi har kontorer i Kolding og Odense, og denne stilling har primær arbejdsplads i Odense.

Ansøgning

Kan du se dig selv som en del af JWC Staffing Agency, og har du lyst til at være med på vores vækstrejse? Så send din ansøgning og dit CV hurtigst muligt til jwc@jwc-staffing.dk med emnet "Salg".

Vi afholder samtaler løbende og ansætter, så snart vi har fundet den rette kandidat.

Vi glæder os til at høre fra dig.

jobs.title: Directeur (h/f) (H/F)
jobs.description:
À propos de la mission

Véritable chef d'orchestre de l'établissement, vous prenez en charge la direction opérationnelle, administrative, financière, commerciale et humaine d'un hôtel. Vous reportez directement au Président et bénéficiez d'une large délégation de pouvoir.

Stratégie & Développement commercial :
- Élaborer et piloter la politique tarifaire (hébergement, restauration, salles)
- Développer les ventes, fidéliser la clientèle, animer les réseaux sociaux et le site internet
- Gérer les relations avec les plateformes de réservation (Booking, TO, collectivités touristiques)
- Assurer une veille marché pour adapter en permanence les offres

Gestion financière & budgétaire :

- Établir et suivre le budget annuel, contrôler les coûts, analyser le chiffre d'affaires
- Gérer la trésorerie, la comptabilité et les investissements

Management & Ressources humaines :

- Recruter, former et animer les équipes permanentes et saisonnières (réception, restauration, hébergement.)
- Définir l'organisation et les règles de fonctionnement de la structure
- Gérer les plannings et les profils de poste

Exploitation & opérationnel :

- Superviser le bon fonctionnement de l'établissement 24h/24
- Veiller au respect des normes qualité, hygiène et sécurité incendie
- Piloter le programme de maintenance et d'investissement

Rythme de travail :

- Travail en journée
- Travail en horaires fractionnés
- Travail dimanche et jours fériés
- Travail le week-end


Rémunération & Avantages

Rémunération : 50 000 EUR - 55 000 EUR par an
Avantages :
- Tous vos services dans une application
- Accès rapide à tous vos documents sur notre applicationundefined


Profil recherché

- Formation Bac +5 : Master management tourisme/hôtellerie ou Sup de Co avec spécialisation hôtellerie
- Expérience minimum de 10 ans dans l'hôtellerie-restauration ou le tourisme
- Titulaire du permis d'exploitation en restauration
- Habilitation électrique et formation aux premiers secours (défibrillateur)
- Anglais professionnel indispensable - 2ème langue étrangère appréciée
- Sensibilité à l'environnement catholique et au fonctionnement associatif

Qualités recherchées :

- Leadership, charisme et force de conviction
- Excellente présentation, sens de l'accueil et du service
- Rigueur, organisation, prise d'initiative
- Grande disponibilité (horaires décalés, travail le week-end)
- Autonomie et savoir-faire en droit, économie et gestion

- Expérience : Plus de 5 ans


Certificats requis

- Aucun certificat requis

jobs.title: PhD Candidate in Human-Centered Interactive AI Agents for Maritime Simulator Training
jobs.description:
This is NTNU

NTNU is a broad-based university with a technical-scientific profile and a focus in professional education. The university is located in three cities with headquarters in Trondheim.

At NTNU, 9,000 employees and 43,000 students work to create knowledge for a better world.

You will find more information about working at NTNU and the application process here.

   

Video: https://youtu.be/Xt-yHCN5QS0About the position

The maritime industry faces increasing demands for safe and efficient operations due to growing traffic, more complex vessels, and higher safety requirements. Simulator-based training is essential for preparing maritime professionals, but it relies heavily on experienced human instructors, whose availability is limited.

Recent advances in artificial intelligence, especially large language models (LLMs), enable the development of interactive AI agents that can support human learning in complex, safety-critical environments. Human-centered AI in this project means that the agent will learn from simulator data and expert knowledge, and will be designed to work collaboratively with trainees and instructors rather than replacing them. The AI agents will leverage LLMs for knowledge acquisition, natural language interaction, and decision support, while integrating simulator data and multimodal inputs to provide timely guidance, feedback, and post-training analysis.

This PhD project aims to develop human-centered interactive AI agents for maritime simulator training. The research will investigate how LLM-driven agents can perceive and interpret dynamic maritime environments, collaborate with human trainees during simulator sessions, provide transparent explanations for their actions, and adapt their support to individual training needs

Are you motivated to take a step towards a doctorate and open up exciting career opportunities? As a PhD Candidate with us, you will work to achieve your doctorate, and at the same time gain valuable experience that qualifies you for a further career in higher education and research, in and outside academia.

Your immediate leader will be the Head of Department.


Duties of the position
  • Complete the doctoral education until obtaining a doctorate
  • Set up research plans with the help of the supervision team and conduct them accordingly
  • Academic publications and popular science dissemination
  • Take lead in research idea generation and research paper writing
  • Collaborate closely with other PhD candidates and project partners to share knowledge, integrate findings, and coordinate research activities
  • Participate in international activities such as conferences and/or research stays at foreign educational institutions

Be prepared for changes to your work duties after employment.


Required selection criteria
  • You must have a relevant Master's degree in computer science, automation, maritime-related engineering or equivalent. Your course of study must correspond to a five-year Norwegian course, where 120 credits have been obtained at master's level. Master students can apply, but the master's degree must be obtained and documented before starting the position.
  • You must have a strong academic background from your previous studies and have an average grade from your Master's degree study, or equivalent education, which is equal to B or better compared to NTNU's grading scale. If you do not have letter grades from previous studies, you must have an equally good academic foundation. If you have a weaker grade background, you maybe considered if you can document that you are particularly suitable for a PhD education.
  • You must meet the requirements for admission to the faculty's Doctoral Programme in Engineering

PLEASE NOTE: For detailed information about what the application must contain, see paragraph “About the application”.

The appointment is to be made in accordance with NTNUs guidelines for recruitment positions and Regulations for the degrees philosophiae doctor (ph.d.) and philosophiae doctor (ph.d.) in artistic development work at the Norwegian University of Science and Technology (NTNU)for general criteria for the position.


Preferred selection criteria
  • You demonstrate a strong motivation for the position
  • You have experience of LLM and and related applications, preferably in maritime-relevant projects
  • You demonstrate knowledge/experience in AI and data-driven approaches

Personal characteristics

To complete a doctoral degree (PhD), it is important that you are able to: 

  • Work independently as well as in a cross disciplinary team
  • Work in a structured way, set goals and make plans to achieve them
  • Present and discuss your research with other professionals
  • Get involved and contribute constructively with feedback 
  • Show enthusiasm and a strong motivation for the subject
  • Analyze data, assess different perspectives and draw well-founded conclusions 
  • Be flexible and open to adjusting the plan for the project as needed
  • Communicate well in English

Emphasis will be placed on personal qualities.


We offer
  • An exciting job with an important mission in society
  • Developing tasks in a strong and international professional environment
  • Open and inclusive working environment with committed colleagues
  • Favorable terms as a member of the Norwegian Public Service Pension Fund (SPK)
  • Free Norwegian language training at a basic level (A2)

As a PhD Candidate at NTNU, you will have access to employee benefits.


Diversity

Diversity is a strength, and at NTNU we aim to be an employer that reflects the diversity in society and that makes use of the potential of the population's collective skills. Our vision is Knowledge for a better world and our values ​​are creative, critical, constructive and respectful. We believe that an organization that is equal, diverse and gender-balanced is essential for us to achieve our goals. 

We strive to attract employees with different skills, life experiences and perspectives to contribute to even better problem solving of our societal mission in research and education. 

If you think this position is relevant and interesting, we encourage you to apply, regardless of gender, functional ability and cultural background, or whether you have been out of work for a period of time.

At NTNU we want to increase the proportion of women in scientific positions. We have a number of measures to promote equality. (delete if not applicable)


Salary and conditions

In the position of PhD Candidate, code 1017, your gross salary will normally be NOK 550 800,-per annum depending on qualifications and seniority. A 2% statutory contribution to the State Pension Fund is deducted from the salary. 

The employment period is 3 years.

For employment as a PhD Candidate, it is a prerequisite that you gain admission to the PhD programme in Engineering within three months of your employment contract start date, and that you participate in an organized doctoral programme through out the period of employment.

As an employee at NTNU, it is important that you keep yourself up to date with academic and organizational changes and adapt to them.

For the necessary professional and social interaction, it is a prerequisite that you are physically present and available to the institution on a daily basis.

The appointment is carried out in accordance with the principles of the State Employees Act, and Export control (legislation that regulates the export of knowledge, technology and services). Candidates who, after assessment of the application and attachments, are considered to bein conflict with the criteria in the latter act, will not be able to be employed.


About the application

The attachments (including a description of your scientific work) must accompany the application as these documents form the basis of the application assessment. The documents must be in English.

Please note: the application will only be assessed on the basis of the information we have received by the application deadline. Therefore, make sure that your application clearly shows how your skills and experience meet the criteria described above. The application and all attachments must be sent electronically via Jobbnorge.no. If you are invited to an interview, you must bring certified copies of certificates and diplomas upon request.

The application must include:

  • Transcripts and diplomas for Bachelor's and Master's degrees
  • CV 
  • Copy of Master's thesis. If you have recently submitted your Master's thesis, you can attach a draft of the thesis. Documentation of a completed Master's degree must be presented before taking up the position.
  • Project outline containing proposals for an overall description of research questions, theoretical perspectives, methodological design for the project and progress plan (maximum 1500 words/4 pages) 
  • Possibly publications etc. other relevant research work
  • Possibly certificates
  • Names and contact information of three relevant referees


If all, or parts, of your education has been taken abroad, we also ask you to attach documentation of the scope and quality of your entire education, both Bachelor's and Master's education, in addition to other higher education. If your institution uses “diploma supplement” (normal for most European institutions), you must attach this. A description of the documentation required can also be found here. If you already have a statement from Norwegian Directorate for Higher Education and Skills (HK-dir), please attach this as well.


Joint work will be considered. If it is difficult to identify your contribution to joint work, you must attach a brief description of your participation.

When assessing the best qualified, we emphasize necessary qualifications such as education, experience and personal suitability. Motivation for the position, ambitions, and potential for research will also count when assessing the candidates.

NTNU recognizes a wide range of academic contributions and has committed itself to The San Francisco Declaration on Research Assessment and CoARA (responsible assessment of research and recognition of a greater breadth of academic contributions in accordance with NTNU's social mission).


General information

A public list of applicants with name, age, job title and municipality of residence is prepared after the application deadline. If you wish to be exempt from entry on the public applicant list, this must be justified. Assessment will be made in accordance with current legislation. You will be notified if the exemption is not granted.

If you think this position looks interesting and in line with your qualifications, you are welcome to apply.

If you have any questions about the position, please contact Professor Houxiang Zhang, email: hozh@ntnu.no

If you have any questions about the recruitment process, please contact PhD Coordinator Lara Bromann, e-mail: lara.bromann@ntnu.no

Application deadline: 20.09.2026

-----------------

For practical information about working at NTNU, please visit this webpage. 
 

Ålesund, known for its unique Art Nouveau architecture and spectacular nature, is a gem on Norway's west coast. The city offers a vibrant cultural life, modern facilities, and a dynamic business environment. With its strategic location by the sea, Ålesund provides a perfect balance between urban living and natural experiences. Here, you will find excellent schools, top-notch healthcare services, and a wide range of recreational activities. Ålesund is an ideal place for both career and family life, with a safe and inclusive community.


Om arbeidsgiveren:

NTNU - knowledge for a better world

The Norwegian University of Science and Technology (NTNU) creates knowledge for a better world and solutions that can change everyday life.


Department of Ocean Operations and Civil Engineering

We aim to be a hub of international knowledge and innovation in maritime operations. This involves education and research on the design of ships and marine equipment as well as on the operation of vessels. Maritime operations integrate technology, human factors and business. The interfaces between these areas often spark inspiration for innovation and new solutions. The Department of Ocean Operations and Civil Engineering is one of eight departments in the Faculty of Engineering.

jobs.title: 2 Närvårdare inom äldreomsorgen
jobs.description:
Vi söker nu två engagerade närvårdare till Saltviks kommuns äldreomsorg, med aktuell placering på våra demensenheter Viken och Udden på Sunnanberg vårdhem. Här får du arbeta nära människor med demenssjukdom i en trygg, hemlik miljö där personcentrerad vård, delaktighet och livskvalitet står i fokus.

Sunnanberg vårdhem ligger i Kvarnbo och erbjuder långvarigt serviceboende med heldygnsomsorg. Verksamheten består av tre enheter med totalt 32 platser. Viken och Udden är särskilt inriktade på vård och omsorg för personer med demenssjukdom, medan Fyren erbjuder vård för personer med andra omfattande omsorgsbehov.

Hos oss är ingen dag den andra lik. Du blir en viktig del av ett engagerat team som tillsammans skapar trygghet, glädje och meningsfulla dagar för våra boende. Vi tror på att se människan bakom sjukdomen och att ta tillvara varje individs resurser, vanor och önskemål.

Dina arbetsuppgifter

Som närvårdare ansvarar du tillsammans med dina kollegor för att ge en trygg, professionell och personcentrerad vård. Arbetet omfattar bland annat att:

- planera och utföra individuellt anpassade vård- och omsorgsinsatser

- skapa trygghet, struktur och meningsfulla aktiviteter i vardagen

- stärka och bevara den boendes egna resurser och självständighet

- samarbeta med kollegor, anhöriga och andra yrkesgrupper

- utföra medicinska arbetsuppgifter enligt delegering.


Vi söker dig som

- är utbildad närvårdare och registrerad i Valvira

- gärna har erfarenhet av eller intresse för demensvård

- är trygg, lyhörd och har ett respektfullt bemötande

- uppskattar samarbete och bidrar till ett gott arbetsklimat

- kan arbeta självständigt och ta ansvar

- har goda kunskaper i svenska, både muntligt och skriftligt, samt grundläggande datavana.


Därför ska du välja Saltviks kommun:

Vi vill att våra medarbetare ska trivas och utvecklas. Hos oss får du:

- ett varierande och meningsfullt arbete

- engagerade kollegor och ett nära samarbete i arbetsgruppen

- möjlighet att utvecklas inom demensvård

- utökad företagshälsovård

- friskvårdsförmån med massage, kultur och motion till ett värde av 400 euro per år

- lön och övriga anställningsvillkor enligt AKTA.


Anställningsvillkor

Arbetet är periodarbete. Anställningen inleds med sex månaders prövotid. Tillträde enligt överenskommelse.

Vill du veta mer?

Kontakta gärna:

- Omvårdnadsledare Pia Nordberg, tel. 431 622, pia.nordberg@saltvik.ax

- Omvårdnadsledare Malin Häggblom, tel. 431 641, malin.haggblom@saltvik.ax

jobs.title: Technical Support
jobs.description:
Landis+Gyr EMEA, formerly part of the Landis+Gyr Group, supports electricity, gas, water and thermal utilities in managing increasingly complex networks, improving operational efficiency and enabling more sustainable use of resources.

With more than 2.800 employees in 19 countries and decades of experience in critical infrastructure technology, the company provides advanced metering, network intelligence and digital solutions to utilities and infrastructure operators primarily across Europe, Middle East and Africa. As a stand alone organisation, Landis+Gyr EMEA builds on long-standing customer relationships and proven technology capabilities, backed by experienced regional teams.

Onko sinulla intohimo tarjota ensiluokkaista asiakastukea ja olet teknisesti suuntautunut? Pidätkö ongelmanratkaisusta kansainvälisessä työyhteisössä?

Etsimme järjestelmäasiantuntijaa 1. tason teknisen tuen tiimiimme. Tässä roolissa toimit suoraan yritysasiakkaidemme kanssa, auttaen heitä teknisessä tuessa Landis+Gyr EMEA:n ratkaisuihin liittyen. Teet tiivistä yhteistyötä organisaatiomme eri tiimien kanssa varmistaaksesi asiakastyytyväisyyden.

Tehtäväsi:

- Toimit ensisijaisena yhteyshenkilönä teknisessä tukitiimissämme yritysasiakkaille

- Ratkaiset teknisiä ongelmia liittyen Landis+Gyr EMEA:n ratkaisuihin

- Laadit ja keräät teknistä dokumentaatiota

- Teet yhteistyötä sisäisten tiimien kanssa tukipyyntöjen käsittelyssä


Odotamme sinulta:

- Teknistä ymmärrystä

- Asiakaspalveluhenkisyyttä

- Vahvoja ongelmanratkaisutaitoja

- Sujuvaa suomen ja englannin kielen taitoa (muut kielet ovat etu)

- Mahdollisuutta matkustaa kotimaassa ja kansainvälisesti tarvittaessa


Mitä tarjoamme sinulle:

- Merkityksellisen uran kansainvälisessä, kestävään kehitykseen panostavassa yrityksessä

- Osaavat ja laadusta tinkimättömät kollegat

- Monipuoliset työtehtävät ja tuen ammatilliselle kehitykselle

- Joustavan ja hybridimalliin perustuvan työskentelytavan

- Tukea hyvinvointiin, mukaan lukien Epassi Flex ja lounasetu, sekä ennaltaehkäisevän hammashoidon tuen


Jos haluat olla mukana rakentamassa vihreämpää tulevaisuutta ja vaikuttaa siellä, missä sillä on merkitystä, kuulisimme sinusta mielellämme!

Työpisteesi sijaitsee ensisijaisesti Jyväskylässä - töitä teemme joustavasti hybridimallilla.

Seuraa meitä LinkedIn:ssä.

jobs.title: Responsable des opérations Adjoint (h/f) (H/F)
jobs.description:
LHH Recruitment Solutions, cabinet de conseil en recrutement et évaluation d'experts, cadres et dirigeants, recrute pour son client, acteur majeur de la logistique et du transport, un Responsable Adjoint des Opérations Transport Multimodal H/F, pour une mission intérim de 6 mois minimum, basée à Blagnac (31).

Au sein d'un environnement Supply Chain Optimization (4PL), vous intervenez sur un périmètre stratégique visant à piloter et optimiser les opérations de transport multimodal, avec une dominante route.

Ainsi, vos missions principales seront :
- Superviser les opérations de transport multimodal, avec un focus sur le transport routier domestique et international
- Planifier, piloter et suivre l'ensemble des flux logistiques dans un environnement 4PL / Lead Logistics Provider
- Garantir le respect des SLA, KPI et engagements clients
- Gérer les incidents transport et mettre en place des plans d'actions correctifs
- Optimiser les coûts et la performance globale des opérations
- Piloter les relations avec les transporteurs et partenaires logistiques
- Négocier les conditions opérationnelles et contractuelles et suivre la performance fournisseurs
- Manager, accompagner et développer une équipe opérationnelle
- Organiser la planification et la répartition des activités
- Déployer une culture de performance et d'amélioration continue
- Piloter l'optimisation des processus transport et contribuer à la digitalisation (TMS, reporting, dashboards)
- Être l'interlocuteur privilégié des clients stratégiques et proposer des solutions d'optimisation logistique

Issu(e) d'une formation supérieure en logistique, transport ou supply chain, vous justifiez d'une expérience significative de 5 ans minimum en transport et logistique, avec une expertise en transport routier national et international, sur des fonctions managériales.

Une expérience en environnement 4PL ou en pilotage de transporteurs multiples est fortement appréciée.
Vous maîtrisez les outils TMS ainsi que le pack Microsoft Office (Excel avancé, PowerPoint) et avez une bonne connaissance des KPI et du pilotage de la performance opérationnelle.
La connaissance des réglementations transport international et export control est un plus.
Un niveau bilingue français et anglais est indispensable. Une troisième langue serait appréciée.

Ce poste est une mission d'intérim à pourvoir à partir du mois de novembre, pour 6 mois, à Blagnac (31), statut Cadre.
Rémunération selon profil.

jobs.title: Front of House Manager – Diamond Slice
jobs.description:
Front of House Manager – Diamond Slice

Location: Copenhagen, Denmark (Nørrebro)

Position: Full-Time (37 hours / week)

Salary: 28,000 – 35,000 DKK / month (based on experience)

Start Date: As soon as we find the right candidate

About Diamond Slice

At Diamond Slice, we bring proper New York slice shop culture to Copenhagen. We elevate the humble slice with high-hydration sourdough, top-tier seasonal local ingredients, natural wines, craft beers, and cocktails—all served in a fast-paced, high-energy, welcoming neighborhood environment.  We pride ourselves on exceptional quality, great hospitality, and an unpretentious vibe.

We are growing and looking for a driven Front of House Manager to lead our floor operations, nurture our team culture, and deliver outstanding guest experiences.

The Role & Key Responsibilities

As FOH Manager, you will take ownership of the day-to-day guest experience, lead shift execution, and serve as a key operational anchor for both our daily service and special events.

  • FOH Leadership & Experience: Take ownership of the Front of House, ensuring smooth service flow, excellent atmosphere, and high operational standards.

  • Team Coaching & Motivation: Train, mentor, and inspire the FOH team to build a high-performing, friendly, and efficient service squad.

  • Guest Communication: Serve as the primary face and voice for guest interactions, handling feedback, special requests, and inquiries with warmth and professionalism.

  • Festivals & Events Logistics: Play a central, hands-on role in planning and executing logistics for outdoor festivals, pop-ups, and special catering events.

Candidate Profile

We are looking for an experienced hospitality leader who takes initiative, and thrives with autonomy.

Requirements & Qualifications

  • Experience: Minimum 5 years of experience in hospitality (with proven leadership or supervisory experience preferred).

  • Autonomy & Problem Solving: Self-motivated, proactive, and comfortable taking ownership to solve operational challenges independently.

  • Assertive Communication: Unafraid to speak up, bring issues to the table, and constructively challenge the status quo to make operations better.

  • Feedback Culture: Skilled and comfortable with both giving and receiving direct, constructive feedback with colleagues and leadership.

  • Guest-Centric Mindset: Genuinely loves host culture, high-energy environments, and personal interactions with guests.

  • Schedule Availability: Fully comfortable working evenings, weekends, and peak service hours.

What We Offer

  • Competitive Compensation: 28,000 – 35,000 DKK / month, aligned with your experience.

  • Flexible Schedule: High degree of scheduling flexibility, provided operations run smoothly and team coverage is secure.

  • Autonomous Role: Real freedom to shape FOH operations and make your mark on our growing brand.

  • Great Culture: A fast-paced, supportive, and passionate workplace with high standards and great pizza.

How to Apply

Ready to join the Diamond Slice team?

Please submit your CV along with a short introduction telling us about yourself and why you'd be a great fit for Diamond Slice to: work@diamondslice.dk

Note! Applications must include: "Diamond Slice FOH Manager" in the subject line to be considered.

Applications are reviewed on an ongoing basis, and we will hire as soon as we find the right candidate.

jobs.title: Vi søger betonchauffør til Unicon Avedøre og Prøvestenen
jobs.description:
Der er chauffører - og der er Unicon chauffører 

Som betonchauffør er du andet og mere end bare en “ratholder”. Du er chaufførernes svar på Tom Kristensen og en ørn til at navigere under selv de trangeste forhold. Derudover kan du håndtere betonen, når den skal off-loades via båndet eller til en pumpechauffør, og du ved, hvordan man får en god dialog med de ansvarlige på pladsen, der modtager betonen.  

Der er dig, der sørger for, at betonen bliver leveret rigtigt og til tiden – og derfor også dig, der er respekt om, når folk får øje på den blå- og hvidstribede Unicon-bil. At være en del af holdet hos Unicon er noget ganske særligt, og det kræver, at du også er det.  

Vi arbejder tæt sammen i teams på de enkelte fabrikker og er der for hinanden, når der er brug for det. Og så har vi branchens bedste betingelser; med karrieremuligheder, fleksibilitet, betalt arbejdstøjsordning med vask, tryghed og gode forhold.  

Der er flere gode grunde til at blive chauffør hos Unicon:  

  • Vi har branchens bedste ansættelsesforhold 

  • Fleksibilitet for dig i forhold til vagter og arbejdssted 

  • Betalt arbejdstøjsordning, hvor vi også vasker tøjet for dig  

  • Gode udviklingsmuligheder både fagligt og personligt og spændende karrieremuligheder 

  • En helt unik holdånd  

  • En grundig introduktion og oplæring i jobbet  

  • Gode arbejdsforhold. Unicon er medlem af Dansk Industri, som har overenskomst med 3F 

For at komme med på holdet kræver det, at... 

  • Du har stort kørekort inkl. hænger/trailer og EU-bevis

  • Du har fokus på din og andres sikkerhed  

  • Du er præsentabel og serviceminded, da du er vores ansigt udadtil 

  • Du har fysik til at rengøre og vedligeholde din betonbil 

  • Du kan holde orden omkring dig 

  • Det er en fordel, hvis du har krancertifikat samt erfaring fra bygge-/entreprenørbranchen

Med udgangspunkt fra vores fabrik i Avedøre eller Prøvestenen vil du indgå i et fleksibelt team med gode kollegaer om afvikling af den daglige betonproduktion samt forefaldende arbejde på fabrikken. 

Du vil referere til fabrikkens daglige leder.   

Sådan bliver du en del af holdet  

Hvis du vil med på holdet, så send os din ansøgning og CV hurtigst muligt. Såfremt du har spørgsmål til stillingen, kan du kontakte fabriksleder Michael Rud Larsen på telefon 40181421. Vi indkalder løbende til samtaler og ansætter, når vi har den rette kandidat.  

Om Unicon 

Unicon Danmark tilbyder lige muligheder for alle og har aktivt fokus på at fremme et arbejdsmiljø, der er fri for diskrimination, og hvor medarbejdere behandles med værdighed og respekt. I vores virksomhed er ansættelse baseret på den enkeltes fortjenester og kvalifikationer, som er direkte relateret til kompetencekrav i jobbet. Vi diskriminerer ikke nogen medarbejder eller jobansøger baseret på race, etnicitet, nationalitet, herkomst, genetiske oplysninger, statsborgerskab, religion, alder, køn, kønsidentitet/udtryk, seksuel orientering, graviditet, civilstand, handicap eller andre beskyttede karakteristika efter gældende love eller regler. Vi overholder disse principper i alle aspekter af ansættelse, herunder rekruttering, ansættelse, uddannelse, kompensation, forfremmelse og fordele.

jobs.title: Lärare inom småbarnspedagogik till Folkhälsans daghem i Hyvinge
jobs.description:
På Folkhälsan jobbar vi tillsammans för en god vardag för små och stora. Vi är en hälsofrämjande organisation och en familjevänlig arbetsplats, som arbetsgivare är vi flexibla och pålitliga. Vi jobbar aktivt för jämlikhet, värdesätter mångfald på vår arbetsplats och uppmuntrar personer med olika bakgrund och som tillhör olika minoriteter att söka jobb hos oss. Kom och jobba med oss!

Folkhälsan Välfärd Ab rekryterar en lärare inom småbarnspedagogik

till daghemmet i Hyvinge för en tillsvidareanställning. Arbetet är på heltid och inleds enligt överenskommelse under hösten 2026.

Hyvinge daghem är beläget centralt i Hyvinge med parker och natur på gångavstånd. Vi finns i samma byggnad som Svenska skolan i Hyvinge och har ett aktivt samarbete samt möjlighet att använda både gymnastiksal och slöjdsal i vår verksamhet. Tillsammans med Svenska skolan i Hyvinge bildar vi en helhet där barnens lärstig fortsätter naturligt från småbarnspedagogiken till grundläggande utbildningen. Välkommen att jobba för en svenskspråkig helhet på en språkö!

Vi erbjuder småbarnspedagogik och förskoleundervisning samt språkbadsinriktad verksamhet. Du tar dig smidigt till daghemmet med tåg eller buss.

Som lärare inom småbarnspedagogik ansvarar du för och planerar den pedagogiska verksamheten. Arbetet sker i en miljö med kunniga pedagoger samt andra sakkunniga. Du är teamledare för ditt arbetsteam. På daghemmet arbetar vi i enlighet med Grunderna för planen för småbarnspedagogik samt Folkhälsans handbok. Vi erbjuder dig en arbetsplats där du har möjlighet att påverka och utveckla ditt arbete. Förmågor så som kreativitet, samarbetsvilja, flexibilitet, kommunikation och hälsofrämjande arbetssätt värderas hos oss.

Behörighetsvillkor är behörighet enligt lagen om småbarnspedagogik (540/2018) eller enligt rådande övergångsbestämmelse (75 §): pedagogie kandidat (lärare inom småbarnspedagogik), lämplig yrkeshögskoleexamen eller tidigare motsvarande examen på institutnivå, t.ex. barnträdgårdslärare eller socialpedagog.

Vi erbjuder dig en inkluderande arbetsgemenskap där alla stöder varandra. Du får tillgång till olika personalförmåner (bl.a. företagshälsovård via Mehiläinen och ePassi-förmån) för att du skall må bra i ditt arbete, samt utbildningsdagar och sektorsspecifika utbildningar i Eduhouse för att få goda förutsättningar för att utvecklas professionellt. Lön enligt kollektivavtalet för den privata småbarnspedagogiken med möjlighet till personliga tillägg.
Den som väljs till arbetet bör uppvisa utdrag ur straffregistret enligt 6 § 2 mom. i straffregisterlagen samt tuberkulosutredning enligt 55 § i lagen om smittsamma sjukdomar. Folkhälsan är en rökfri arbetsplats.

Läs mer om oss här: [Hyvinge daghem - Folkhälsan](https://www.folkhalsan.fi/service/daghem/hyvinge-daghem) och följ oss gärna på Instagram för att se mer av vår verksamhet: [@hyvingedagis](https://www.instagram.com/hyvingedagis/)

För närmare information om jobbet kan du kontakta enhetschef Anna Holmgren per e-post, anna.holmgren@folkhalsan.fi , eller per telefon, +358 44 788 3670.

Vi önskar få din ansökan senast den 7.9.2026 kl. 14:00. Använd gärna det elektroniska ansökningsformuläret när du skickar in din ansökan. Vi intervjuar under ansökningstiden och platsen fylls genast då lämplig person hittas.

Vi ser fram emot att få höra mer om dig!

jobs.title: Taxi Driver Espoo
jobs.description:
Taxi driving experience is an advantage but not required. The task suits both experienced drivers and those who want to learn the profession.

LETS RIDE
* Get behind the wheel with Taksi Helsinki Finlands most popular operator. Bolt and Uber options are also available.
* You drive a Tesla Model Y.
* Day and night shifts are available. Shifts can be planned a month in advance, we only confirm vehicle availability.
* We operate on a commission model. The drivers fee is 45% of rides (VAT 0%).

BASICS WILL DO
* To drive a taxi, you need a driving licence (B) issued in Finland or another EU/EEA country at least one year ago.
* We expect Finnish at a sufficient conversational level; perfect grammar is not required. English or other languages are a plus.
* Reliability and a service-minded attitude are important.

360° SUPPORT
* Youve got or youre ready to get a taxi drivers licence (taksinkuljettajan ajolupa) soon. If needed, the prep materials are right there on the table.
* Moving from another location? Well help you with housing search and support you through the process.
* Support with practical matters and paperwork at the start.

Different people. New places. Freedom to choose. If this sounds like you lets ride!

jobs.title: Kiertävä liikunnanohjaaja
jobs.description:
Loviisan kaupungin koulutuspalvelut hakee määräaikaiseen työsuhteeseen ajalle 1.9.2026-4.6.2027 tai heti kun sopiva hakija löytyy, kiertävää liikunnanohjaajaa. Liikunnanohjaaja on liikunta-alan ammattilainen, joka työskentelee kaikissa Loviisan peruskouluissa (luokat 1-6 sekä esikoulut) erilaisissa ohjaustehtävissä Liikkuva koulu -hankkeessa. Liikunnallisuudesta, positiivisesta asenteesta ja hyvistä vuorovaikutustaidoista on hyötyä. Edellisellä hakukierroksella saapuneet hakemukset huomioidaan.

Hankekaudella edistetään opetussuunnitelman mukaista liikunnallista elämäntapaa yhteistyössä koulujen henkilöstön kanssa. Toimenpiteet vahvistavat koulujen arkea liikuntamyönteisemmäksi, jotta aktiivisuus koulupäivän aikana lisääntyy välitunneilla, oppitunneilla ja koulukerhoissa.

Odotamme hakijalta vuorovaikutus- ja yhteistyötaitoja sekä valmiuksia sopeutua nopeasti muuttuviin tilanteisiin. Arvostamme monialaista osaamista, oma-aloitteisuutta, joustavuutta sekä aktiivista, kehittämismyönteistä ja itsenäistä työotetta. Sujuva suomen ja ruotsin kielen taito on tehtävän hoitamisen edellytys kaksikielisessä ympäristössä.

Tarjoamme monipuolisen työn, osaavan, kokeneen ja ammattitaitoisen työyhteisön, nykyaikaiset työvälineet, kuntosali- sekä Epassi-henkilöstöetuuden.
Palkkaus ja palvelussuhteen ehdot määräytyy KVTES mukaan ja viikoittainen työaika on 38 h 15 min.

Kelpoisuusehtona on alalle soveltuva koulutus ja kokemus lasten ja nuorten kanssa tehtävästä työstä. Tehtävästä suoriutuminen vaatii itsenäistä työotetta, kokemusta ryhmänohjauksesta sekä hyviä yhteistyötaitoja.

B-ajokortti sekä oman auton käyttö on välttämätön työn kannalta.

Työn kesto 1.9.2026-4.6.2027, 100 % työajalla.

Valitun henkilön on ennen tehtävän vastaanottamista esitettävä lasten kanssa työskentelevien rikostaustan selvittämisestä annetun lain (504/2002) mukainen rikosrekisteriote sekä toimitettava hyväksyttävä lääkärintodistus terveydentilastaan 30 päivän kuluessa työsuhteen alkamisesta.

Tehtävään ja hakuprosessiin liittyvissä kysymyksissä voit olla yhteydessä: liikuntakoordinaattori Karolina Hoviin puh. 050 382 7554 tai koulutuspäälikkö Auli Saariseen puh. 0440 555 332.

Our client, Zinc Processors Limited t/a Shannonside Galvanising, based in Drombanna, Co. Limerick, is currently seeking Industrial Painters for immediate start at their two facilities in Co. Limerick. Key Duties and Responsibilities - To paint interior & exterior of buildings, other structures and structural metal products - To prepare and apply industrial-grade coatings to metal products and structures, ensuring long-lasting corrosion protection before and after galvanising process - To prepare surfaces for painting by cleaning, sanding, blasting, and priming as needed - To use both standard latex-based paints and specialised paints for decorative and protective effect - To apply industrial coatings (e.g., epoxy, zinc-rich primers, polyurethane) using airless or conventional spray equipment - To ensure even coverage and correct thickness of coatings in accordance with customer and industry specifications - To use brushes, paint rollers and paint sprayers for different applications - To operate and maintain painting equipment and spray booths Key Requirements – Skills & Experience - Minimum 2 years' experience in industrial painting or similar role, ideally within a galvanizing or steel fabrication environment. - A formal qualification is not required, but relevant certifications are always a plus - Knowledge of industrial paint types, surface preparation techniques, and application methods. - Ability to read and interpret job specifications and technical drawings. - Strong attention to detail and commitment to quality. - Understanding of health, safety, and environmental regulations. - Essential knowledge includes paint types - Essential skills include cleaning painting equipment, disposing of hazardous & non-hazardous waste, and following health & safety procedures in construction and at heights - Further essential skills include inspection of paintwork, interpretation of 2D & 3D plans, and preparation of surfaces for painting - Candidates must be competent to protect surfaces during construction work, remove paint, and sand between coats - Candidates must have experience in snapping chalk line, using measurement instruments, and working safely with chemicals - Experience painting structures & metal products is a plus Annual remuneration: €36,605.00; Pay rate €18.05 per hour Work Locations – Zinc Processors Limited t/a Shannonside Galvanising at: -
