jobs.title: Junior Embedded Software / Payload Engineer
jobs.description:
Want to work within sustainability and drones? Looking to be part of an innovative, fast-growing Danish greentech company with global reach? Then Explicit might be the place for you. 

Our tech team is looking for a new colleague to help build and improve the electronics that turn our drones into precision measuring instruments. If you enjoy hands-on hardware work in a greentech environment and want real ownership over what you build, we want to hear from you. 

About the job 

You will be part of a small, talented tech team, responsible for designing, building and maintaining our fleet of custom UAV deployed across the world to help map critical emissions. 

Responsibilities: 

  • Developing payload firmware that communicates with our drone systems (MAVLink / DJI) and onboard gas instrumentation and other sensors. 

  • Helping to bring new sensor instruments from datasheet to bench to flight. 

  • Improving and fixing existing payloads, diagnose issues on the bench and through in-flight data, harden the firmware, and ship the fix. 

  • Building small interface and breakout PCBs in KiCad, from assembly and bringing it up through to your own revisions. 

  • Potential for CAD and other mechanical work, depending on your qualifications. 

About you 

  • A bachelor's degree or similar/higher in electronics, robotics, computer engineering, mechatronics, physics or similar. 

  • 1+ years of hands-on experience, from your studies, a project, or a job. 

  • Tinker with Arduino/Raspberry Pi type projects. 

  • Wired up and used Serial/UART, I²C, SPI, etc., not just read about them. 

  • Basic C/C++ (or Arduino) and a bit of Python. 

  • English at a professional level. 

Nice to have 

  • Curiosity about drones, sensors and physical measurements. 

  • PCB design/KiCad experience, with signal/noise integrity knowledge. 

  • CAD and/or mechanical knowledge. 

  • Python for log analysis and quick tooling. 

  • Danish is an advantage, but not a requirement. 

What we offer 

  • A permanent, full-time position in a fast-growing greentech company with real-world impact. 

  • Competitive benefits including paid pension, health insurance, parental leave and 6 weeks' holiday allowance. 

  • Real hardware ownership early on, with a senior engineer to learn from. 

  • A flat hierarchy where ideas are heard, initiative is encouraged, and responsibility comes early. 

  • A close-knit, supportive team that values collaboration, trust and learning. 

  • Work that measurably cuts industrial emissions. 

About Explicit 

Explicit ApS is a pioneering Danish engineering company specialising in drone-based emissions monitoring across the energy, maritime, waste management, and other industry sectors. We deliver reliable, transparent and actionable emissions data to some of the largest energy companies all over the world using our patented drone-based methodology. Every measurement depends on the payload the drone carries: the boards, firmware, and sensors. 

We are headquartered in Virum, Denmark, with offices in Norway, Germany and Australia. Our international team of around 30 colleagues brings together engineering, data and environmental expertise, united by a shared mission to make a difference in emissions monitoring. 

Practical information 

  • Application deadline: 21 August 2026 

  • Expected start date: 1 October 2026 or 1 November 2026 

  • Location: Virum, Denmark 

How to apply 

Please send your application, including a few lines about what you’ve built and your CV, to jobs@explicit.dk. 

If you have any questions about the role, you are welcome to contact Rune Brogaard, Technical Manager, at ryb@explicit.dk

jobs.title: Keittiön palveluvastaava, ABC Pitkälahti
jobs.description:
Primary location:
KUOPIO

ABC PITKÄLAHTI etsii nyt KEITTIÖN PALVELUVASTAAVAA vakituiseen kokoaikaiseen työsuhteeseen - ihan tavallisiin töihin, harvinaisen toimeliaaseen porukkaan

Sopimustunnit: keskimäärin 112,5 t / 3 viikkoa
Työ alkaa: sopimuksen mukaan

Työtä kuvataan usein korulauseilla, mutta meidän mielestämme tavallisuudessa ei ole mitään pahaa. Me Osuuskauppa PeeÄssällä sanomme olevamme ihan tavallisissa töissä - eikä se tarkoita tylsää porukkaa, päinvastoin. Työ on hyvää ja sujuvaa arkea, jossa teemme muiden arjesta, ja välillä juhlastakin, vähän parempaa. Ja joskus juhlitaan itsekin. Jos työpaikkailmoitusten kliseet kyllästyttävät, tule meille ihan tavallisiin töihin.

ABC Pitkälahdessa halutaan tarjota liikkuville asiakkaille nopea ja helppo tauko savolaiseen, rennon lupsakkaan tyyliin. Palveluvastaavana olet mukana luomassa hyvää fiilistä ympärillesi ja varmistamassa, että asiakkaamme saavat sujuvaa ja lämminhenkistä palvelua, josta voimme olla yhdessä ylpeitä. Lisäksi huolehdit sujuvasta vuoron johtamisesta ja varmistat, että pääsemme porukalla yhteisiin tavoitteisiimme. Odotamme sinulta positiivisuutta, reipasta otetta työhösi ja halua tarjota asiakkaillemme unohtumattomia asiakaskokemuksia.

Pitkälahden liikennemyymäläpäällikön Miran sanoin: Meillä pääset joukkoon mukavaan ja rentoon, ja työhön, jossa todellakin jokainen päivä on erilainen. Itse puhun usein Apsin sykkeestä, joka itselleni antaa energiaa valtavasti jokaiseen päivääni. Työ on mielenkiintoista ja erilaisia työtehtäviä meidän asemallemme on paljon. Pääset kehittymään itse sekä kehittämään yksikkömme toimintaa ihanien työkavereiden kanssa.

Tämä työ sopii sinulle, jos olet ravintola-alan ammattilainen, jolla on kokemusta kannustavasta ja innostavasta lähijohtamisesta. Pidät langat käsissä myös silloin, kun ravintolassa riittää asiakkaita ja tekemistä. Johdat tiimiäsi omalla esimerkilläsi ja pidät huolta, että peukutettava asiakaspalvelu on arjessa keskiössä.

Tässä tehtävässä onnistut, kun:
- Hyödynnät työssä hyviä vuorovaikutus- ja valmennustaitojasi.
- Työskentelet sujuvasti suomen ja englannin kielellä.
- Sinulta löytyy vahvaa keittiöpuolen työkokemusta ja osaamista.
- Vuorotyö sopii sinulle.
- Haluat kehittää arjen tekemistä yhdessä tiimin kanssa.

Mitä se ihan tavallinen työ meillä on
- Henkilökuntaetuja: alennuksia ruoasta, juomasta, elektroniikasta, ravintoloista, hotelleista, pankkipalveluista ja monesta muusta mukavasta asiasta.
- Epassin etuja: jopa 250 € arvosta vuodessa.
- Tulospalkkaus: mahdollisuus ansaita ylimääräistä jopa kahden kuukauden palkan verran vuodessa.
- Rahaa: MaRaVa esihenkilöiden työehtosopimuksen palkkaryhmän 1 mukainen palkka, 2280 €/kk - 2476 €/kk kokemusvuosista riippuen. Lisät tuovat kivasti lisää ansioita. Ne maksetaan myös TES:n mukaisesti.
- Työpaikka, johon on kiva tulla ja olla. Esihenkilötiimissämme ei tarvitse pärjätä yksin - innostamme ja tuemme toinen toisiamme.
- Mahdollisuus oppia ja kehittyä omassa työssä. Jos sinulla on halua ja intoa, meillä voit kasvaa myös kohti uusia uramahdollisuuksia.

Jos tuntuu siltä, että tämä voisi olla sinun paikkasi, kuulemme sinusta mielellämme.

Hakuaika päättyy 16.8.2026. Ethän kuitenkaan jää odottelemaan viime hetkeen, sillä käsittelemme hakemuksia ja voimme edetä valinnoissa jo hakuaikana. Ensimmäinen haastattelukierros toteutetaan Teams-haastatteluna, joten pidäthän silmällä sähköpostiasi - mahdollinen haastattelukutsu saapuu sinne.

Lisätietoja tehtävästä antaa ABC Pitkälahden liikennemyymäläpäällikkö Mira Myllynen, p. 050 446 0227. Jos kiinnostuksesi heräsi tai jokin asia mietityttää, ole rohkeasti yhteydessä - kysymällä se selviää!

Osuuskauppa PeeÄssä on yli 134 000 asiakasomistajan omistama palvelualan yritys Pohjois-Savossa. Tavoitteenamme on olla Parhaan Elämän Edelläkävijä Savossa. Meille se tarkoittaa merkityksellistä työtä, reilua työnantajuutta ja arjen sujuvuutta. Olemme ylpeitä siitä, että voimme tuottaa osuustoiminnallista hyötyä ja kehittää sitä jatkuvasti arvojemme mukaisesti: #tunteella, #toimeliaasti, #ylpeästi ja #yhdessä.

jobs.title: Autolakerer til Skovlunde
jobs.description:
Autolakerer søges til at få ridser og buler til at forsvinde!  

Har du styr på afdækning, slibning og spartling så bilerne står knivskarpe, før de ruller ind i kabinen? Kan du få selv de mest triste biler til at se ud som nye? Så er det dig, vi leder efter! 

Byens bilpleje.com er Danmarks førende virksomhed inden for kosmetisk klargøring af biler; herunder autolakering, buleopretning, rustbeskyttelse samt udskiftning af autoglas - vi er bilbranchens foretrukne samarbejdspartner. Byens bilpleje.com blev grundlagt i 1997 og beskæftiger i dag over 400 medarbejdere. Hertil håndterer virksomheden mere end 200.000 biler om året..

Hvad skal du lave? 

  • Du bliver en del af et team af lakspecialister, der tryller buler og ridser væk. Dine opgaver inkluderer bl.a.: 
  • Du fixer buler, spartler, sliber og afdækker (sprøjtelakerer), Så bilerne står som nye 
  • Sikre topkvalitet på det udførte arbejde 
  • Selvom du styrer dine egen opgaver, er du en del af et stærkt team, der hjælper hinanden, når der er brug for det 
  • Alt det andet: Fordi ingen arbejdsdag er helt ens 

Hvem er du? 

  • Du er en frisk type med humor, der elsker en god snak med kollegaerne over en kaffepause – men også en, der går op i kvalitet og finish. Vi leder efter dig, der: 
  • Har uddannelse eller erfaring som autolakerer 
  • Kan holde styr på opgaverne, selv når der er travlt 
  • Du evner at strukturere dine opgaver 
  • Har kørekort (B) – så du ikke behøver skubbe bilerne selv 
  • Elsker tempoet i en virksomhed, hvor ingen dage er helt ens 

Hvad får du? 

  • Løn efter kvalifikationer – vi betaler for talent! 
  • Gode kollegaer, der kan deres kram (og deler værkstedshistorier i pauserne) 
  • Markeds bedste redskaber/produkter at arbejde med 
  • Mulighed for udvikling 
  • En arbejdsplads med humor, godt humør og højt til loftet  
  • Overenskomst, pension og de fordele, du fortjener 

 Hvad gør du nu? 

Ansøg nu – før en anden snupper din plads! 

Vi holder samtaler løbende, fordi vi vil have den helt rigtige medarbejder med på holdet hurtigst muligt. Men hey – vi ved, at kvalitet tager tid, så vi venter gerne på den rette. 

Hvis du tænker: "Det dér job er som skabt til mig!" – så spild ikke tiden! Send din ansøgning afsted med det samme.  

Grundet GDPR-forordningen modtager vi ikke ansøgninger på mail, hvorfor disse ikke tages i betragtning. Ansøgningen skal sendes elektronisk via vores hjemmeside www.byensbilpleje.com. 

 Har du spørgsmål til stillingen, er du velkommen til at kontakte Susanne Damgaard Petersen 30432854

jobs.title: ISA Creative søger 2 ambitiøse mødebookere – 20–30 timer om ugen
jobs.description:
ISA Creative søger 2 energiske og resultatorienterede mødebookere, som skal være med til at skabe nye kundemøder med danske virksomheder.

Stillingen er på 20–30 timer om ugen og foregår fra vores kontor på Stamholmen i Hvidovre.

Om rollen

Din vigtigste opgave bliver at kontakte danske virksomheder, identificere relevante behov og booke kvalificerede møder til vores digitale rådgivere og specialister.

Du skal ikke selv sælge eller levere hjemmesiderne.

Din opgave er at:

  • Kontakte potentielle kunder telefonisk

  • Tale med virksomhedsejere og beslutningstagere

  • Identificere virksomheder med et digitalt behov

  • Skabe interesse for ISA Creatives løsninger

  • Booke kvalificerede salgsmøder

  • Registrere aktivitet og opfølgning i vores CRM

Vi leverer leads, systemer, træning, scripts og produktviden.

Hvad sælger ISA Creative?

ISA Creative hjælper virksomheder med blandt andet:

  • Websites og landing pages

  • Branding og visuel identitet

  • SEO og digital synlighed

  • AI Visibility / AEO / GEO

  • Leadgenerering

  • Content, foto og video

  • Digitale vækstløsninger

Mødebookeren skal ikke være specialist på disse områder. Du skal kunne skabe en god dialog, stille de rigtige spørgsmål og få den relevante beslutningstager til at tage et møde med vores eksperter.

Hvem søger vi?

Vi leder efter personer, som:

  • Er komfortable med telefonen

  • Har energi og et højt aktivitetsniveau

  • Kommunikerer professionelt på dansk

  • Er udadvendte og vedholdende

  • Motiveres af mål og resultater

  • Kan arbejde struktureret

  • Har lyst til at lære B2B-salg

  • Trives i et miljø med klare KPI'er og forventninger

Erfaring med salg eller mødebooking er en fordel, men ikke et krav.

Det kan eksempelvis være en attraktiv stilling for dig, der holder sabbatår, studerer ved siden af eller ønsker at udvikle dig inden for salg og digital marketing.

Arbejdstid og arbejdssted

20–30 timer om ugen. Arbejdet foregår fra vores kontor på Stamholmen i Hvidovre og primært inden for normal dansk arbejdstid, hvor virksomhederne kan kontaktes. Det er ikke en remote-stilling.

Løn

140 kr. i timen.

Derudover får du 300 kr. i bonus for hvert møde, du har booket, som efterfølgende bliver til et salg. Det betyder, at høj performance direkte kan ses på din løn.

Vi tilbyder

  • Professionel salgstræning

  • Produkt- og markedstræning

  • Leads og virksomhedslister

  • CRM og salgssystemer

  • Scripts og strukturerede salgsprocesser

  • Løbende coaching

  • Klare KPI'er

  • Mulighed for at udvikle dig inden for B2B-salg og digital marketing

  • Et ambitiøst miljø med fokus på vækst og performance

Om ISA Creative

ISA Creative er en del af ISA Media Group og arbejder med virksomheder inden for digital udvikling, branding, kommunikation og vækst.

Vi bygger i øjeblikket vores salgsorganisation inden for websites og digitale løsninger yderligere ud. Derfor søger vi nu 2 mødebookere, der skal være med til at skabe fundamentet for vores fortsatte vækst.

Ansøgning

Send os en kort ansøgning med:

  • Navn og alder

  • Hvad du laver i dag

  • Eventuel erfaring med salg eller kundekontakt

  • Hvorfor du tror, du vil være god til mødebooking

  • Hvor mange timer om ugen du ønsker at arbejde

  • Hvornår du kan starte

Vi afholder samtaler løbende.

Sa mission : contribuer durablement à un monde plus sûr, où le transport aérien devient toujours plus respectueux de l'environnement, plus confortable et plus accessible. Implanté sur tous les continents, le Groupe emploie 110 000 collaborateurs pour un chiffre d'affaires de 31,3 milliards d'euros en 2025, et occupe, seul ou en partenariat, des positions de premier plan mondial ou européen sur ses marchés.

Safran est la 2ème entreprise du secteur aéronautique et défense du classement « World's Best Companies 2025 » du magazine TIME.



SLS est le leader mondial des trains d'atterrissage, roues & freins, et systèmes associés, pour avions civils, militaires, hélicoptères. Nous maîtrisons l'ensemble du cycle de vie de nos produits, de la conception et la fabrication jusqu'à la maintenance.



Envie d'évoluer dans un environnement international, stimulant et bienveillant, au sein d'une entreprise à taille humaine ? Rejoignez-nous !



Vous ne remplissez pas 100 % des critères ? Ce n'est pas un frein pour nous. Ce que l'on recherche avant tout, ce sont des personnes créatives et engagées !



Parce que nous sommes persuadés que chaque talent compte, nous valorisons et encourageons les candidatures de personnes en situation de handicap pour nos opportunités d'emploi.

jobs.title: Change Management Specialist - Accounting and Corporate Services Transformation (m/f)
jobs.description:
Change Management Specialist - Accounting and Corporate Services Transformation

BDO Luxembourg is looking for a Change Management Specialist to support the transformation of its Accounting, Corporate, Fund and Payroll practices.

Who are we?

BDO is present in over 169 countries and we offer an extensive range of services in the areas of Audit, Tax, Advisory, Accounting, Business Services and Outsourcing. At BDO Luxembourg, our mission is to provide our clients with the expertise of our global network tailored to the unique needs of the Luxembourgish market, delivering personalized services and building valued relationships. With over 700 employees representing more than 40 nationalities, we embrace diversity and encourage skills and people development among our employees. Our core values, honesty, integrity, quality, respect and responsibility, define our culture. Hence, our People can expect to grow in a stimulating work environment that supports professional development and fosters inclusivity.

What will you do?

As Change Management Specialist, you will:
• Support the transformation core team in organising, monitoring and steering the overall transformation agenda.
• Contribute to the definition and implementation of change management plans across departments.
• Assess the impact of transformation initiatives on teams, roles, responsibilities, processes, behaviours and client service delivery.
• Work closely with sponsors, department representatives, managers and operational teams to ensure that change is understood, accepted and adopted.
• Identify adoption risks, resistance points, communication needs, training needs and operational readiness issues.
• Prepare stakeholder communications, internal updates, user engagement material and change adoption reporting.
• Support the preparation of change impact assessments, stakeholder maps, readiness assessments and adoption dashboards.
• Coordinate with the central IT Business Application team, project teams and other internal stakeholders to align implementation plans with business change needs.
• Promote a pragmatic and user-oriented approach to transformation, focused on operational adoption and sustainable change.

This position is for you if:

• You have 4 to 6 years of experience in change management, business transformation, organisational change, consulting, operational excellence or a similar field.
• You have contributed to transformation programmes involving several stakeholders, business teams or departments.
• Experience with accounting, corporate services, fund administration or professional services environments.
• You can translate strategic objectives into practical change actions.
• You are able to assess how change impacts people, processes, roles, responsibilities and ways of working.
• You are comfortable facilitating discussions, structuring feedback and turning complex situations into clear action plans.
• You have strong communication skills and can adapt your message to partners, managers and operational teams.
• You are structured, autonomous and pragmatic, with the ability to monitor progress without taking ownership of each individual project.
• You have a good understanding of digital transformation, business applications and the role technology can play in improving processes, collaboration and service delivery.
• You are familiar with the potential of AI in a business environment and have already used, tested or contributed to practical AI-related use cases.
• You are fluent in English and French.
…then this offer is probably made for you!

It would be an advantage if you also have:

• Exposure to software implementation or digital transformation programmes.
• Knowledge of change management methodologies such as Prosci, ADKAR, Kotter or similar approaches.
• Experience preparing change plans, communication plans, adoption material, training support or stakeholder engagement plans.
• Good command of Microsoft 365 tools, including PowerPoint, Excel, Teams and SharePoint. Experience with project or collaboration tools would be an asset.

What we offer

• A key role in a strategic transformation programme within one of BDO Luxembourg's core business practices.
• The opportunity to work closely with senior stakeholders, business teams and technology specialists.
• A varied role combining change management, stakeholder engagement, communication and transformation monitoring.
• A collaborative, multicultural and entrepreneurial working environment.
• The opportunity to contribute to the future operating model of our Accounting, Corporate, Fund and Payroll practices.
• Ongoing learning and development opportunities in line with your strengths and career aspirations.

What´s in it for you:

• Competitive remuneration package including
- a 13th month (representing a mobility budget offering a car leasing opportunity),
- a discretionary performance bonus
• Pension plan
• Lunch vouchers
• Extra days of annual leave
• Flexible working hours and homeworking options
• Parking spots available for a fee within our building
• Possibility to charge electric vehicles in our parking
• On-site employee restaurant with preferential prices
• Free access to our fitness room
• Sports sessions for small additional charge
• Internal sports groups (e.g. running, cycling and football)
• Career development opportunities through a wide range of trainings (e.g. technical and soft skills, language courses)

Our main office is ideally located in the modern and rapidly expanding Cloche d'Or area. This dynamic area offers easy access to public transport, stores and park-and-ride facilities.

Are you willing to grow your career in a multicultural, pleasant and dynamic environment? Then, take your chance!

jobs.description:
Career Opportunities: Banking Operations Officer (Fixed-term 24 months) (124470)
Requisition ID 124470 - Posted 31/07/2026 - Luxembourg - Luxembourg - Activity area (1) - Experienced Professionals

Your team

The Pictet Group is one of the world's leading independent wealth and asset managers. Founded in 1805 and headquartered in Geneva, Switzerland, the Group is represented at 30 offices in financial centres worldwide, and currently employs over 5200 people. Pictet has been present since 1989 in Luxembourg, where it employs over 700 people.

Technology & Operations design and integrate software applications ranging from portfolio management systems, trading platforms to banking and corporate solutions. The division is responsible for some of the Group's key innovations while sustaining business operations and developing custodian and funds administration services.

This function is in the Clients & Assets Services department, in the Asset Data Management unit.

Your role

As a Banking Operations Officer, you will be responsible for overseeing the opening and pricing of a diverse range of financial products. This includes a wide scope of assets, such as listed products (equities, bonds, loans, derivatives), OTC products (IRS, CDS, FX & Equity options, TRS, CFD), and structured products (autocall, reverse convertible, dual currency deposits, accumulators, airbags). You will manage the entire workflow, from trade reception and integration into the bank's database, through lifecycle management, to instrument pricing.

Another aspect of the role will be to manage our complex platform and its development, working closely with our Product Analyst.

• Integrate and control asset openings on our global platform, Neoxam.
• Monitor and publish asset data, prices, Greeks, market data, and analytics across all supported platforms.
• Manage the lifecycle of all assets from an asset data perspective (Corpac events, openings, unwinds).
• Provide support to various users of this data (accountants for investment funds, valuers, administrators, asset managers, wealth managers, etc.).
• Challenge various asset types against counterparty prices.
• Liaise directly with key stakeholders in case of issues.
• Implement the necessary configurations for queries and data/pricing flows for newly registered securities from our various financial information providers (Bloomberg, SIX, Reuters, ICE).
• Regularly review and update these settings.

Your profile

Requested experience:

• Master's degree in Finance, economics.
• 2 to 5 years' experience minimum in a similar position with a strong understanding of financial products and market structures.

Hard skills:

• Strong understanding on financial products.
• Solid technical skills, particularly with data management tools and financial platforms.
• Background in mathematical finance.
• Skilled user of office software applications, especially Excel.
• Programming skills: VBA, SQL or another language is an asset.

Soft skills:

• Ability to handle multiple tasks and projects with versatility in a dynamic environment.
• Excellent communication and collaboration skills to work with various teams and stakeholders.
• Strong analytical mindset and attention to detail, with a proactive approach to problem-solving.
• An enquiring mind with strong learning skills and a well-developed critical faculty.
• Accuracy and thoroughness in searching for the information required to value securities.
• Good capacity to collaborate and find win-win solution.

Language skills:

• French: fluent level
• English: good knowledge (written and spoken)

Note

We will not accept any CVs from agencies.

In accordance with the provisions of the Luxembourg law of 23 July 2016 amending the law of 29 March 2013, candidates may be required to provide an extract from their criminal record. This document, issued by the authorities, must not be older than three months. Such a document will be requested with the aim of carrying out a character check on candidates, bearing in mind the area of activity of our establishment and, more particularly, the tasks described in the job description.


Flexible and modern ways of working

As a responsible and supportive employer, we promote the well-being of our employees through a set of flexible working arrangements, ranging from a work-from-home policy for eligible functions to opportunities for annualised part-time leave and extended parental leave.

jobs.title: GBL Strategy Specialist, Global Medical Accommodations (m/f)
jobs.description:
GBL Strategy Specialist, Global Medical Accommodations
Job ID: 10485960 | Amazon Europe Core Sarl

Description

The Medical Accommodations Global Relations & Strategy Specialist is a specialized individual contributor role within Global Medical Accommodations (GMA), created to align ROW stakeholders to our global strategy, ways of working, and technology direction - while ensuring their legitimate concerns are heard, addressed, or escalated decisively. A key objective of this role is to help GMA progress toward global parity between the US and all other regions, ensuring ROW associates and business partners receive a consistent, high-quality accommodations experience.

This role operates as a strategic stakeholder advocate and internal change agent - listening deeply to regional business concerns, evangelizing the global accommodations mission, having backbone when stakeholder requests conflict with global strategy, and bridging divides where local legal requirements demand differentiation. The specialist owns the overarching program direction and strategy for ROW stakeholder alignment, but executes through partnership with the Global Parity & People Accessibility Leader, SME/ACES teams, Technology, and others as required.

Key job responsibilities

Stakeholder Advocacy & Strategic Alignment

Serve as the primary point of alignment between ROW stakeholders and GAA's global strategy, building deep understanding of regional business concerns while driving adoption of global ways of working and technology direction.
Evangelize the global accommodations mission and technology strategy to ROW stakeholders, building understanding and buy-in for the direction even when it challenges local preferences or established practices.
Exercise backbone: where stakeholder concerns conflict with global strategy and are not legally required, push back respectfully, bring stakeholders on board with the rationale, or escalate with a clear recommendation.
Where stakeholder concerns are valid - aligned to global policy or driven by local legal requirements - identify gaps and partner with the Global Parity & People Accessibility Leader to ensure they are addressed through the Global Parity program or technology roadmap.
Identify and surface emerging stakeholder concerns proactively (e.g., self-service models driving unintended volume in EU markets, insufficient medical documentation friction creating compliance risk), working with relevant teams to close gaps before they escalate.
Treat stakeholders as customers: understand their needs, close the loop on their concerns, and drive accountability for resolution.
Propose and implement mechanisms to measure stakeholder satisfaction - addressing the current gap where manager and business partner experience with accommodation services is not systematically captured.
Provide structured, data-backed updates to stakeholders on initiatives and concerns they have raised - keeping them informed, engaged, building trust through transparency and follow-through.

Service Adoption & Awareness

Develop and drive a global strategy to increase adoption of GMA services across ROW countries.
Partner with country operations and HR teams to understand barriers to service utilization, and work with relevant teams to remove friction and increase awareness.
Track adoption metrics by country and region, surfacing gaps and recommending targeted interventions to close them.

Program Ownership & Cross-Functional Execution

Own the overarching ROW stakeholder alignment program and strategic direction, executing through partnership with the Global Parity & People Accessibility Leader, SME/ACES, Ops Center of Excellence, business policy/standard work teams, Technology, Legal, and Expansions.
Partner with the Global Parity & People Accessibility Leader to ensure ROW stakeholder needs inform parity priorities. Validate that parity deliverables address field concerns and drive stakeholder adoption of implemented solutions. This role does not own the Global Parity program - it serves as the voice of ROW stakeholders into that program.
Identify ROW-specific technology needs and partner with the Global Parity & People Accessibility Leader to ensure these are reflected in the technology roadmap and product requirements.
Facilitate cross-functional working groups and governance forums, establishing clear decision rights, escalation pathways, and accountability mechanisms across all stakeholder teams.

Process Improvement and Standardization

Conduct structured current-state analyses and future-state mapping, engaging cross-functional teams to validate findings and build alignment on solutions before scaling.
Facilitate process improvement initiatives across ROW regions, identifying fragmentation and inconsistency in accommodation workflows and partnering with the Global Parity & People Accessibility Leader and operational teams to drive resolution.
Monitor regional performance against defined GMA expectations and metrics that are important to the business - including new metrics where existing measures do not capture stakeholder or operational reality.

Senior Leadership Engagement & Escalation Management

Build and maintain productive relationships with senior leaders across Operations, PXT, Legal, and WHS - ensuring they are informed, engaged, and aligned on accommodation strategy for their regions.

Draft and deliver structured communications, leadership briefings, and status updates that are concise, data-backed, and appropriate for executive audiences, including contributions to the business's Weekly Business Review (WBR) and Monthly Business Review (MBR) mechanisms as required.

Proactively surface cross-regional risks with proposed mitigation plans.
Exercise sound judgment in identifying when complex issues require escalation, preparing clear, data-driven problem statements, root cause analyses, and recommended actions that enable leaders to make informed decisions quickly.

Data Analysis and Insights

Analyze case data, audit findings, stakeholder feedback, and operational metrics across ROW regions to identify trends, bottlenecks, and emerging issues before they escalate into systemic problems.
Build and maintain tracking mechanisms that provide visibility into case volumes, turnaround times, adjustment types, stakeholder satisfaction, service adoption rates, and compliance adherence across the ROW network.
Use data to prioritize program initiatives, measure the impact of implemented solutions, and communicate progress to stakeholders and leadership.

Quantify the impact of stakeholder-raised concerns (e.g., volume increases attributable to self-service rollout) to inform strategic decisions on technology deployment pace and sequencing.

Regional Expansion and Change Management

Partner with the Expansions team during active country launches, focusing on post-launch adoption and ongoing stakeholder alignment rather than launch execution.
Lead change management for stakeholder adoption of GMA services and strategic initiatives this role drives, including stakeholder communications, training development, and feedback loop mechanisms that ensure adoption and continuous refinement.
Document learnings from ROW implementations and contribute to a central knowledge base that enables teams to benefit from cross-regional experience and avoid duplicating effort.

Basic Qualifications

- Experience in stakeholder management, including influencing executive level global leaders
- Bachelor's degree in Human Resources, Business Administration, Healthcare Management, or a related field, or equivalent professional experience.

jobs.title: Recognizing the Friction
jobs.description:
Virtual works adequately for many meetings. But how big is the gap between adequate and optimal for any given meeting? The mode decision should weigh the meeting's importance against the friction of meeting in person â not default to either one.

tClara

  • survey of 522 US-based business leaders, including 95 C-suite respondents
  • Across 26 meeting goals, 43% of leaders rate in-person as the better mode, 35% say virtual, and 22% say mode barely matters â the decision is genuinely goal-dependent, not a fixed rule.
  • In-person is the preferred mode for 22 of 26 goals â especially building trust and teamwork, persuading or selling, and solving important problems.
  • Virtual is preferred for goals like gathering diverse opinions, sharing updates, and using people's time efficiently.
  • Virtual meetings are seen as nearly twice as likely to produce a negative outcome as in-person meetings (47% vs. 25%) â convenience carries real risk.
  • 70% of leaders say a deliberate blend of virtual and in-person work allows them to do their best work; C-suite respondents value in-person meetings more than other leaders do (53% vs. 41%).

jobs.title: Director Proposal Management Defense and Space
jobs.description:
Job Description

We are seeking an experienced and strategic Director of Proposal Management to lead Defense and Space proposal operations supporting U.S. Government, OEM Defense, International Defense, and Space customers. This senior leadership role is responsible for driving winning proposal strategies, leading high-performing teams, improving proposal processes, and ensuring successful execution of complex RFQ, RFI, and RFP opportunities.

The ideal candidate is a transformational leader with deep expertise in proposal management, government contracting, cross-functional collaboration, and process improvement. This individual will work closely with executive leadership, sales, engineering, finance, and operations teams to secure new business and retain existing customers.

Responsibilities

Key Responsibilities

Team Leadership & Talent Development

  • Lead, mentor, and develop a diverse team of proposal management professionals.
  • Conduct performance evaluations, coaching, and career development planning.
  • Establish performance metrics and productivity goals.
  • Develop succession plans and build organizational capability for future growth.
  • Foster a culture of accountability, collaboration, and continuous improvement.

Process Improvement & Operations Excellence

  • Identify and implement process improvement initiatives to increase proposal quality, efficiency, and responsiveness.
  • Leverage automation and emerging technologies, including generative AI, to improve proposal operations.
  • Monitor key operational metrics and present results to executive leadership.
  • Improve proposal turnaround times and on-time delivery performance.
  • Lead continuous improvement efforts using Lean and Six Sigma methodologies.

Strategic Collaboration

  • Partner with Sales, Engineering, Finance, Contracts, and Program Management teams to develop compelling solutions.
  • Facilitate executive reviews, proposal kickoffs, and compliance reviews.
  • Analyze risks, opportunities, and business impacts to support strategic decision-making.
  • Present proposal performance, business insights, and organizational recommendations to senior executives.

Qualifications

Required Qualifications

  • 10+ years of proposal management experience in Aerospace, Defense, Government Contracting, or related industries.
  • 5+ years of people leadership experience managing professional teams.
  • Strong understanding of RFQ, RFI, and RFP processes.
  • Knowledge of FAR and government proposal compliance requirements.
  • Experience leading cross-functional and geographically dispersed teams.
  • Proven success managing multiple priorities in a fast-paced environment.
  • Advanced Microsoft Office proficiency.
  • Strong presentation, communication, and stakeholder management skills.

Preferred Qualifications

  • Bachelorâs Degree, Management, Operations, or related field
  • APMP membership or certification.
  • Six Sigma Green Belt certification.
  • Experience with Salesforce.com and data analytics tools.
  • Experience implementing process automation and AI-enabled business solutions.
  • Background supporting Defense, Aerospace, Aviation, or Space customers.

Key Competencies

  • Strategic Leadership
  • Proposal Management
  • Project Management
  • Business Process Improvement
  • Executive Communication
  • Relationship Building
  • Data-Driven Decision Making
  • Planning & Scheduling
  • Risk Management
  • Team Development
  • Continuous Improvement
  • Customer Focus

What Success Looks Like

  • Increased proposal win rates and business growth.
  • Improved proposal productivity, quality, and turnaround times.
  • Strong employee engagement and talent development.
  • Consistent on-time proposal delivery
  • Effective implementation of process improvements and operational efficiencies

Due to compliance with U.S. export control laws and regulations, candidate must be a U.S. person, which is defined as, a U.S. citizen, a U.S. permanent resident, or have protected status in the U.S. under asylum or refugee status.

Benefits

Beyond a performance-driven salary, you'll work alongside dedicated experts on technology that's advancing aviation. As a Honeywell Aerospace employee, you're eligible for a comprehensive benefits package that includes:

  • Employer-subsidized medical, dental, vision and life insurance
  • Short-term and long-term disability coverage
  • 401(k) match, flexible spending accounts and health savings accounts
  • Employee assistance program and educational assistance
  • Parental leave and 12 paid holidays
  • Paid time off for vacation, personal and sick time

Explore your benefits: https://honeywellaerospacebenefits.com/

Honeywell Aerospace products and services are found on aircraft across commercial aviation, defense and space â from engines and cockpit electronics to cabin systems, mechanical components and connectivity solutions. Our technology helps operators fly more safely, reduce fuel consumption, improve on-time performance and deliver a better experience for the people on board.

As aviation continues to evolve, we're also developing systems to support autonomous and supersonic platforms, bringing the same focus on safety and efficiency to the next era of flight. With approximately 36,000 employees worldwide and net sales of $17.4B in 2025, Honeywell Aerospace is one of the largest dedicated aerospace companies in the world. Explore our businesses: https://www.honeywellaerospace.com

With more than 10 million passengers per day flying on aircraft equipped with our products and more than 75% of commercial flights beginning with our engine start systems, Control Systems reaches farther across the aviation industry than most people realize.

jobs.title: Campaign Manager, Brand
jobs.description:
WHO WE ARE

Notion is the collaborative AI workspace where teams and agents think together https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=vkpYpWfEK5s. We're building one place where your knowledge, projects, meetings, and AI tools live side by side, so work is faster, clearer, and less fragmented. Millions of individuals, small teams, and large companies run their work on Notion.



Notinos (our employees) are customer zero in bringing this future of work to life. We care about craft, building things that last, and the belief that great work is still fundamentally human. Our goal isn’t to ship the next feature. Each and every team of Notinos is working to set the standard for how humans work together in the AI era. From building a business’s system of record to making and managing AI agents to automating away the busy work, we care deeply about giving our customers more time for their life’s work.




ABOUT THE ROLE:

Notion’s Integrated Marketing team connects our brand story to the world—ensuring that every campaign, launch, and experience builds on global awareness of Notion as the intelligent, AI-connected workspace for modern work. We're looking for an experienced, creative, and rigorous brand campaign expert who excels at conceptualizing innovative campaign strategies and bringing clarity to complex challenges.

 

This role can be based in either San Francisco or New York City. We work from our offices on Mondays, Tuesdays and Thursdays (our Anchor Days) because we do our best thinking and building together in person. We’re looking for someone who’s excited to work alongside the team during those days. 




WHAT YOU'LL ACHIEVE:

The Campaign Manager, Brand brings Notion’s mission, product capabilities, and customer stories to life through targeted, insight-driven brand campaigns. This role is responsible for conceptualizing, developing, and executing integrated marketing programs that connect Notion’s core value props to the needs and aspirations of our customers—from individuals to global enterprises.

Reporting to the Campaign Lead, you’ll drive seasonal campaigns, brand activations, and special projects that aim to build excitement among both current customers and prospects. You’ll work closely with Product Marketing, Growth Marketing, and Creative to transform feature launches, product education, and customer insights into powerful, scalable brand moments that build understanding, drive conversion, and reinforce Notion’s position as the AI workspace for teams. Responsibilities include:

 - Lead cross-functional campaign execution, from concept to delivery, for both special brand projects and feature-led programs

 - Partner with Creative to generate out-of-the-box brand marketing concepts, breaking from the industry mold and encouraging blue sky thinking

 - Partner with Product Marketing to develop strategies that translate product value into meaningful narratives for the target audience of each activation or campaign

 - Partner with Growth Marketing to define the right mix of content, media, and channels to reach each segment effectively

 - Manage campaign briefs, creative deliverables, and timelines—ensuring clarity, accountability, and alignment across stakeholders

 - Integrate brand and performance media buying from planning through delivery and reporting

 - Define and track KPIs for each campaign, analyzing and sharing results and applying insights to optimize future programs

 - Ensure all campaigns maintain a cohesive Notion voice and brand expression, while adapting to audience needs and regional contexts




SKILLS YOU'LL NEED TO BRING: 

 - 8+ years of experience in integrated or brand marketing, preferably in AI or tech, with proven success leading complex projects to fruition

 - Idea catalyst: You bring a concept-led approach and an opinionated point of view, sparking, shaping, and shepherding breakthrough concepts until they're undeniable

 - AI fluency: You have deep, first-hand experience experimenting with new AI tools, and are passionate about staying on top of fast-moving industry trends

 - Speed: You bias towards action and operate with ambition, creating processes that help cross-functional teams do the same

 - GTM expert: You have strong understanding of and passion for go-to-market planning, messaging, and storytelling for brand-driven campaigns

 - Collaborative: People on the projects you lead become the best versions of themselves by working with you, across product, creative, and data teams

 - Order agent: You possess strong organizational and analytical skills, with the ability to balance multiple work streams and deadlines at once while iterating for improvement




NICE TO HAVES:

 - Familiarity with hybrid audience targeting

 - Experience supporting global and/or regionalized campaigns

 - Experience using Notion—both personally and professionally



Notion is committed to providing highly competitive cash compensation, equity, and benefits. The compensation offered for this role will be based on multiple factors such as location, the role’s scope and complexity, and the candidate’s experience and expertise, and may vary from the range provided below. For roles based in San Francisco or New York City, the estimated base salary range for this role is $174,000 – $195,000 per year.



By clicking “Submit Application”, I understand and agree that Notion and its affiliates and subsidiaries will collect and process my information in accordance with Notion’s Global Recruiting Privacy Policy https://notion.notion.site/Notion-Global-Recruiting-Privacy-Policy-fc3eb4e829354a26a2bb6fd5e289b550?pvs=74 and NYLL 144 https://notion.notion.site/Ashby-AI-Bias-Audit-2b0efdeead05803bbbfae159ec86c528.



#LI-Onsite




A NOTE ON AI

You don’t need deep AI expertise for every role, but we do expect every Notino to be intellectually curious, drawn to tinkering and discovery, and excited to use AI as a real collaborator in their work. For some roles, AI fluency is a core requirement — when that’s the case, we'll say so explicitly in the qualifications. People who thrive here don’t treat AI as a novelty. They use it to think better, and make their work easier for others to build on.




EQUAL OPPORTUNITY & ACCOMMODATIONS

We hire talented people from a wide range of backgrounds. If you’re excited about this role but don’t meet every bullet, we still encourage you to apply. Notion is an equal opportunity employer and does not discriminate on the basis of any legally protected characteristic. Consistent with applicable law, we will consider for employment qualified applicants with arrest and conviction records. Notion provides reasonable accommodations during the application process; if you need one, please let your recruiter know.



Notion is proud to be an equal opportunity employer. We do not discriminate in hiring or any employment decision based on race, color, religion, national origin, age, sex (including pregnancy, childbirth, or related medical conditions), marital status, ancestry, physical or mental disability, genetic information, veteran status, gender identity or expression, sexual orientation, or other applicable legally protected characteristic. Notion considers qualified applicants with criminal histories, consistent with applicable federal, state and local law. jobs.title: Software Engineer, Infrastructure Security
jobs.description:
WHO WE ARE

Notion is the collaborative AI workspace where teams and agents think together https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=vkpYpWfEK5s. We're building one place where your knowledge, projects, meetings, and AI tools live side by side, so work is faster, clearer, and less fragmented. Millions of individuals, small teams, and large companies run their work on Notion.



Notinos (our employees) are customer zero in bringing this future of work to life. We care about craft, building things that last, and the belief that great work is still fundamentally human. Our goal isn’t to ship the next feature. Each and every team of Notinos is working to set the standard for how humans work together in the AI era. From building a business’s system of record to making and managing AI agents to automating away the busy work, we care deeply about giving our customers more time for their life’s work.




ABOUT THE ROLE:

Millions of people use Notion every day, and we’re growing quickly. The Infrastructure Security team’s mission is to build a secure-by-default foundation across Notion’s technical stacks—architecting systems that make the secure path the easy path. As an IC4 on this team, you’ll own meaningful infrastructure security problems end-to-end: from identifying risk, to designing pragmatic controls, to shipping secure defaults that scale across engineering.



This role can be based in either San Francisco or New York City. We work from our offices on Mondays, Tuesdays and Thursdays (our Anchor Days) because we do our best thinking and building together in person. We’re looking for someone who’s excited to work alongside the team during those days. 

 


WHAT YOU'LL ACHIEVE:

 - Proactively enhance the security posture of our AWS accounts and cloud infrastructure.

 - Create secure frameworks for secrets management and authentication/authorization.

 - Design and deploy robust Identity and Access Management (IAM) solutions.

 - Provide guidance and education on security and privacy best practices to cross-functional partners.

 - Participate in (and help drive) mitigation strategies during security-related incident response.

 


SKILLS YOU'LL NEED TO BRING: 

 - Security architecture and expertise: you’ve built and maintained systems to secure cloud architectures, ranging from secrets management to Identity and Access Management solutions.

 - Backend/infrastructure development: you’ve written and shipped production-grade code, and can contribute to the codebase and architecture to raise the bar on secure systems design.

 - Working in production: you can debug systems in production and continuously improve components with minimal disruption.

 - Pragmatic, risk-based prioritization: you model threats, balance trade-offs, and focus security investments where they drive the most business impact.

 - Empathetic communication: you communicate nuanced ideas clearly in writing and in real time; in disagreements, you engage thoughtfully and look for the right compromise.

 


NICE TO HAVES:

 - AWS security best practices, zero trust architectures, and/or deep IAM expertise.

 - Data security or privacy engineering experience.

 - Experience applying AI tooling to defensive security workflows.

 - Participation in security communities (local or regional groups, conferences).

 

Notion is committed to providing highly competitive cash compensation, equity, and benefits. The compensation offered for this role will be based on multiple factors such as location, the role’s scope and complexity, and the candidate’s experience and expertise, and may vary from the range provided below. For roles based in San Francisco or New York City, the estimated base salary range for this role is $230,000 - $280,000 per year.

 

By clicking “Submit Application”, I understand and agree that Notion and its affiliates and subsidiaries will collect and process my information in accordance with Notion’s Global Recruiting Privacy Policy https://notion.notion.site/Notion-Global-Recruiting-Privacy-Policy-fc3eb4e829354a26a2bb6fd5e289b550?pvs=74 and NYLL 144 https://notion.notion.site/Ashby-AI-Bias-Audit-2b0efdeead05803bbbfae159ec86c528.



#LI-Onsite




A NOTE ON AI

You don’t need deep AI expertise for every role, but we do expect every Notino to be intellectually curious, drawn to tinkering and discovery, and excited to use AI as a real collaborator in their work. For some roles, AI fluency is a core requirement — when that’s the case, we'll say so explicitly in the qualifications. People who thrive here don’t treat AI as a novelty. They use it to think better, and make their work easier for others to build on.




EQUAL OPPORTUNITY & ACCOMMODATIONS

We hire talented people from a wide range of backgrounds. If you’re excited about this role but don’t meet every bullet, we still encourage you to apply. jobs.title: ein wissenschaftlicher Referent / eine wissenschaftliche Referentin (m/w/d) (Archäologe/Archäologin)
jobs.description:
Weitere Berufsbezeichnung:
Bauforscher*in

Stellenbeschreibung:
Gestalten Sie die Zukunft der internationalen Forschung

Das Deutsche Archäologische Institut (DAI) ist eine weltweit führende Forschungseinrichtung im Bereich der Archäologie und Altertumswissenschaften. Es ist dem Auswärtigen Amt, einer obersten Bundesbehörde, nachgeordnet und leistet an seinen insgesamt 20 Standorten europa- und weltweit einen wichtigen Beitrag zum Schutz und Erhalt sowie zur Vermittlung von kulturellem Erbe. Sie finden uns im Internet unter http://www.dainst.org (http://www.dainst.org) .

An der Abteilung Madrid des Deutschen Archäologischen Instituts (DAI) ist zum nächstmöglichen Zeitpunkt die Stelle

eines wissenschaftlichen Referenten / einer wissenschaftlichen Referentin (m/w/d)

(Kennziffer: 08/2026)

in Vollzeit im Rahmen eines unbefristeten Beschäftigungs- bzw. Dienstverhältnisses. Eine Teilzeitbeschäftigung ist grundsätzlich möglich. Gehen entsprechende Bewerbungen ein, wird für den Arbeitsplatz geprüft, ob den Teilzeitwünschen im Rahmen der dienstlichen Möglichkeiten (insbesondere hinsichtlich der Anforderungen des Arbeitsplatzes und der gewünschten Gestaltung der Teilzeit) entsprochen werden kann.

Für Tarifbeschäftigte richtet sich das Entgelt beim Vorliegen der persönlichen Voraussetzungen bis Entgeltgruppe 13 TVöD Bund. Bei Vorliegen der laufbahn- und haushaltsrechtlichen Voraussetzungen besteht die Möglichkeit der Ernennung in das Beamtenverhältnis. Für Beamt*innen erfolgt die Besoldung bis Besoldungsgruppe A 13 BBesO. Bei Tarifbeschäftigten des Bundes sowie Beamtinnen und Beamten ist zunächst eine Abordnung mit dem Ziel der Versetzung zum DAI vorgesehen. Der Dienstort ist Madrid.

Das Arbeitsgebiet der Abteilung Madrid umfasst Spanien, Portugal und Marokko. Dieser geografische Raum bildet mit der Meerenge von Gibraltar eine zentrale Brücke zwischen Europa und Afrika sowie zwischen der Mittelmeerwelt und der Atlantikküste. Die Abteilung widmet sich der Erforschung von rund 7.000 Jahren Archäologie in diesen Kulturzonen, vom Neolithikum bis zum Beginn der Neuzeit. Seit ihrem Bestehen hat die Abteilung Madrid leistungsfähige Forschungsinfrastrukturen aufgebaut. Dazu zählen eine der größten archäologischen Fachbibliotheken der Iberischen Halbinsel mit mehr als 90.000 Bänden, umfangreiche Archiv- und Fototheksbestände sowie eine Forschungsstelle in Lissabon.

Aufgabenbeschreibung

Der Aufgabenbereich umfasst insbesondere:

- Entwicklung eigener Forschungsfragen im westlichen Mittelmeerraum (mit Fokus auf Austausch- und Entwicklungsprozesse zwischen Nordafrika und der Iberischen Halbinsel).
- Konzeption und Leitung eines eigenen Forschungsprojektes in Nordafrika (in Marokko und/oder Algerien).
- Leitung und Koordination des Forschungsdatenmanagements und des Archivs/Fotothek der Abteilung
- Capacity building und Netzwerkarbeit, z. B. Durchführung von Schulungen und/oder Summerschools und Mitwirkung in der Verbundforschung des DAI, (z. B. TANA-Netzwerk, TANMed).
- Eigenverantwortliche Budgetplanung und Mittelabrechnung für die betreuten Projekte und Arbeitsbereiche.
- Fachliche Leitung unterstellter Mitarbeiter sowie Anleitung von Hilfskräften und Praktikanten.
- Einwerbung von Drittmitteln.

Ihr Profil

Vorausgesetzt werden:

- Ein mit hervorragender Promotion abgeschlossenes Hochschulstudium auf dem Gebiet der Archäologie (Ur- und Frühgeschichte/Vor- und Frühgeschichte, Klassischen Archäologie, Archäologie der römischen Provinzen, Spätantike und frühes Christentum/Christliche Archäologie) oder Bauforschung.
- Deutsch verhandlungssicher in Wort und Schrift (mind. Niveau C2).
- Erfahrung in der Durchführung von Forschungs- und/oder Feldforschungsprojekten in Nordafrika.
- Erfahrung im Bereich Forschungsdatenmanagement und/oder in der Arbeit mit wissenschaftlichen Archiven/Fototheken.
- Vorlage eines überzeugenden Konzeptes zu den wissenschaftlichen Perspektiven und Capacity building für die ersten drei Jahre der Anstellung.

Wir freuen uns über:

- Kenntnisse einer für den Forschungsraum relevanten Sprachen bzw. Bereitschaft zum Erlernen dieser Sprachen.
- Bereitschaft zur Koordinierung von Arbeitsgruppen, Kolloquien und Mitarbeit in internationalen Kooperationen.
- Bereitschaft zum aktiven Auslandsdienst, d. h. internationale Kontaktpflege in Spanien und Nordafrika, enge Zusammenarbeit mit den deutschen Auslandsvertretungen in den Gastländern, Teilnahme an institutseigenen Kolloquien, Tagungen usw.

Als Mitarbeiterin oder Mitarbeiter des DAI bringen Sie eine hohe Sensibilität für Gleichstellung und Antidiskriminierung mit. Sie verfügen über interkulturelle Kompetenz und sind in der Lage, mit Menschen unterschiedlicher Herkunft respektvoll und offen zu kommunizieren und zu kooperieren.

Ihre Vorteile:

Abwechslungsreiche und kulturnahe und Aufgaben

Sie arbeiten in einer national wie international angesehenen Forschungseinrichtung des Bundes, die die weltweite Forschung und Nachwuchsförderung, den Schutz von kulturellem Erbe sowie die kulturelle Verständigung und Zusammenarbeit zum Ziel hat.

Arbeitsplatzsicherheit

Auch in Krisenzeiten bieten wir Ihnen ein sicheres Beschäftigungsverhältnis im öffentlichen Dienst.

Flexibles und familienfreundliches Umfeld

Wir fördern eine gute Vereinbarkeit von Beruf, Familie und Pflege durch:

• flexible Arbeitszeiten (Rahmenarbeitszeit von 6:00 bis 22:00 Uhr)

• Gleitzeit mit Stundenausgleich (z. B. durch Gleittage)

• Möglichkeiten zur Teilzeit und mobilen Arbeit

• kostenfreien Familienservice mit Beratungs- und Vermittlungsangeboten.

Motivierendes Arbeitsumfeld

Unsere Zusammenarbeit ist geprägt von gegenseitigem Respekt, Vertrauen, flachen Hierarchien und kurzen Entscheidungswegen. Eigeninitiative, Mitgestaltung und kreative Ideen sind ausdrücklich erwünscht.

Entwicklungs- und Karriereperspektiven

Wir bieten Ihnen ein breites Spektrum an Fort- und Weiterbildungen sowie individuelle Maßnahmen zur Personalentwicklung.

Urlaubsregelung

Sie erhalten 30 Tage Erholungsurlaub (bei einer Teilzeitbeschäftigung wird der Urlaubsanspruch entsprechend der tariflichen/gesetzlichen Vorgaben gewährt). Zusätzlich besteht die Möglichkeit von Sonder- und Bildungsurlaub.

Mobilitätszuschuss

Sie erhalten bei einem Dienstort in Deutschland von uns einen Zuschuss zu einem ÖPNV-Ticket (DeutschlandJobTicket o.a.).

Betriebliche Gesundheitsförderung

Wir bieten eine Mitgliedschaft im Sozialwerk des Auswärtigen Amtes an und ermöglichen so den Zugang zu vergünstigten Freizeit- und Erholungsangeboten. Zusätzlich profitieren Sie von der Kooperation mit Wellhub und erhalten über diese Wellness-Plattform Zugang zu zahlreichen Fitness-Studios, Online-Kursen zu Themen wie z. B. Meditation oder Ernährung und weiteren Angeboten.

Interessenvertretungen

Ihre Interessen werden bei uns von den Personalräten, der Schwerbehindertenvertretung und der Gleichstellungsbeauftragten vertreten.

Haben wir Ihr Interesse geweckt?

Dann freuen wir uns auf Ihre Bewerbung! Senden Sie Ihre Unterlagen (Motivationsschreiben, Lebenslauf, Ausbildungsnachweis, Arbeitszeugnisse etc.) bis zum

26.08.2026

in einer zusammengefassten PDF-Datei unter Angabe der Kennziffer 08/2026 an bewerbung@dainst.de. (https://mailto:bewerbung@dainst.de) Bitte fügen Sie Ihren Bewerbungsunterlagen weiterhin den auf der Homepage des DAI unter https://www.dainst.org/karriere/bewerben-am-dai (https://www.dainst.org/karriere/bewerben-am-dai) (Formularcenter) eingestellten Bewerbungsbogen „Wissenschaft“ ausgefüllt sowie, sofern Sie bereits im öffentlichen Dienst tätig sind, eine Einverständniserklärung zur Einsicht in Ihre Personalakte bei.

Wir bitten um Verständnis, dass wir nur vollständige Bewerbungen berücksichtigen können.

Haben Sie noch Fragen zu unserem Stellenangebot?

Dann kontaktieren Sie uns für weitere Auskünfte. Schreiben Sie eine E-Mail an bewerbung@dainst.de oder rufen Sie Herrn Sternbeck unter 030/187711-295 an. Für fachliche Fragen wenden Sie sich bitte an Paul Scheding, Leitender Direktor der Abteilung Madrid, E-Mail: paul.scheding@dainst.de.

Weitere Hinweise:

Bewerber*innen (m/w/d) mit Schwerbehinderung oder diesen gleichgestellte Personen werden bei gleicher Eignung entsprechend den gesetzlichen Grundlagen bevorzugt berücksichtigt.

Das DAI gewährleistet gemäß BGleiG die berufliche Gleichstellung unabhängig vom Geschlecht und unterstützt die Vereinbarkeit von Beruf und Familie, indem flexible Arbeitszeiten gelebt und Teilzeitmodelle im Rahmen der dienstlichen Möglichkeiten realisiert werden.

Vielfalt ist einer unserer zentralen Organisationswerte. Deshalb begrüßen wir Bewerbungen unabhängig von Nationalität, ethnischer und sozialer Herkunft, Religion und Weltanschauung, Alter sowie sexueller Orientierung und Identität.

Im Zusammenhang mit Ihrer Bewerbung behandeln wir Ihre personenbezogenen Daten mit größter Sorgfalt und Diskretion. Unsere Datenschutzinformation finden Sie auf unserer Webseite unter www.dainst.org/datenschutz (http://www.dainst.org/datenschutz) . Diese informiert Sie gemäß Art. 13 DSGVO über den Umfang und die Art und Weise der Verarbeitung sowie über Ihre diesbezüglichen Rechte.

Ergänzende Informationen:
Anforderungen an den Bewerber:
Zwingend erforderlich: Forschung, Archäologie, Ausgrabungen, Quellenmaterial auswerten (Geschichte)

jobs.title: Vice President Turbo Charging Research & Development (m/f/d)
jobs.description:
We are seeking a highly skilled, strategic and innovative Vice President R&D to lead and manage the research and development of new turbocharging products, components, and technologies within our organization.

In this role, you will be responsible for overseeing the entire R&D process, including product performance testing, validation, and ensuring product safety and reliability. You will lead a team of ca 120 R&D employees and manage a budget of over 50 MUSD. You will collaborate closely with the division presidents and other senior leaders to ensure that all product releases meet the highest standards before launch. You and your experts will also support the process of technology scouting beyond turbocharging. Located in Baden, you will report to the CEO and be part of the extended management team.  

Your Responsibilities:

1. R&D Strategy and Leadership:

Lead and manage the turbocharging R&D department to drive the development of new products, components, technologies and engineering methodologies aligned with the company’s strategic goals.
Define and execute the TC R&D strategy ensuring it supports the company's vision and objectives.
Foster an innovative environment that encourages creative solutions, research breakthroughs, and efficient development processes.
Secure that the R&D budget is spent efficiently on related projects and initiatives.
Represent the company in industry organizations and initiatives, (eg. CIMAC Greenhouse Gas Strategy Group, Swissmem industry sector for the internal combustion engine industry), and support the Swiss IMO delegation.
2. Product Development and Innovation:

Oversee the development of new products from concept through to prototype, ensuring that each product meets performance, safety, and reliability standards.
Manage the research and design process to ensure efficient, cost-effective product development that reflects the customer needs and is in line with Accelleron Product Market Strategy.

3. Product Performance Testing and Validation:

Ensure that robust testing and validation processes are in place to assess product performance and reliability with adherence to safety and quality standards.
Maintain and continuously develop testing and computing infrastructure.
Focus on improving product performance, reliability and safety.
Identify potential risks and implement corrective actions throughout the product lifecycle.

4. Collaboration with Management:

Work closely with the Division Presidents and senior management to ensure alignment on product development goals and timelines.
Jointly approve and sign-off on all product releases with the Division Presidents to ensure that all products meet the required standards before market launch.
Enhance the opportunities that AI provides in collaboration with AI organization.
Collaborate with Vice President Strategy and Investor Relations on scouting of new technologies.

5. Continuous Improvement:

Identify opportunities for process improvements within the R&D department and across the organization to optimize efficiency and productivity.
Stay current on industry trends, research methodologies, AI and emerging technologies to maintain competitive advantage and drive innovation.
Build and maintain networks with diverse stakeholders such as universities, research institutions and associations to gain broad perspective of development and to represent the company.

6. Leadership and Development:

Lead, mentor, and manage the R&D team, ensuring that each member is supported in their professional development and empowered to contribute to the team’s success.
Secure that competences needed now and in the future are acquired and developed.
Foster a collaborative, high-performance and effective safety culture within the department.

​Your Qualifications:

In depth and proven knowledge of turbocharging technologies and research methodologies including an advanced degree in mechanical engineering.
Robust experience of leading R&D operations and engineering globally across a complex technology portfolio.
Strong track record of creating and leading technology strategies, investment prioritization and innovation portfolios, preferably on enterprise level and closely aligned with business strategy.
Experience of repeatedly leading technology development from concept through validation to market introduction, especially leading turbocharger programs successfully converting innovation into commercial outcomes.
Deep understanding of product performance testing, validation, safety, and reliability assessments as well as regulatory compliance.
Exceptional stakeholder and influencing skills based on having regularly interfaced with executive leadership, government agencies, universities, industry consortia and regulatory bodies while advising on technology and policy topics.
Excellent leadership skills with collaborative and people-focused leadership style proven in successfully leading sizable global teams.
Future technology and innovation orientation combined with strong business and investment acumen.
Curiosity, learning agility and entrepreneurial mindset.

Your benefits:

Attractive compensation & benefits
Employee Assistance Program
Global parental leave program
Flexible working models
We look forward to receiving your application. If you want to discover more about Accelleron, take another look at our website accelleron.com.

 - AI and data licensing experience, with strong partnership across Privacy and Security to translate model, data, and customer requirements into practical product and vendor terms.

 - Demonstrated curiosity about AI and a willingness to adopt AI tools to work smarter, move faster, and deliver better results. Developing your personal AI fluency is required for this role.

jobs.title: Demand Generation Lead, Growth
jobs.description:
At Linear, we're building the product development system for teams and agents. AI is fundamentally changing how software gets built, and we’re shaping the tools this new era requires. 

Founded in 2019, Linear has become the platform of choice for more than 40,000 companies (including OpenAI, Coinbase, and Ramp) to plan, build, and ship their products. Today, our team is distributed across North America and Europe, and we’re continuing to grow internationally. What unites us is relentless focus, fast execution, and a deep care for software craftsmanship.

Over the last year we’ve made a lot of progress producing quality content and messaging, and we’re now looking for someone to help us distribute it to the right audiences.

As Demand Generation Lead, you’ll own how future customers find and first experience Linear, across web, search, and paid media. Your objective is to build awareness and pipeline, particularly with larger companies.

It’s likely this role will operate and feel a little different to what you might find elsewhere. Linear is a very brand forward company, so there will be scenarios where we have to turn down seemingly great opportunities to protect perception. We’re unlikely to ever use retargeting pixels and gated content, for example.

We’ve got a basic demand motion in place today but we’ve barely scratched the surface. As the first demand generation hire, you’ll own the strategy and lead on delivering it.

The marketing team is small but has an outsized impact, and we intend to keep it that way. You’ll have real influence on how Linear grows, and you’ll be encouraged to take ownership and deploy tooling and practices that help you be more effective.

Location & work mode

Linear is a remote-first company, with optional co-working offices in San Francisco, New York, and London. This role is open to candidates based in the US and Europe. You can work from anywhere within those regions. We value deep focus and async collaboration, with intentional moments to connect in person through team off-sites, optional co-working, and occasional travel.

What you’ll do

 - Work with Magic, our in-house design team, on the web pages and ad creative that future customers see first

 - Own paid media end to end, from channel strategy and budget to the creative itself, including account-based campaigns for enterprise accounts in partnership with sales and event marketing

 - Own search, both the classic kind and the answers AI gives when someone asks which tools to use

 - Define how we measure success for this motion

 - Use AI and automation tools actively to move faster and do more. This is a core part of how we expect this role to operate, not a nice-to-have

What we’re looking for

 - 5+ years in growth or demand generation at a B2B SaaS company, with hands-on experience across web, paid media, and ABM, and real time spent generating pipeline for an enterprise sales team

 - Genuine design sense. You can direct creative and identify when something feels off

 - Strong instincts around Linear’s core audience (product and engineering teams), and you can speak their language

 - Disciplined with capital (anyone can throw dollars at problems), but you know when to double down

 - Fluent in measurement without being captive to it. You can build the reporting and argue the pipeline math, and still defend spend a dashboard will never really explain

 - Deep fluency with AI tooling. You default to automation and use it to do work that would otherwise take a team

 - Very well versed with attribution, but somewhat disillusioned with it. We’re not going to spend much energy defining attribution, we just need someone with good instincts

What we offer

We're a small, focused team that cares deeply about the quality of our work and the people we do it with. Here's what you can expect:

 - Competitive salary and equity

 - Employee-friendly equity terms including early exercise in the US and extended exercise windows

 - Daily meal and coffee stipend on every workday

 - Paid co-working space or desk

 - Health coverage (based on country requirements)

 - 5 weeks paid vacation, plus local statutory holidays

 - 4 months paid parental leave

 - Paid month off after 4 years & every 2 years thereafter

 - Regular team events and off-sites

 - Remote-first with no required commute

Learn how we think and work

 - How we work: Designing remote work at Linear https://linear.app/now/designing-remote-work-at-linear

 - Our CEO and co-founder, Karri at 20VC: How to Grow Capital Efficiently in a World of BS Growth https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=4vqDYkuzbSM

jobs.title: Holly Can Fix It
jobs.description:
About Four Seasons

Four Seasons is powered by our people. We are a collective of individuals who crave to become better, to push ourselves to new heights and to treat each other as we wish to be treated in return. Our team members around the world create amazing experiences for our guests, residents, and partners through a commitment to luxury with genuine heart. We know that the best way to enable our people to deliver these exceptional guest experiences is through a world-class employee experience and company culture.

At Four Seasons, we believe in recognizing a familiar face, welcoming a new one and treating everyone we meet the way we would want to be treated ourselves. Whether you work with us, stay with us, live with us or discover with us, we believe our purpose is to create impressions that will stay with you for a lifetime. It comes from our belief that life is richer when we truly connect to the people and the world around us.

About the location:

Since opening in 1962, The Ocean Club, A Four Seasons Resort, Bahamas has been a playground for celebrities and discerning travellers set along an 8-kilometre (5-mile) stretch of natural, white-sand beach on Paradise Island. Connect with Bahamian beauty in an enclave of remarkable seclusion, where intimate low-rise buildings are immersed in 14 hectares (35 acres) of Versailles-inspired lawns and gardens. Wake up to breakfast on your private balcony, then indulge in a restorative treatment in one of our Balinese-style spa villas or head out for a round of golf at Ocean Club Golf Course. However you spend your day, be sure to join us back at Martini Bar and Lounge for a nightcap.

When Legends Come To Life

Since opening in 1962, The Ocean Club has welcomed the worldâs most discerning guests to our five-mile stretch of natural white sand beach â framed by 35 acres of Versailles inspired lawns and gardens.

Discover the legendary chic of The Ocean Club, combining elevated Four Seasons service with laid-back Bahamian style â creating one of the most sought-after resort experiences in the Caribbean.

On a stretch of natural white sand beach, our resort offers 107 ultra-luxury accommodations, a Balinese-inspired spa, and dining by Michelin-starred chef Jean-Georges Vongerichten.

The Ocean Club has a treasured history serving generations of luxury travelers. Expansive lawns and towering coconut palms provide an enchanting backdrop to the pristine beaches of Paradise Island.

The Ocean Club offers a rich roster of activities including water sports such as snorkeling, sailing and wind-surfing along with land-based activities including world-class golf and tennis plus a relaxing spa.

Key Duties And Responsibilities

  • Keeps all equipment in good repair with a minimum of downtime by providing day to day maintenance of the hotel under the direction of Engineering Management. Ensures a complete understanding of and adheres to the companyâs fire and safety procedures.
  • Continually supports and improves engineering services that effectively address problems affecting both guests and associates.
  • Trains and instructs other members of the staff by passing along knowledge and skills to assist them in their development and the advancement of your own.
  • Strives to become an independent mechanic, analyzes problems and formulates plans to get work done quickly with a high degree of quality. Ensures that Engineering and the work area are kept clean at all times.
  • Completes work orders and responds to guest calls unsupervised. Maintains a basic knowledge of the hotel TV system and trouble shooting. Ensures a complete understanding of basic trouble shooting of electrical problems.
  • Maintains communications with Supervisors to ensure that all materials, tools, and supplies are available or on order. Follows up on any items that may be back ordered. Responsible for letting supervisor know of stock and tool needs.
  • Performs minor plumbing repairs and maintenance. Performs basic repairs and maintenance of chilled water fan coil units in guest rooms. Performs basic wallpaper repairs as required. Ensures a complete understanding of guest room safe lock system, and performs emergency access to guest room locks as required.
  • Performs basic painting and touch-ups as required. Performs basic repairs to all guest room furnitureâs, sliding door locks, drapes etc., in guest rooms. Performs basic repairs to guest bathroom tiles, grouting and all hardware.
  • Performs all reasonable duties requested by management.

This is an exciting time to join The Ocean Club, a Four Seasons Resort.

Applicants that are interested in applying, please note that the position is based on The Ocean Club, A Four Seasons Resort Property located in The Bahamas and is available to those individuals who possess a legal ability to work in The Bahamas without sponsorship.
